## What it is Reasonix is an open-source AI coding assistant. The program runs on your computer; the AI model is a service you configure, which receives what it reads. You describe a task in plain language; it reads code, edits files and runs commands and tests inside the project folder you choose, and shows you each step. You pick the model: a DeepSeek preset is built in, any OpenAI-compatible service is one config entry, and you pay the model provider directly. ## What you get - **Read, edit, run.** It reads code, edits files and runs tests and commands, all inside your project folder. - **Permission levels.** Have it ask every time, or let everyday actions run on their own; your forbid rules always hold. To see the approach first, use plan mode: it starts work only once you approve. - **Rewind.** A file is saved before it changes, so you can rewind by conversation turn without touching your git history. Only files its edit tools changed are covered, not what a shell command did. ## 30-second start Download, add a model key, open a project. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app. 1. Download and install the desktop app, Reasonix Studio, from the [releases page](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true). 2. Open it and enter your model provider and key when asked. 3. Open your project folder and write what you want, for example "add retry on failure to the http client". 4. At the level you chose, it stops and asks before anything that needs your say-so. Allow it to continue, or refuse. Prefer a terminal? Download the `reasonix` command-line tool, run `reasonix setup` to pick a model, then run `reasonix`. See [Install](#install) and [Quick start](#quick-start). ## Four ways to use it - **Desktop app (Studio).** A graphical app; the best place to start. - **Terminal.** A full-screen text interface; `reasonix run "task"` also works in scripts. - **Browser.** `reasonix web` opens a web interface on your own machine. - **Editor.** Install the extension in VS Code; other editors that support ACP (Agent Client Protocol, a common way for an editor to connect to an AI assistant) can connect to `reasonix acp`. All four are the same program underneath. What follows is for advanced users and contributors. ## Use it from DeepSeek Harness DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) can hand a task to Reasonix as a subagent over ACP. This repository publishes a plugin index for it: 1. Run `reasonix setup` on the machine that runs `dsh`. In the DSH Web UI turn on Custom plugin markets (Plugins, More) and add this index in the Discover tab: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/studio/integrations/dsh-plugin/market-index.json` 2. Install "Reasonix subagent" from it. 3. Open the plugin's page and turn its switch on. While it is off the model has no `reasonix` tool and may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell, which looks like a delegation and is not one. Setup details, the permission policy and limits are in [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md). ## Versions Reasonix ships on two lines. See the [version roadmap announcement](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/discussions/10748) for the reasoning behind the split. | Line | Branch | Status | Get it | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Reasonix 2.x** | `studio` (this branch) | Active development | [Studio releases](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) | | **Reasonix 1.x** | [`main-v2`](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/tree/main-v2) | Maintenance / stable | `npm i -g reasonix` · [desktop download](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start) | - **Want something stable?** Stay on 1.x. It keeps receiving bug fixes, provider/API compatibility, updater and security fixes; its core architecture is no longer being extended. - **Want the new architecture?** Use 2.x Reasonix Studio. It is still moving quickly; reports are welcome. Valuable fixes, tests and behaviour from 1.x are reviewed one by one and ported or reimplemented on 2.x where they fit the new architecture. - [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md): what the two lines share, and how to run both on one machine without losing sessions. - [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md): what 2.x still has to deliver, how it ships, and the decisions still open. ## Features Technical highlights for advanced users. - **Config-driven.** Providers, the agent, enabled tools, and plugins are all declared in `reasonix.toml`. No hardcoded models. - **Multi-model & composable.** DeepSeek ships as a preset; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a config entry, not new code. Optionally run two models together (executor + planner) in separate, cache-stable sessions. - **Plugin-driven.** MCP servers contribute tools, prompts, and resources; Extension Protocol v1 sidecars can also intercept runtime events, contribute Providers and structured UI, and ship versioned plugin packages. - **Cache-aware context maintenance.** Startup injects a small stable environment summary, stale tool output is snipped/pruned before summary compaction, and the built-in tool schema contract is documented for regression review. - **Zero-friction distribution.** `CGO_ENABLED=0` single binary; cross-compile to six targets with one command. The result is a fully self-contained static binary — nothing to install on the target machine beyond the binary itself. ## Install This branch is **Reasonix 2.x**. Its desktop app is Reasonix Studio; the CLI, Studio, and editor integrations all run the same local Reasonix engine. ### Reasonix Studio (2.x) Download the package for your platform from the latest [Studio release](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) (tagged `studio-v2.*`; candidates such as `-rc.N` are marked as pre-releases): | Platform | Package | Architecture | | --- | --- | --- | | macOS | `.dmg` or `.zip` | Apple Silicon (`arm64`) / Intel (`amd64`) | | Windows | Installer `-installer.exe` or portable `.zip` | x64 | | Linux | `.deb`, `.rpm`, or `.AppImage` (download only) | x64 (`amd64`) / ARM64 (`arm64`, aarch64) | Every package ships with a `.minisig` signature, and the release carries `SHA256SUMS`. Once installed, Studio updates itself in place. The same release also carries the 2.x `reasonix` CLI as archives for `darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64`. ### Reasonix 1.x (stable) The 1.x CLI installs through npm on any supported platform, or Homebrew on macOS: ```sh npm i -g reasonix # any OS; pulls the prebuilt native binary brew install esengine/reasonix/reasonix # macOS ``` The 1.x desktop app is on the [official download page](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start). Windows installers are code-signed with a Certum code-signing certificate. ### VS Code extension The extension does not bundle the CLI; it starts your local `reasonix acp` backend and adds native chat, editor context, tool-call approvals, model selection, and workspace sessions. Install the 1.x CLI first. - **VS Code:** [install from Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SivanLiu.reasonix-agent) - **VSCodium / Eclipse Theia:** [install from Open VSX Registry](https://open-vsx.org/extension/SivanLiu/reasonix-agent) - **Extension ID:** `SivanLiu.reasonix-agent` · [source and usage guide](https://github.com/SivanCola/reasonix-vscode) ### Build from source Clone the repository; `studio` builds 2.x and `main-v2` builds 1.x: ```sh git clone https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.git cd DeepSeek-Reasonix git switch studio ``` #### CLI The CLI build requires **Go 1.25+**. The module pins a `toolchain` directive; keep `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` so Go downloads the pinned toolchain, or install it. ```sh make build # -> bin/reasonix(.exe) make cross # -> dist/ (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64) ``` #### Studio Studio additionally requires **Node 24+ and pnpm 10** (`npm install -g pnpm@10`) for the frontend. ```sh make studio ``` See the [Studio build guide](desktop/README.md#prerequisites) for platform webview dependencies and Linux build tags. ## Quick start ### Reasonix Studio Install and launch Studio, then connect a provider and model in the app. No CLI setup is needed. ### CLI / TUI ```sh reasonix setup # configure a provider and model reasonix # start an interactive session reasonix run "implement the TODOs in main.go" ``` In an interactive session, run `/init` when you want Reasonix to create project instructions. For advanced CLI usage and configuration, see the **[CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md)**, **[Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md)**, and **[configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md)**. ## Documentation - **Getting started:** [Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md) · [CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md) · [Configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md) · [ACP editor integration](./docs/ACP.md) · [Use from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md) - **Features & troubleshooting:** [Subagent profiles](./docs/SUBAGENT_PROFILES.md) · [Context Engine v2](./docs/SESSION_MEMORY_RETRIEVAL.md) · [Capability diagnostics](./docs/CAPABILITY_DIAGNOSTICS.md) · [Recovery and updates](./docs/RECOVERY.md) · [Checkpoints & rewind](./docs/CHECKPOINTS.md) - **Agent presets:** [Session Agent compositions](./docs/AGENT_COMPOSITIONS.md) - **Engineering & migration:** [Spec](./docs/SPEC.md) · [Task contracts & pause policy](./docs/TASK_CONTRACT.md) · [Tool contract](./docs/TOOL_CONTRACT.md) · [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md) · [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md) - **Extension development:** [Skills](./docs/SKILLS.md) · [Extensions](./docs/EXTENSIONS.md) · [Plugin packages and Manifest v1](./docs/PLUGIN_PACKAGES.md) · [Extension Protocol](./docs/EXTENSION_PROTOCOL.md) · [Go SDK and starter](./sdk/go/README.md) ## Star History
## Acknowledgments A small list of folks whose work has shaped Reasonix the most — the current top 20 contributors by commit count. The full contributor graph is on [GitHub](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/graphs/contributors?all=1). | Contributor | Contributor | Contributor | Contributor | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [**SivanCola**](https://github.com/SivanCola) | [**KHG420**](https://github.com/KHG420) | [**ttmouse**](https://github.com/ttmouse) | [**lifu963**](https://github.com/lifu963) | | [**XTLine**](https://github.com/XTLine) | [**HUQIANTAO**](https://github.com/HUQIANTAO) | [**chuiwenwei**](https://github.com/chuiwenwei) | [**Harbor404**](https://github.com/Harbor404) | | [**GTC2080**](https://github.com/GTC2080) | [**mchenziyi**](https://github.com/mchenziyi) | [**Li-Charles-One**](https://github.com/Li-Charles-One) | [**light-front-theory**](https://github.com/light-front-theory) | | [**xxoingr**](https://github.com/xxoingr) | [**eghrhegpe**](https://github.com/eghrhegpe) | [**noreply**](https://github.com/noreply) | [**par73e**](https://github.com/par73e) | | [**Bernardxu123**](https://github.com/Bernardxu123) | [**Guan0923**](https://github.com/Guan0923) | [**HaoyueQin**](https://github.com/HaoyueQin) | [**BuGlessRB**](https://github.com/BuGlessRB) | Special thanks to [**Bernardxu123**](https://github.com/Bernardxu123) for designing the project logo and intro video.

# dsh-TUI plugin — `/memory` 与 `/audit` 在 dsh-TUI 里增加一个用户命令： ```text /memory ``` 执行后确保 `memory-eternal` 的本地 Web 服务存活，并打开同一套 Memory Atlas Web UI。 另一个命令： ```text /audit ``` 在 dsh-tui 内直接打开**原生审核场景**：读取真实待审队列，判词面板显示卡片来源与 `reason`（区分「蒸馏兜底原文卡」和真正值得审的内容）、`severity`；`s` 全选、`a` 批准、`r` 驳回（批准/驳回都先进入二次确认，驳回可顺手填理由），`Esc` 取消/退出。它不打开浏览器，也不复制 Web UI。详见下文 [「`/audit` 审核闭环」](#audit-审核闭环issue-50)。 ## 先看效果（不需要 dsh-tui） 完整 TUI 原型： ```bash node dsh-tui-plugin/demo.mjs ``` 包含： - `1` 记忆库：搜索、类型、今日回看、读卡 - `2` 待审：类型、全选、批量批准/驳回、判词 - `3` 知识星图：连接簇、相关卡 - `4` 运行状态：知识库/备份/沉淀日志 - `5` 回收站：恢复、彻底删除 - `6` 设置：开关、主题 - `Enter` 读卡器 - `/` 搜索 - `?` 帮助 静态预览单页： ```bash node dsh-tui-plugin/demo.mjs --once --no-color node dsh-tui-plugin/demo.mjs --once --no-color --screen=library node dsh-tui-plugin/demo.mjs --once --no-color --screen=settings node dsh-tui-plugin/demo.mjs --once --no-color --screen=audit --select-all node dsh-tui-plugin/demo.mjs --once --no-color --screen=reader node dsh-tui-plugin/demo.mjs --once --no-color --screen=reader --scroll=60 ``` 按键： - `1–6` 切换页面 - `Tab` 循环页面 - `↑↓` / `j k` 移动 - `←→` / `t` 切换类型 - `Enter` 读卡 / 切换设置 - `L` 直接打开长文读卡器；`j/k` 滚动，`PgUp/PgDn` 翻页，`g/G` 首尾 实时数据模式： ```bash # 只读：读取真实待审卡和正文 node dsh-tui-plugin/demo.mjs --live # 写入：允许真实批准 / 驳回，谨慎使用 node dsh-tui-plugin/demo.mjs --live --write ``` 实时模式默认走 `http://127.0.0.1:7999/memory-eternal/api`，可用 `MEMORY_ETERNAL_API` 覆盖。API 不可用时自动回退到示例数据。 - `Space` 多选 / 切换设置 - `s` 或 `Ctrl+A` 全选 / 反选 - `a` 批准，`r` 驳回（都先进入二次确认：`Enter` 才提交，`Esc` 取消；驳回确认态里可直接输入理由） - 回收站：`r` 恢复，`d` 彻底删除 - `/` 搜索，`Esc` 返回 / 清空 - `?` 帮助，`q` 退出 每个页面的底部快捷键会随当前页面更新，例如待审页显示全选/批驳，设置页显示切换，回收站显示恢复/删除。 `demo-audit.mjs` 保留为纯审核页备份。 ## 安装 在 `memory-eternal` 仓库根目录： ```bash # 本地 profile（推荐先用这个验证） dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add ./dsh-tui-plugin ``` 或手动： 1. 把本目录复制到 dsh-TUI profile 的 node_modules； 2. 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中加入： ```yaml - insert: - id: memory-eternal-tui name: 'memory-eternal-tui' ``` 3. 重启 dsh-TUI。 ## 使用 ```text /memory ``` - 优先执行 `dsh-memory open`（确保 7999 存活 + 打开浏览器） - 找不到 CLI 时直接打开 `http://127.0.0.1:7999/` - 不会在 TUI 内嵌 WebView，也不复制第二套 UI - 审批仍在 Web 里由人完成，不新增 agent 工具 ## `/audit` 审核闭环（issue #50） 装到 dsh-tui 之后，输入 `/audit` 打开原生审核场景（或 `/memory` 打开 Web 版）。 两者用的是**同一份数据**：待审队列来自 `GET /cards?status=pending&limit=300`，批准/驳回走 `POST /audit/approve`、`POST /audit/reject`，最终都落到 `setCardStatus()` + `audit_log`， 不新增 agent 工具、不绕过审核守卫。 ### 判词面板：先看 `reason` 右侧面板按顺序显示：`kind · 时间 · 来源 · 严重度` → `依据：` → 兜底标记 → 标题/摘要。 `reason` 由卡片 DB 的 `reason` 字段带出（`/cards` 已返回），常见值： | reason | 含义 | 审核建议 | | --- | --- | --- | | `AI 自动沉淀（蒸馏卡）` | LLM 蒸馏出的知识卡 | 正常审 | | `AI 自动沉淀（原文卡）` | **蒸馏失败/不可用时的降级原文卡** | 优先复核，多数可驳回 | | `手动创建` | `/write` 手动写入 | 正常审 | | `多卡合并` | 优化合并产生 | 正常审 | - 兜底原文卡额外显示 `⚠ 蒸馏兜底原文卡（无 LLM 精炼，优先复核）`； - 没有 `reason` 的卡片不显示该行（不留空行）； - `severity` 为默认值 `info` 时不显示，非默认值（如 `warning`）才出现在第一行。 ### 键位 | 键 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `↑` / `↓` | 移动选中项（列表窗口跟着走，标题显示当前屏 `起-止/总数`） | | `Space` | 多选 / 取消选中当前卡 | | `s` / `Ctrl+A` | 全选 / 全不选 | | `a` | 进入**批准确认态**（底栏：`确认批准 N 张？Enter 确认 / Esc 取消`） | | `r` | 进入**驳回确认态**并输入理由（底栏：`驳回 N 张 · 理由（可空）：… Enter 确认 / Esc 取消`） | | `Enter` | 确认态下提交（驳回时把输入的理由一起提交，批量驳回共用同一理由） | | `Esc` | 确认态：取消回列表；列表：退出场景 | | 其他可见字符 | 仅驳回确认态：拼进理由（可空；上限 120 字） | 确认目标在进入确认态时**冻结**：确认期间列表/选择变化不会改变这次提交的对象； 提交失败会留在确认态，排好网络/权限后可直接 `Enter` 重试。 ### 驳回理由写到哪 `POST /audit/reject` 现在接受可选 `reason`（JSON body 或 query）： ```js // body: { path, reason? } 或 GET /audit/reject?path=...&reason=... await setCardStatus(vaultRoot, rel, 'rejected', { changedBy: 'user', reason }) ``` - 有理由 → 写进 `audit_log.reason`（`changed_by='user'`）； - 不传理由 → `reason` 仍是空串，状态流转与以前一致（唯一区别是 `changed_by` 从默认 `'system'` 变成 `'user'`，因为这是人点的）； - 响应里回显 `reason`，方便调用方自检。 ### 本机没有 dsh-tui 宿主时 本插件只做 dsh-tui 宿主注册（`tuiPluginHost` / `tuiScenes`）。没有宿主时 `/audit` 不会被加载， 能用的是仓库里的 TUI 原型（`node dsh-tui-plugin/demo.mjs --live`）。 纯函数（`cardMeta` / `reasonLine` / `reasonFlag` / `positionLabel` / `confirmLabel` / `auditPayload`） 可以在没有宿主的环境里直接被 `tests/tui-audit-scene.test.mjs` 验证。 ## 要求 - `memory-eternal` 已安装在当前机器 - 终端能执行 `dsh-memory`（否则走 URL 兜底） - dsh-TUI >= 0.9.0（commands seam） # 🧠 memory-eternal — a second brain for your AI [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/EternalNight996/memory-eternal?style=flat)](https://github.com/EternalNight996/memory-eternal/stargazers) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/memory-eternal)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/memory-eternal) [![release](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-v0.17.0-FF7A45)](https://github.com/EternalNight996/memory-eternal/releases) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) **English (default)** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

▲ 20-second tour — review queue · token ledger · knowledge graph · live demo

> **Your AI forgets every session. Give it a memory it can trust.** > > Local-first, review-gated, measurable — one SQLite vault shared by DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any MCP client. - 🔍 **Review before it counts** — new cards wait in a review queue; approve or reject from the Web UI or terminal; every change is written to an immutable audit log. - 🧾 **Token ledger** — see how much recall injected, how many distillation calls ran, and how often recall was actually useful. - 🏠 **Local-first, no cloud** — SQLite + Markdown on your own disk. No third-party memory framework, no account, no outbound calls.

⭐ If it saves you from explaining the same context again, a star helps a lot.
DSH one-liner: dsh plugin --profile desktop add memory-eternal

## ⚡ Quick start **DeepSeek Harness (desktop / web)** ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add memory-eternal # reopen DSH → sidebar "Memory" ``` **Claude Code, Codex or Cursor — same vault via MCP** ```bash npm i -g memory-eternal dsh-memory connect claude # or: codex / cursor ``` **Any MCP client** ```bash npx -y -p memory-eternal dsh-memory mcp ``` **Browser or terminal** ```bash dsh-memory open # http://127.0.0.1:7999 npx -y -p memory-eternal dsh-memory tui # live queue in the terminal ``` ## 🧾 Does it actually save tokens? 安装插件 跟着视频一次装好插件并重启生效。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3332e166-ecdc-4a3a-877b-154a2614dd03 1. 跑 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-opencode-palette` 把插件装进你的 profile。 2. 重启 DSH（或刷新浏览器页面）。 3. 打开「OpenCode调色板」，确认面板能打开。
---
设置字体字号 分清等宽与常规两种字体，字号 11–24 px 随手调。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f6c17168-5b39-4a12-bf9b-f819db681055 1. 打开设置面板，找到字体与字号两处。 2. 等宽把整个界面换成等宽字，常规只让代码块用等宽。 3. 字号在 11–24 px 之间拖到看着舒服为止。
---
选择主题 一键挑中喜欢的主题，界面立即换装。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b425fed9-1aab-43c3-ab70-726de38a9c1a 1. 打开「OpenCode调色板」，按色系浏览 38 款配色。 2. 点中喜欢的那一款，界面立即换装。 3. 不满意再点另一款，随时可换。
---
新增自定义主题 37 个颜色逐个调，右边预览实时联动，存成专属胶囊。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/349dba7f-4cdb-4281-b71c-c39c6f9dfccd 1. 点新增，37 个颜色逐个调，右边预览实时联动。 2. 点预览里的元素，左边对应那行会滚到中间并打开取色器。 3. 存好后胶囊落在 `/opencode-palette/custom-themes/` 里。
---
编辑自定义主题 回来改存好的胶囊，改完界面即时换上新配色。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4ff48986-142f-404b-bb1b-70d948d95ba8 1. 打开存好的自定义主题，进编辑。 2. 改要动的颜色，预览里即时看效果。 3. 保存，界面即时换上新的配色。
---
删除自定义主题 删掉不想要的胶囊，删前确认，删后可以重建。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5f2e42bb-7e5b-4bf2-b61a-600df5e47ba2 1. 选中不想要的自定义主题，点删除。 2. 确认删除，胶囊从列表里消失。 3. 后悔了照新增那条重建一个。
---
AI 编辑自定义主题 一句话让 AI 改色，不用逐个手调。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/542f3083-eb7e-4b60-8d1a-a142ef9a87e9 1. 打开自定义主题的 AI 编辑入口。 2. 一句话说清想要的配色，比如“暖一点的暗色”。 3. 看预览，满意就保存，不满意再说一句。

EXTENSIONS
OpenCode 主题之外提供的功能

| 能力 | 说明 | |---|---| | **IP 主题胶囊** | 预置 25 套：原神、库洛米、哆啦A梦、哈利波特、赛博朋克2077、宝可梦、龙珠……开箱即用，挑一套喜欢的当配色基底直接用。 | | **打造专属胶囊** | 37 个颜色逐个调，右边是微缩的 DSH 预览：点预览里的元素，左边对应那行会滚到中间并打开取色器；鼠标划过左边的颜色，右边预览里那个元素会亮起一圈。存好的胶囊落在 `/opencode-palette/custom-themes/`。 | | **字体与字号** | 字体独立于颜色：等宽（终端风）把整个界面换成等宽字，常规（界面风）只让代码块用等宽；字号 11–24 px，代码字体可以直接从本机已装字体里挑。 |

UPGRADE
升级

```bash # 升级到最新版（当前 2.1.10）：web 与 desktop 两个 profile 各跑一条 dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-opencode-palette dsh plugin --profile desktop update dsh-opencode-palette # 需要钉回指定版本（把版本号换成你要的）： dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-opencode-palette@2.1.10 dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-opencode-palette@2.1.10 ``` 「设置 → 插件 → OpenCode调色板」 → **检查更新**

MORE
作者的其他作品

喜欢这个插件的话，这几个你可能也用得上： **[dsh-prompt](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-prompt)** —— 经常反复重复的模板化提示词，存成自定义模板，选中后直接注入，不再需要耗费精力。 **[dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck)** —— 近 30 万 star 的 mattpocock/skills 整套预置好（27 个技能），装好即用。 **[dsh-im-companion](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-im-companion)** —— 给 dsh-im 加了「助理」和「家」的概念。 **[ilife](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/ilife)** —— 爱生活：居家生活套件，记账、运动、饮食、体重、食谱、物品管理、作息规划、备忘录等。⚠️建设中⚠️待正式发布

THANKS
感谢贡献者

感谢每一位提交 Issue、PR 与参与讨论的朋友，是你们让这个插件一点点变好。 | 贡献者 | 致敬 | 贡献 | | --- | --- | --- | | [@oopsdoes](https://github.com/oopsdoes) | 🌹🌹 | [#46](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette/issues/46) [#55](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette/issues/55) | | [@insp63](https://github.com/insp63) | 🌹 | [#124](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette/issues/124) | | [@gitwch1](https://github.com/gitwch1) | 🌹 | [#73](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette/issues/73) | | [@anci3ntr0ck](https://github.com/anci3ntr0ck) | 🌹 | [#73](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette/issues/73) | | [@SRKBob](https://github.com/SRKBob) | 🌹 | [#43](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette/issues/43) | | [@anupamme](https://github.com/anupamme) | 🌹 | [#32](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette/pull/32) | | [@Number444](https://github.com/Number444) | 🌹 | [#12](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette/issues/12) | | [@xiSage](https://github.com/xiSage) | 🌹 | [#11](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette/issues/11) | | [@the-beating-light-of-the-nail](https://github.com/the-beating-light-of-the-nail) | 🌹 | [#3](https://github.com/FeatherHunter/dsh-opencode-palette/issues/3) | 也感谢在评论区与讨论区留下想法的每一位朋友。如果你也遇到了问题或有新想法，欢迎直接提 Issue 或发起讨论。

# dsh-custom-css


设置行里的 CSS 编辑器：写完即生效，样式表就是磁盘上的 .css 文件







拾取元素 · 查找 · 文件下拉 · 更多操作，把 ~/.dsh/custom-css/ 下的样式表注入界面 ——
编辑器照 DevTools 的 Styles 标签页做：行号 gutter、语法高亮、键入补全、规则面板、格式校验、撤销重做、查找替换；
拾取器在界面里点选一个元素，直接给出跨版本尽量稳的选择器，并把它实际生效的令牌写成声明；
壁纸不用写 CSS：选一张本机图片即可，界面透明与明暗都由它自己调（插件详情页里那一节）。
DSH Web GUI 扩展：在 **设置 → 通用** 的「外观」下方增加一行 **自定义 CSS** —— 样式表以普通 `.css` 文件保存在宿主磁盘上，写进去即时应用到整个界面。 - npm：[`dsh-custom-css`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-custom-css)（2026-09-13 首发，当前版本见上方徽章） - 收录：[dshfind 插件超市 → 皮肤主题](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/FOX4096/dsh-custom-css)（徽章与展示卡由 dshfind 提供，`/api/badge` 与 `/api/card`） - 兼容：DSH `0.1.2-rc.1` ~ `0.2.0-rc.2` 已真机验证；接口契约断言覆盖 `0.0.1-rc.1` ~ `0.2.1-rc.3`（共 37 个版本）；`npm run compat` 可复跑（见「兼容性」） - 许可：MIT - 形态：DSH profile 插件（host 半 + 浏览器半），无构建步骤，`lib/*.js` 即产物
dshfind 展示卡（440×200） [![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/card/FOX4096/dsh-custom-css?lang=zh)](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/FOX4096/dsh-custom-css?ref=badge)
--- ## 装 **前置**：DSH `0.1.2-rc.1` ~ `0.2.0-rc.2`（**已真机验证**；接口契约断言覆盖 `0.0.1-rc.1` ~ `0.2.1-rc.3`，见「兼容性」），Node.js ≥ 20、pnpm ≥ 10。 ```bash # 1) 装进 profile dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-custom-css # 2) 让它真的被加载：把包名加进 profiles/web/package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles # "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ ..., "dsh-custom-css" ] } } # 3) 重启 GUI（重开会话不够，进程内模块缓存是旧的） ``` **两步缺一不可**：只装不列进 `bundles` → 那一行不出现且没有报错；只写 `bundles` 不装 → 启动直接失败。 装完打开 **设置 → 通用**，滚到「外观」下方的 **自定义 CSS**，写： ```css [data-dockkit-strip] { background-color: var(--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1); border-radius: var(--dsw-radius-sm); } ``` 不想抄类名就点 **[拾取元素]** 在界面里点你要的东西。 - 换 GitHub 源、本机 `link:` 开发安装、卸载、换版本 → [安装](./docs/install.md) - **装错了**：每个症状对应哪一步漏了 → [安装 · 装错了](./docs/install.md#装错了症状与原因) ## 文档 按「想做什么」找，完整索引在 [`docs/index.md`](./docs/index.md)。 | 我在… | 看这些 | | --- | --- | | **刚装上** | [安装](./docs/install.md) · [三分钟上手](./docs/getting-started.md) · [已知坑](./docs/known-issues.md) | | **换张背景图（不写 CSS）** | [自定义壁纸](./docs/wallpaper.md) —— 入口在插件详情页里 | | **写样式** | [编辑器](./docs/editor.md) · [元素拾取器](./docs/picker.md) · [规则面板](./docs/rule-panel.md) · [格式校验](./docs/validation.md) · [控件](./docs/controls.md) | | **改插件** | [开发](./docs/development.md) · [UI 组件库](./docs/ui-kit.md) · [测试与巡检](./docs/testing.md) · [设计一致性](./docs/design-tokens.md) · [仓库结构](./docs/repo-map.md) · [命名表](./docs/naming.md) | | **排查问题** | [已知坑与已知限制](./docs/known-issues.md) · [兼容性](./docs/compat.md) · [host 侧文件接口](./docs/api-host.md) | | **等新功能** | [预览块（规划中）](./docs/preview.md) | 另有可直接导入的示例：[`examples/acrylic.css`](./examples/acrylic.css) —— 完整的亚克力皮肤（渐变壁纸 + 玻璃面板 + 背景模糊）； 想学怎么写就看 [`examples/showcase.css`](./examples/showcase.css)（60 行的最小示例）。 两者都由 [`examples/README.md`](./examples/README.md) 导览。 ## 兼容性 插件与 DSH 的耦合面是刻意做窄的，所以它跨版本比多数插件活得久：**浏览器半在运行时一个 `@deepseek-ai/*` 模块都不 require**（只通过 `dsh.client.inject` 声明可用 id、并从 Context 取 `slots` 服务），host 半只挂 HTTP 路由。真正依赖的平台契约只有四条，全部记在 [`compat.json`](./compat.json)，由 `npm run compat` 逐个版本断言： | 契约点 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | 槽位 | `settings.general.item`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-general` 里 `GeneralSection` 渲染的那个 seat） | | 声明的模块 id | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-general` | | 需要的服务 | 仅 `slots` | | 运行时 require | 零 | ### 验证矩阵 | DSH 版本 | 验证方式 | 结论 | | --- | --- | --- | | `0.2.0-rc.2` | 真机运行：本机日常在用的实例（生产 profile `web`，插件以 `link:` 装入并实际渲染设置行）。实测 host 路由 `GET /list`、`GET /read`、`GET /history` 全部 200，返回的正是磁盘上的样式表与历史快照 | 通过 | | `0.1.5-rc.1` | 真机运行（本仓库开发环境） | 通过 | | `0.1.2-rc.1` | 真机运行：独立 `DSH_HOME` 起实例，`/dsh-custom-css/list`、`/write`、`/read` 全部 200 且文件确实落盘 | 通过 | | `0.0.1-rc.1` ~ `0.2.1-rc.3`（共 37 个） | 接口契约断言（`npm run compat` 解包该版本的 settings 包，核对槽位与 id） | 通过 | `npm run compat` 需要网络（要拉各版本的包），所以本地 `npm test` 保持离线可跑；CI 里单跑一档。 上表由 `npm run compat:update` 自动维护（GitHub Actions 每 6 小时检查一次 DSH 是否更新，有新版本就重新断言并提交这一节）。**上次核对：2026-10-24，当时最新已发布版本 `0.2.1-rc.3`。** > **换代时的两种失效模式怎么判别**（症状完全不同）：见 [兼容性](./docs/compat.md#两种失效模式的判别)。 ## 已知限制 - 只能**追加** CSS，不能修改内置样式表本身。 - 规则面板只认**顶层**样式规则（`@media` 里的规则照常生效，只是面板编辑不到）。 - 拾取器只能拾取**当前文档**里的元素，跨域 iframe 里拾取不到。 - 壁纸一次只挂**一张**图；来源二选一 —— **上传本机文件**（≤ 32 MiB），或**贴一个 URL** （`https://` / `file:///` / `data:image/…`，不下载、直接引用）。它自己会做界面透明，但皮肤若也设了 那几个 `--dsw-alias-bg-*` 令牌，**皮肤优先**（面板会说明）。 另外五条（含 host 接口不可达时的降级行为、令牌建议为什么可能一个都不给） 在 [已知坑与已知限制](./docs/known-issues.md)。 ## 参与 - 想改代码：[CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)（本地跑起来、硬约束、发版流程） - 想知道内部怎么转：[开发](./docs/development.md) · [测试与巡检](./docs/testing.md) - 想直接看效果：[`examples/acrylic.css`](./examples/acrylic.css)（亚克力皮肤） · [`examples/showcase.css`](./examples/showcase.css)（最小示例） - 安全问题：见 [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) 的私密渠道 改动记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

# DSH trace waterfall

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that replaces the trajectory view with a trace waterfall inspired by [Kobra](https://kobra.systems/components/trace-waterfall). The presentation is independently implemented; no Kobra code or assets are included.

- Turn rows show model, tool, waiting, handoff, and failed activity as one segmented bar.
- A three-lane overview (input / model / tools) supports drag-to-zoom; long idle gaps collapse into axis breaks, and any turn can be focused.
- Model bars split time to first token from decoding.
- Click a row or bar for an anchored summary, then open full details for complete input, output, timing, and metadata.

## Screenshots

![Expanded session in the light theme](docs/screenshots/light-expanded.png)

![Expanded session in the dark theme](docs/screenshots/dark-expanded.png)

![Multi-turn overview with a compressed idle gap](docs/screenshots/multi-turn-overview.png)

![Focused turn with teammate handoffs](docs/screenshots/focused-turn.png)

![Anchored span summary](docs/screenshots/popover.png)

## Install

Requires Node 24.9+ and pnpm 11 on `PATH` (`dsh plugin` uses pnpm; pnpm 10 fails with `ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT`). Targets DSH **0.2.1-rc.3**; DSH's plugin APIs are pre-stable.

Install from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:greatv/dsh-trace-waterfall
```

The bundle's `cordis.patch.yml` disables `ui-trajectory` and adds `trace-waterfall`. The view ID stays `trajectory`, so existing view preferences and tool-inspection links keep working. Restart DSH Web or reload the browser after installing.

To update to the latest commit, run the same `add` command again.

To restore DSH's original trace:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-trace-waterfall
```

Do not enable both trajectory providers at once; they own the same view.

## Develop

Requires a built DeepSeek Harness checkout.

```sh
npm ci
npm run link:dsh -- ../deepseek-harness
npm run build
npm test
```

`link:dsh` links the local DSH packages and generates TypeScript paths; rerun it after reinstalling dependencies or switching checkouts.

The built `lib/` is committed so that GitHub installs need no build step. Run `npm run build` and commit `lib/` together with source changes.

To install a local checkout instead of the GitHub version, run `dsh plugin --profile web add .` from this directory.

To try the plugin without installing it, run from the DSH repository:

```sh
pnpm dsh --patch ../dsh-trace-waterfall/cordis.source.patch.yml --no-open
```

For a preview with deterministic test data:

```sh
node scripts/build-preview.mjs
python3 -m http.server 3468 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory .local/preview
```

## Usage

- **Zoom**: drag across the overview to select a range; double-click to reset. The target icon on a turn focuses it.
- **Search**: Ctrl/Cmd+F. Matches in names, arguments, prompts, and outputs are highlighted.
- **Errors only**: lists failed operations with their parent context. A recovered failure adds an error badge to its turn instead of marking the whole turn red.
- **Escape** closes the summary or details, or clears filters.

## Notes

- Total tokens = uncached input + cache-read input + cache-write input + output, matching the DSH status bar. Cache hit rate is cache-read input divided by all input.
- Idle gaps longer than 60 seconds are compressed; recorded durations are unchanged.
- Independent child-agent sessions are not merged into the parent trace.
- Cost is not shown, since recorded traces carry no authoritative pricing.
- The plugin is presentation-only: it adds no tools, changes no agent behavior, and sends no telemetry.

## License

The adapter modules derive from DSH's MIT-licensed trajectory implementation. See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

The patch replaces the official trajectory view with a native slot/event renderer; no external network or install lifecycle hook was observed. Node at least 24.9 is required. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# dsh-audit-skills

**DeepSeek Harness（DSH）专用的技能 / 插件审查插件。**

上游 [`skills-summarize-audit`](https://github.com/gtbwpkwjnb-alt/skills-summarize-audit-skill) v9.2.2 是跨平台（Codex / ZCode / Claude Code）审计技能。
本插件把它**收敛为 DSH 单平台**，并把「插件页中文化」提升为主能力。

MIT License · © 2026 ZCode（上游）· DSH 适配部分同许可发布。

---

## 安装

DSH 的 `desktop` / `web` profile 由插件管理器托管：

```bash
# 官方 profile（web 等）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:gtbwpkwjnb-alt/dsh-audit-skills

# 应用托管的 desktop profile：在侧边栏 Plugins 页粘贴
github:gtbwpkwjnb-alt/dsh-audit-skills
```

安装后 **重启 DSH**：侧边栏 **Plugins 页**出现 `dsh-audit-skills（插件审查）` 卡片，
卡片上的开关就是效果开关——**启用即应用精炼，停用即还原**。

> v1.1.0 起本插件是**纯插件形态**（不再注册 skill）。
>
> **v1.4.0 —— 新装插件识别 · 按钮稳定性 · 版本监控与一键更新。**
> 状态表改用第一方 `pluginManager.listBundles()` 作数据源（与插件页同源）；
> slot 注册改为 `ctx.inject(['slots'])` 等待服务就绪；新增「检查更新」与逐行「更新」按钮，
> 更新经第一方插件管理器执行（自带锁与回滚），不自行跑 pnpm。
>
> **v1.3.2 —— 修复「插件页慢一拍」。** 此前 `revertOnDisable` 默认 true，退出 DSH 时会把
> `package.json` 的 `./locale/*.json` 导出撤掉，下次启动宿主在读取元数据之后（+1s）才等到本插件重写，
> 导致插件页永远落后一轮。现已默认不还原（需要还原请用设置页的「还原翻译」按钮），并改为幂等写入。
>
> **v1.3.1 —— 修复 locale 导出键 / 新装插件 / 设置页口径。**
>
> DSH 要求 exports 用 **`./locale/*.json`**（`./locale/*` 无效）；本插件会自动迁移旧键。
> 状态表改为**动态发现已装 bundle**，新装插件自动现身并标「待补文案」。
>
> **v1.3.0 —— UI 半体以正确格式回归。** 关键：DSH 客户端必须是**无顶层 import 的传统脚本**
> （`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory: (require) => ... })`），不是裸 ESM，也**不需要打包器**。
>
> ⚠️ **v1.2.1 事故（已修复）**：v1.2.0 发的是裸 ESM，被按传统脚本加载 →
> `Cannot use import statement outside a module` → `web boot: 1 entry did not activate` → **GUI 起不来**。
> 复盘见 [docs/incident-web-boot-crash.md](docs/incident-web-boot-crash.md)。
> 此后**任何客户端改动都必须先过** `scripts/preflight-client.mjs`（以传统脚本方式执行 + exports 契约校验）。
>
> **当前可用能力（宿主半体，已本机实测）**：启用本插件即自动把已装插件的插件页说明精炼为中文；
> **新装插件后停用再启用本插件**（或重启 DSH）即会自动补上，无需重装。
> 开启/关闭开关就是效果开关：关闭即还原。

---

## 五项能力

| # | 能力 | 触发 | 产物 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 一 | 技能库翻译精炼 | 技能翻译精炼 / 描述精炼 | 中文候选、真实来源与质量状态 |
| 二 | 项目画像 | 项目画像 / 项目审查 | 技术栈、项目类型、扫描边界与缺口 |
| 三 | 技能/插件推荐 | 技能审查 / 插件推荐 | 已装工具优化、同类比较、带证据的下一步 |
| 四 | **插件页中文化落地** | 插件页翻译 / 插件中文化 | 写入 `<pkg>/locale/{en,zh}.json`，插件页显示精炼中文 |
| 五 | **市场按需检索** | 找插件 / 需求检索 | 真 DSH bundle 的兼容/成本/冲突对比 |
| 六 | **插件与技能状态维护** | 设置页 → 插件 / 技能主表 | 在同一张表内查看翻译、作用、来源、版本、更新与审查；更新、翻译和还原均从对象行执行 |

### 关键约定：插件名保留原文

DSH 插件页的标题来自 `locale/<lang>.json` 的 `meta.title`，**一旦写成中文就再也认不出是哪个插件**。
因此本插件强制：

```json
// locale/zh.json
{ "meta": {
    "title": "dsh-free-search（免费搜索）",
    "description": "接管内置 web_search：13 个引擎自动降级，默认免 API key……只负责搜索，不接管网页抓取。"
} }
```

- `title` = **原包名（英文代码名）** + 全角括号中文名
- `description` **按语言直接替换**为精炼文案，写明「做什么 / 不做什么」

---

## 脚本

### `scripts/render-smoke.mjs` — 渲染冒烟（合成夹具 + 可选真实快照）

```bash
node scripts/render-smoke.mjs          # 合成夹具（进闸门，结果确定）
node scripts/render-smoke.mjs --live   # 用 DSH 真实进程返回的 /updates 渲染真客户端（端到端证据）
```

`--live` 把线上真正的插件行灌进同一个真客户端并断言渲染文本：桥接不可达时 SKIP，不阻塞闸门。
没有浏览器时，这是「列表到底显示成什么样」最硬的证据。

### `scripts/build-client-catalog.mjs` — 内置 catalog 中文快照注入

```bash
node scripts/build-client-catalog.mjs          # 改完 references/dsh-plugin-locale-catalog.json 后重新注入
node scripts/build-client-catalog.mjs --check  # 漂移校验（regression 里也逐条比对）
```

宿主 <2.9 的插件行**不发** `displayName`/`localizedDescription`（2.8.0 里 `displayName` 只在技能行），
所以客户端半体内联这份仓库内置 catalog 的中文快照，刷新即可显示中文名与中文说明。

### `scripts/dsh_plugin_locale.mjs` — 插件页中文化落地

```bash
node scripts/dsh_plugin_locale.mjs --check      # 只读巡检
node scripts/dsh_plugin_locale.mjs --apply      # 写入 locale 文件并补 exports
node scripts/dsh_plugin_locale.mjs --restore    # 从 *.dsh-locale.bak 还原
node scripts/dsh_plugin_locale.mjs --profile <profileDir>
```

文案来源：`references/dsh-plugin-locale-catalog.json`。幂等；写前自动备份。

**机制**（已核实 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` `readPluginMeta()`）：DSH 读
`<pkg>/locale/en.json`（英语资源，同时定义同目录语言文件集合）的 `meta.title` / `meta.description`；
缺失才回落 `package.json.name` / `description`。该路径**经包 specifier 解析**，
所以有 `exports` 的包必须导出 `./locale/*`，否则读不到——脚本会自动补上。

### `scripts/dsh_market_search.mjs` — 市场按需检索

```bash
node scripts/dsh_market_search.mjs --need 记忆 --need 搜索 --limit 8
node scripts/dsh_market_search.mjs --need 语音转写 --json
```

只保留**真 DSH bundle**（`package.json` 含 `dsh.bundle.patch`），输出兼容判定 / 许可 /
发布日 / 是否已装启用 / 仓库。需求→关键词映射见 `references/dsh-market-needs.md`。

---

## 范围收敛

`config.yaml`：

```yaml
platform_scope:
  default: "dsh"
  exclude_other_platforms: true
```

- `scan_paths`：4 条，全部 DSH 相关（用户技能根、内置 office 技能、profile 插件、本地化目录）
- `excluded_scan_paths`：8 条（Codex / ZCode / Claude Code），**默认不计入** DSH 的健康度、评分与推荐

DSH 技能根的发现规则：只扫描根**顶层**的 `<name>/SKILL.md` 或 `<name>.md`，
嵌套 `**/SKILL.md` 不发现；六档优先级 100 project-dsh → 600 bundled。

---

## 已知边界

完整优化记录与下一阶段路线见 [docs/optimization-roadmap.md](docs/optimization-roadmap.md)。

- 上游的 `scripts/audit_skill_plugin_issues.py` 仍以 Codex 侧来源为主，且 `config.yaml`
  不参与脚本消费。**脚本级 DSH 采集分支尚未实现**，当前收敛作用于 Agent 行为层。
- 插件页本地化写在 `node_modules` 内，**插件升级 / 重装后会丢失**，重新执行
  `dsh_plugin_locale.mjs --apply` 即可恢复。
- 插件管理能力不再单独占用“治理中心”页面；状态、翻译、版本更新与审查统一回到插件 / 技能主表，避免重复对象列表。安装、启停和卸载仍只调用 DSH 第一方 `pluginManager`，由宿主能力决定是否显示。
- 技能的应用与还原会保留 `.dsh-skill.backup`；随 DSH 提供且没有可写路径的技能只展示来源与状态，不执行写入。
- 所有写操作都有明确的进行中、完成、失败和需要重启反馈；失败结果会带下一步处理建议。

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # dsh-plugin-control-your-schedule · 纸屿 > 把便签、纸页笔记、日历待办、画纸和常用提示词，装进 DeepSeek Harness 的左侧栏。 > 纸面风格的个人工作台：数据保存在本机，不联网。 [![ci](https://github.com/HaoyanZhang123/dsh-plugin-control-your-schedule/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/HaoyanZhang123/dsh-plugin-control-your-schedule/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/HaoyanZhang123/dsh-plugin-control-your-schedule)](https://github.com/HaoyanZhang123/dsh-plugin-control-your-schedule/releases) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-control-your-schedule)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-control-your-schedule) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) 当前版本 **0.4.0** · 开发依据 DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** · Windows 实测，macOS / Linux 由 CI 构建与静态门禁覆盖 | 语言：[English](README.en.md) ## 功能 - **便签**：短句速记，自动保存；**整张纸都能拖着走**（正文、滚动条、色块、删除键除外），最后碰过的那张永远在最上面。正文默认使用内置**霞鹜文楷**手写体，可在设置里换成系统行楷或纸张宋体。 - **废纸篓**：删掉的便签不弹「撤销」提示，而是进便签窗口顶部的废纸篓，**留 7 天**，随时放回去；空便签直接丢弃。 - **纸页笔记**：长文写作，左侧列表搜索/切换，自动保存。新纸页的标题像正文一样是 placeholder，不写字不会留下一行「未命名纸页」。 - **日历与待办**：每件事有**四档紧急程度**（重要且紧急 / 重要但不紧急 / 紧急但不重要 / 不紧急也不重要），**在待办行右侧就地切换**：点色点弹出四档选择（选中即生效），点旁边的胶囊在「仅今日 / 每天」之间切换，都不用进详情。 - **日历圆点**：未完成的点在上、按档位着色；**完成的点沉到格子底部并变灰**，位置固定不换位。 - **持久待办**：选「每天」后，从锚定日起**每天出现一条当前实例**，今天打卡后第二天自动长出一条未完成的新实例；日历上只留真正打过卡的日子（灰点），未来不铺。勾完当天会出现「这件事算结束了」，收起后不再长新实例、随时可恢复，并显示「打卡 N 天」。 - **提示词库**：应用坞第 5 个应用。左列表搜索、置顶优先；右编辑器写标题与多行正文，自动保存。正文上限 20000 字，最多 300 条。新建/复制一条/置顶/删除，删除有确认。 - **对话里随取随用**：每个对话输入框工具行左侧有一个「提示词」小按钮，点开上方弹出列表，↑↓ 选择、Enter 填入、Esc 关闭。**只填进草稿**：草稿为空时整段填入，非空时插到光标处（单步可撤销），输入框正在发送会提示稍后再试。不写系统提示词、不自动发送。点「在便签里管理 ↗」会切到纸屿并打开提示词窗口。 - **安静的界面**：不弹浮层提示；没有信息的状态行不占位。 - **画纸**：手写/绘画，支持撤销、橡皮、导出 PNG；画纸簿可左右翻页，也能整张删掉。 - **固定右侧栏**：今日纸签始终在右侧，窗口只在左侧工作区活动，不会被遮住。 - **底部应用坞**：所有应用的唯一入口；点图标打开/收起窗口；**图标可以拖动排序**（聚焦后按 `Alt + ←/→` 也能挪，顺序会记住；设置 → 外观 →「恢复默认」还原）；最右边的房子按钮一键收好全部窗口，再点一次恢复。 - **点桌面收好**：点击窗口外的空白桌面，也会把全部窗口收进应用坞（不销毁窗口，点图标可恢复）。 - **命令与应用**：设置左栏第一项，`Ctrl/Cmd + K` 直达。搜索应用、纸页或动作，`↑↓` 选择、`Enter` 执行；打开别的窗口后设置会自动收起，不挡路。 - **纯净窗口**：没有最小化/最大化/关闭三件套；拖标题栏移动，拖右下角缩放。关闭当前窗口用 `Esc`、`Ctrl/Cmd + Alt + W`，或「设置 → 命令与应用 → 关闭当前窗口」。 - **新手导览**：首次打开自动播放 6 步导览；可在「设置 → 快捷键 → 新手导览」重播。 - **数据备份**：设置 → 数据与备份，导出/导入完整工作区 JSON。 - **配色跟 DSH 一致**：桌面、窗口、浮层、凹槽这些大色块直接用宿主自己的颜色，文字按 DSH 的 label 阶梯取；**跟随 DSH**（默认，宿主切深色时面板实时跟着变，不用刷新）/ 浅色 / 深色三档可选。插件只读宿主主题信号，不写宿主 DOM，和别的皮肤插件不冲突。 - **深色是重做过的**：深色下去掉纸纹噪点，桌面比窗口暗一档、浮层再亮一档；便签纸保留自己的颜色但提亮了明度，不再糊成一片。 - **纸纹可关**：设置 → 外观 →「纸纹」。关掉是纯色底，打开有极细的纸颗粒。 - **升级不丢数据**：工作区带版本号与迁移阶梯，v1 → v2 → v3 自动升级（v3 新增提示词库，只做加法）；Host 在写盘前会把旧版本另存为 `workspace.v<旧版本>.backup.json`，并在每次写入前留一份 `workspace.prev.json`。存储里的工作区若过不了校验，会**只读打开**并另存原稿，绝不拿示例桌面覆盖。 - **切换不丢状态**：切到 DSH 其它界面再回来，窗口、以及每个应用正在看的东西（选中的纸页、日历停在哪天、便签滚到哪、画纸开哪张、设置哪个分区）都会复原。 ## 安装 ### npm（推荐，一行包名） DSH → Plugins → Add plugin，填： ``` dsh-plugin-control-your-schedule ``` 也可以带版本：`dsh-plugin-control-your-schedule@0.4.0`。 ### GitHub（备选，不需要 npm 时） ``` https://github.com/HaoyanZhang123/dsh-plugin-control-your-schedule ``` ### 本地开发 DSH → Plugins → Add plugin，填本目录的**绝对路径**： ``` <仓库路径>/dsh-plugin-control-your-schedule ``` > Add plugin 对本地路径只接受绝对路径；相对路径会被拒绝。 > 已安装的插件不支持自动更新：升级 = 卸载后重装新版。 安装后左侧栏「插件 / 自动化任务」下面会出现「便签」。如果没有出现，刷新页面；替换已安装的包需要重启 DSH。 > npm： ## 使用 | 想做什么 | 怎么做 | |---|---| | 打开应用 | 点底部应用坞的图标，或按 `Ctrl/Cmd + K` 搜一下 | | 收起 / 恢复窗口 | 再点一次应用坞图标 | | 一次收好全部窗口 | 点房子按钮，或点窗口外的空白桌面 | | 关闭当前窗口 | `Esc` / `Ctrl/Cmd + Alt + W` / 设置 → 命令与应用 →「关闭当前窗口」 | | 应用坞换顺序 | 直接拖动图标；或聚焦图标后按 `Alt + ←/→` | | 重看新手导览 | 设置 → 快捷键 → 新手导览 →「重新播放」 | | 备份数据 | 设置 → 数据与备份 →「导出工作区」 | ## 数据存在哪里 - **DSH 数据目录（主存储）**：`$DSH_HOME/control-your-schedule/workspace.json` - Windows 默认：`C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\control-your-schedule\workspace.json` - 如果设置了 `DSH_HOME`，以该目录为准。 - **浏览器缓存（备用）**：IndexedDB / localStorage，用于页面快速启动。 - 换设备时在设置里导出 JSON，再导入即可。 ## 兼容性 - 开发依据：DSH **0.2.1-rc.2**。 - 已在 Windows 11 + DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 实测：安装、侧栏、面板、刷新/切换后数据保持、宿主落盘、导出/导入路径。 - CI 在 **Windows / macOS / Ubuntu** 三个 runner 上执行构建、页面契约、DOM 嵌套、宿主路由与客户端语法检查。 - **未在 macOS / Linux 真机 DSH 上实测**：快捷键标签会自动使用 ⌘/⌥；数据路径使用 `DSH_HOME` 或 `~/.dsh`；没有平台专属二进制。发现问题请提 issue。 - 页面为中文界面；插件列表中的英文名称为 “Sticky”。 ## 开发 ```bash # 构建 client.js（把 assets/paper-os.html 内嵌进客户端包） python tools/build_page.py # 校验产物是否与源码一致（CI 用） python tools/build_page.py --check # 项目门禁（页面契约 + DOM 嵌套 + 构建 + 迁移 + 宿主路由持久化） python smoke/run_all_checks.py # 连真机浏览器一起跑（需要本机有 Edge/Chrome；不加 --cdp 时该套件只算 SKIP，不算通过） python smoke/run_all_checks.py --cdp # 单独跑迁移与真机页面检查 node smoke/migrate_test.mjs node smoke/page_e2e.mjs ``` | 路径 | 作用 | |---|---| | `index.js` | Host 半边：`/api/control-your-schedule/workspace` 读写 DSH 数据目录 | | `src/client.src.js` | Client 半边：侧栏入口、主面板、iframe 桥接 | | `assets/paper-os.html` | 纸屿页面（唯一 UI 源） | | `client.js` | 构建产物，禁止手改 | | `tools/build_page.py` | 构建脚本 | | `smoke/run_all_checks.py` | 项目门禁 | | `smoke/host_route_test.mjs` | Host 持久化路由 + 升级备份 + 字体路由测试 | | `smoke/migrate_test.mjs` | 迁移门禁：v1 快照升 v2 后逐字段比对，含反向用例 | | `smoke/page_e2e.mjs` | 真机页面检查（无头浏览器，90 项断言） | | `assets/fonts/` | 内置手写体子集（霞鹜文楷，OFL）与来源/许可 | ### 设计取舍 - UI 不重写成 React：原页面用同源 iframe 隔离挂载，窗口拖拽、自动保存与键盘交互保持原样。 - 数据双写：页面先写浏览器存储保证即时可用，再通过 `postMessage` → Host 路由落盘到 DSH 数据目录；重开时选择较新的快照。 - 单一加载闸门：Host 快照 / IndexedDB / localStorage / 恢复日志 / 导入文件全部先过 `ingestWorkspace`（迁移阶梯 + 当前版本严格校验），不存在第二条版本比较。 - 持久待办用「模板 + 读时投影」，不物化每日实例：跨天只重绘、零写盘，计数天然「只算一个」。 - 主题只读不写：读宿主 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`，并用 `MutationObserver` 跟着宿主切换实时生效；读不到再退回 `prefers-color-scheme`。 - 颜色取宿主的真实令牌：iframe 不继承父文档的 CSS 变量，所以运行时读 `parent.document.body` 的 `--dsw-alias-*` 写回本页；只有「跟随 DSH」时才吃宿主值，手动选了浅/深色就以插件自己的为准。 - 无第三方运行时依赖；Host 只用 Node 内置模块，构建只用 Python 标准库。字体子集化脚本额外需要 `fonttools`（仅开发期，产物已入库）。 ## 更新日志与许可 - [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) - [Releases](https://github.com/HaoyanZhang123/dsh-plugin-control-your-schedule/releases) - MIT

# HOL Guard: Open-Source Antivirus for AI Agents [![HOL Guard Version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/hol-guard.svg?logo=pypi&logoColor=white&cacheSeconds=300)](https://pypi.org/project/hol-guard/) whole dark logo](https://hol.org/brand/Logo_Whole_Dark.png) | **Stop risky AI actions before they compromise your machine.** HOL Guard is a local-first security layer for AI agents, tools, plugins, skills, MCP servers, and package installs.

[Install HOL Guard](https://hol.org/guard/activate)
[Read the documentation](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/main/docs/guard/get-started.md)
[PyPI Package (`hol-guard`)](https://pypi.org/project/hol-guard/)
[Report an Issue](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/issues) | | :--- | :--- | HOL Guard reviews agent actions before they run: shell commands, file access, package installs, and MCP tool calls. It detects secret exposure, destructive operations, prompt injection, and supply-chain risks, then allows, blocks, or requests approval according to your policy. Run it locally without an account. Use the CLI and local dashboard to manage protection, resolve approvals, and inspect decision history. Optional [Guard Cloud](docs/guard/local-vs-cloud.md) adds shared history, team policy, and fleet management. [Get started](#install-hol-guard) · [Supported agents](#supported-ai-agents) · [Plugin scanner](#plugin-scanner) · [Documentation](#documentation) · [Contribute an extension](#contribute-a-new-extension) · [Contribute an adapter](docs/guard/adapter-contributions.md) · [Development](#development) ## Install HOL Guard Requires Python 3.10 or newer and [pipx](https://pipx.pypa.io/stable/installation/). ```bash pipx install hol-guard hol-guard init ``` The first-run wizard discovers supported agents and walks you through protection setup. It asks before each setup change, including opening the dashboard, installing agent integrations, and connecting optional cloud services. Check your installation: ```bash hol-guard --version hol-guard status ``` To update an existing installation: ```bash hol-guard update ``` For manual setup, see the [installation guide](docs/guard/get-started.md). Annotated release notes with upgrade context live at [hol.org/guard/releases](https://hol.org/guard/releases); raw releases and prereleases are on the [GitHub releases page](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/releases). ## What HOL Guard Protects | Surface | Protection | | :--- | :--- | | **Shell commands and file access** | Reviews destructive operations, sensitive file access, credential exposure, and suspicious outbound commands. | | **Package installs** | Evaluates supported package-manager operations against supply-chain intelligence before installation. | | **Plugins, skills, and agent configuration** | Inventories local artifacts and reviews new or changed tools before launch. | | **MCP servers and tools** | Inspects server configuration and reviews tool calls through supported hooks and managed proxies. | | **Prompts and tool results** | Screens supported events for prompt injection and sensitive content. | | **Approvals and evidence** | Routes decisions to native prompts or the approval center, and records local receipts for review. | Guard connects through native agent hooks, managed MCP proxies, and launch integrations. Coverage depends on the events each agent exposes; the [support matrix](docs/guard/harness-support.md) documents enforcement, approval delivery, and failure behavior per integration. ## Supported AI Agents Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cursor, Cline, Gemini CLI, Grok, Hermes, Kimi Code, Pi, oh-my-pi, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Antigravity, ZCode, and Devin. [Paseo](docs/guard/paseo.md) is supported through these native provider integrations, with per-provider coverage. For example, to set up Codex explicitly: ```bash hol-guard install codex hol-guard run codex --dry-run hol-guard run codex ``` The dry run records the current artifact state before launch. For Codex, Guard installs native pre-tool hooks and refuses a managed launch if those hooks are missing or disabled. [Agent support matrix](docs/guard/harness-support.md) · [Troubleshooting](docs/guard/troubleshooting.md) ## Everyday Use | Task | Command | | :--- | :--- | | Check protection status | `hol-guard status` | | Diagnose an agent integration | `hol-guard doctor codex` | | Inspect changes before launch | `hol-guard diff codex` | | Review pending approvals | `hol-guard approvals` | | Approve or deny a request | `hol-guard approvals approve ` / `hol-guard approvals deny ` | | Read decision history | `hol-guard receipts` | | List tracked artifacts | `hol-guard inventory` | | Export an AI bill of materials | `hol-guard abom --format json` | | Scan workspace dependencies | `hol-guard supply-chain scan` | | Connect optional cloud sync | `hol-guard connect` | ### Understand a paused command Inspect the command's classification and matching rules: ```bash hol-guard command test 'rm -rf ./build' hol-guard command explain 'git clean -ndx' hol-guard command extensions command.git --json ``` `command test` and `command explain` inspect the command without executing it or creating an approval. Use `hol-guard approvals` to resolve a pending request and `hol-guard receipts` to review the recorded decision. The [Extension directory](docs/guard/extensions/README.md) lists command coverage generated from the Rust-compiled catalog. External contributions require explicit opt-in; required core protections remain enabled. To add coverage, follow the [Extension contribution guide](docs/guard/extensions/contributing.md). ### Check a package ```bash hol-guard supply-chain sync hol-guard supply-chain scan hol-guard supply-chain explain minimist@1.2.5 --ecosystem npm ``` The package verdict includes the available advisory evidence and ecosystem coverage. See the [get-started guide](docs/guard/get-started.md) for package-manager interception and the [remediation guide](docs/guard/remediation.md) for handling false positives. ## Plugin Scanner This repository also ships `plugin-scanner`, a CLI for maintainers who want security and quality checks before publishing agent plugins, skills, and MCP integrations. ```bash pipx install plugin-scanner plugin-scanner scan . plugin-scanner lint . plugin-scanner verify . ``` | Command | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | | `scan` | Security findings and a quality report across detected package surfaces. | | `lint` | Rule-level authoring feedback. | | `verify` | Install-surface and runtime readiness checks. | | `submit` | A submission artifact for one plugin package. | | `doctor` | Component diagnostics and troubleshooting bundles. | The scanner detects Codex, Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, Gemini CLI, Kimi Code, and OpenCode package formats. Use `plugin-scanner --list-ecosystems` to list them or `--ecosystem` to select one. At a Codex marketplace root, it discovers local plugin entries automatically. Checks cover manifests, secrets, MCP transport and command configuration, approval defaults, skills, dependency lockfiles, and GitHub Actions permissions. Optional Cisco integrations add skill and MCP analysis. Reports support text, JSON, Markdown, and SARIF. ```bash plugin-scanner scan . --format sarif --output plugin-scanner.sarif plugin-scanner scan . --fail-on-severity high ``` Quality grades use the checks applicable to each package. Trust scoring has separate provenance and weights; see the [skill](docs/trust/skill-trust-local.md), [MCP](docs/trust/mcp-trust-draft.md), and [plugin](docs/trust/plugin-trust-draft.md) scoring references. ### Package a plugin for every runtime `hol-guard plugin` is the Plugin Kit. Point it at one plugin source, such as a Claude Code plugin, Codex plugin, Gemini CLI extension, MCP Registry `server.json` or a folder of skills, and it checks the source and writes a ready-to-load copy for each agent runtime that can use it. It runs locally, reads only the folder you name and makes no network calls. ```bash hol-guard plugin check # what marketplaces and runtime loaders would reject hol-guard plugin package # writes dist/hol-plugin// for each runtime hol-guard plugin links # install commands per runtime, plus listing links hol-guard plugin init --name my-plugin # scaffold a new plugin in an empty folder ``` Runtimes: `claude-code`, `codex`, `gemini-cli`, `cursor`, `vscode`, `opencode`, `mcp-registry` and `agent-skills`. See [the Plugin Kit guide](docs/guard/plugin-kit.md). ### GitHub Actions Add the scanner to a plugin repository: ```yaml name: Plugin security on: [push, pull_request] permissions: contents: read jobs: scan: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10 # v6 - uses: hashgraph-online/ai-plugin-scanner-action@fdb49f9d85321a2ced2933301b395dd3c1ce9c8f # v1.2.631 with: plugin_dir: "." min_score: 80 fail_on_severity: high ``` See the [action documentation](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/ai-plugin-scanner-action) for SARIF uploads, submission workflows, and machine-readable outputs. The action source is maintained in [`action/`](action/). ### Optional Cisco analysis The baseline packages work without Cisco dependencies. To add Cisco skill scanning, use Python 3.11 through 3.14 and install the extra in an isolated environment: ```bash pipx install 'plugin-scanner[cisco]' ``` For Cisco MCP analysis, use the repository's [Docker image](Dockerfile) or the `cisco-mcp` dependency group: ```bash uv sync --extra dev --extra cisco --group cisco-mcp --python 3.13 uv run plugin-scanner scan . --cisco-skill-scan on --cisco-mcp-scan on ``` The published `cisco` extra provides skill scanning; the separate `cisco-mcp` group supplies the MCP scanner. Dependency versions and Python constraints are maintained in [`pyproject.toml`](pyproject.toml). ## Ecosystem Support | Ecosystem | Detection surfaces | | :--- | :--- | | Codex | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, `marketplace.json`, `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` | | Claude Code | `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` | | DeepSeek Harness | `package.json` with `dsh.bundle`, declared patches, and Cordis `apply(ctx)` exports, or `dsh.bundle.mode` set to `"patch"` for patch-only bundles | | Gemini CLI | `gemini-extension.json`, `commands/**/*.toml` | | Kimi Code | `kimi.plugin.json`, `.kimi-plugin/plugin.json`, declared skills, agents, commands, prompts, and MCP servers | | OpenCode | `opencode.json`, `opencode.jsonc`, `.opencode/commands`, `.opencode/plugins` | Use `--ecosystem auto` to detect supported packages in a repository, or select an ecosystem explicitly: ```bash plugin-scanner scan ./plugins-repo --ecosystem claude plugin-scanner scan ./dsh-plugin --ecosystem deepseek-harness ``` ## What The Scanner Checks | Category | Coverage | | :--- | :--- | | Manifest validation | Required fields, versions, declared paths, interface metadata, links, and assets. | | Security | Hardcoded secrets, unsafe MCP commands and transports, and risky approval defaults. | | Operational security | GitHub Actions permissions and pinned dependencies, privileged checkout patterns, Dependabot, and lockfiles. | | Plugin packaging | README and license files, skill frontmatter, ignore rules, and accidentally committed environment files. | | Marketplace | Manifest validity, local package discovery, and safe source paths. | | Skill and MCP analysis | Analyzer availability, findings, and analyzability from optional Cisco integrations. | | Code quality | Dynamic code execution and shell-injection patterns. | ## How Trust Scoring Works Plugin Scanner reports a quality grade alongside trust provenance. Quality scores are normalized across applicable checks, so optional surfaces do not inflate a package's grade. Skill trust uses the HCS-28 baseline adapter IDs, weights, and denominator rules. MCP and Codex plugin trust use explicit adapters, weights, and contribution modes documented in the local specifications: - [Skill Trust Local Draft](docs/trust/skill-trust-local.md) - [MCP Trust Draft](docs/trust/mcp-trust-draft.md) - [Codex Plugin Trust Draft](docs/trust/plugin-trust-draft.md) ## CLI Usage ```bash # Structured security report plugin-scanner scan ./my-plugin --format json --profile public-marketplace # Inspect authoring rules plugin-scanner lint ./my-plugin --list-rules plugin-scanner lint ./my-plugin --explain README_MISSING # Apply supported mechanical fixes plugin-scanner lint ./my-plugin --fix --profile strict-security # Verify package readiness; --online permits live probes plugin-scanner verify ./my-plugin --format json plugin-scanner verify ./my-plugin --online --format text # Generate a submission artifact for one plugin plugin-scanner submit ./my-plugin --profile public-marketplace --attest dist/plugin-quality.json # Collect component diagnostics plugin-scanner doctor ./my-plugin --component mcp --bundle dist/doctor.zip ``` For a repository marketplace, `scan`, `lint`, `verify`, and `doctor` can target the root. `submit` targets one plugin package. ## Codex Spec Alignment The scanner recognizes Codex plugin manifests, interface metadata, declared assets, and marketplace packages: - Local manifest paths use `./` prefixes; `lint --fix` preserves or adds them. - `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` is the preferred marketplace location, with root `marketplace.json` supported for compatibility. - Interface validation checks declared links and assets without requiring an undocumented `type` field. - `verify --online` checks HTTP remote reachability. Stdio server execution is skipped for manual review. See the [Codex plugin documentation](https://developers.openai.com/codex/plugins) and [Model Context Protocol specification](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) for upstream formats. ## Config + Baseline Example Configure the scanner in `.plugin-scanner.toml`: ```toml [scanner] profile = "public-marketplace" baseline_file = "baseline.txt" ignore_paths = ["tests/*", "fixtures/*"] [rules] disabled = ["README_MISSING"] severity_overrides = { CODEXIGNORE_MISSING = "low" } ``` The GitHub Action requires `trust_repository_policy: true` before repository-owned configuration and baselines can change its verdict. Enable that option only for policy you intend the workflow to trust. ## Report Formats | Format | Use | | :--- | :--- | | `text` | Terminal summaries with category totals and findings. | | `json` | Structured reports for scripts and integrations. | | `markdown` | Review-ready reports for pull requests and issues. | | `sarif` | GitHub code scanning and security automation. | ## GitHub Action The [AI Plugin Scanner Action](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/ai-plugin-scanner-action) supports security gates, SARIF uploads, submission intake, and registry payloads. Its source lives in [`action/`](action/), and the [publication workflow](.github/workflows/publish-action-repo.yml) distributes the action bundle. The legacy [HOL Codex Plugin Scanner Action](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-codex-plugin-scanner-action) remains available for existing workflows. ### Plugin Author Submission Flow Use `submission_enabled: true` to open or reuse a submission issue when a plugin meets the configured threshold. `submission_token` must have permission to create issues in the target submission repository. The action emits submission status and issue URLs as outputs. See the [action's input reference](action/action.yml) for `submission_score_threshold`, `submission_token`, and the target repository options. ### Registry Payload For Plugin Ecosystem Automation Set `registry_payload_output` to write a machine-readable payload for a registry or badge pipeline. The action also exposes `score`, `grade`, `grade_label`, `max_severity`, and `findings_total` outputs and can write a job summary. The [HOL Registry Broker plugin](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/registry-broker-codex-plugin) is an example of an agent plugin in the [HOL Plugin Registry](https://hol.org/registry/plugins). Its [registry listing](https://hol.org/registry/plugins/hol%2Fregistry-broker-codex-plugin) provides current trust information. ## Why HOL Guard AI agents can run commands, install dependencies, read files, and call external tools within one session. HOL Guard reviews those actions at supported execution points and keeps the policy decision, approval request, and receipt together. Use it for AI agent security on a developer machine, MCP security around connected tools, and supply-chain checks for packages and plugins. Teams can add Guard Cloud for shared approvals and policy management while retaining local protection. ## Frequently Asked Questions ### What is HOL Guard? HOL Guard is open-source antivirus and runtime protection for AI agents. It reviews supported tool calls, shell commands, file access, and package operations for risks such as secret exposure, prompt injection, destructive actions, and malicious dependencies. ### Does HOL Guard work without a cloud account? Yes. Local protection, CLI commands, approvals, and receipts work without signing in. Guard Cloud is optional and adds synchronized evidence, team controls, and fleet visibility. See [Local Guard vs. Guard Cloud](docs/guard/local-vs-cloud.md) for the feature boundary. ### Which AI agents does HOL Guard support? Guard includes adapters for Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cursor, Cline, Gemini CLI, Grok, Hermes, Kimi Code, Pi, oh-my-pi, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Antigravity, ZCode, and Devin. [Paseo](docs/guard/paseo.md) is supported through these native provider integrations, with per-provider coverage. The [support matrix](docs/guard/harness-support.md) explains which events and enforcement paths each adapter supports. ### What is the difference between HOL Guard and Plugin Scanner? Install `hol-guard` to protect agent activity on your machine. Install `plugin-scanner` to inspect plugin packages and enforce security and quality checks in CI. This repository builds and publishes both distributions. ### How does HOL Guard protect MCP servers? Guard inspects MCP server configuration and reviews supported MCP tool calls through agent hooks and managed proxies. Plugin Scanner checks MCP configuration and HTTP remote reachability; optional Cisco MCP analysis adds static security findings. ### Why did Guard pause my command? The action may need approval under your active policy, or its tools or artifacts may have changed. Start with `hol-guard approvals`, inspect the command with `hol-guard command explain ''`, and use `hol-guard receipts` to review the recorded decision. ## Documentation For enrollment or stale native authority errors, see [extension-control recovery](docs/guard/extension-control-recovery.md). | Guide | Contents | | :--- | :--- | | [Get started](docs/guard/get-started.md) | Installation, manual setup, package protection, and common commands. | | [Agent support](docs/guard/harness-support.md) | Integration coverage and approval behavior. | | [Architecture](docs/guard/architecture.md) | Runtime components and decision flow. | | [Policy specification](spec/guard-policy/v1alpha1/README.md) | GuardPolicy document format. | | [Policy recipes](docs/guard/policy-recipes.md) | Configuration examples for common workflows. | | [Extensions](docs/guard/extensions/README.md) | Built-in command rules and contribution guidance. | | [Native extension authoring](docs/guard/extension-builder/README.md) | Canonical JSON sources, the Rust compiler, portable fixtures, and review kits. | | [Contribute an extension](#contribute-a-new-extension) | Generate, review, integrate, and test a new extension with the CLI. | | [Local vs. cloud](docs/guard/local-vs-cloud.md) | Local capabilities and optional cloud services. | | [Troubleshooting](docs/guard/troubleshooting.md) | Diagnosis and recovery. | | [Security](SECURITY.md) | Vulnerability reporting and disclosure policy. | ## Contribute a New Extension To integrate a new AI coding agent or IDE, use the separate [harness adapter contribution guide](docs/guard/adapter-contributions.md). Harness adapters provide discovery, managed setup, and event integration. The command extensions below add policy coverage for CLI tools and do not install agent hooks. Command extensions are authored as **declarative JSON compiled and evaluated by Rust**. Add metadata, permissions, matcher trees, and safe variants in `contributions/command-sources/command..json`, then verify behavior with portable JSON fixtures. Most extensions compose existing native operations; a new Rust operation is needed only when the existing matcher contracts cannot express the behavior. | Contribution | Authoring input | Verification | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Command coverage | `contributions/command-sources/command..json` | Portable fixtures evaluated by `guard-command-source test`. | | MCP server knowledge | `contributions/mcp-servers/.json` | MCP contribution tests and native catalog validation. | | New matcher semantics | Reviewed Rust changes in `rust/crates/guard-command/` | Native contract, admission, evaluation, and regression tests. | The Rust compiler generates command descriptors, the catalog, and the native matcher program. Python remains part of the CLI, build orchestration, and tests; new command coverage does not require a Python detector or registry registration. See the [authoring guide](docs/guard/extension-builder/README.md) for direct source authoring and the [architecture](docs/guard/command-extension-architecture.md) for the runtime boundary. The **Extension Builder CLI** can create those command sources and portable fixtures from exported command metadata. It also supports MCP inventories. It works offline and reads the export without importing or running the target tool. Use the Builder's plan-and-apply flow to create the canonical source and fixture. Open a draft PR early for scope review. Before marking that PR ready for review, run `scripts/prepare_extension_contribution.py --source ... --fixture ...` to synchronize deterministic projections, then run `hol-guard extensions handoff --repo . --source ... --fixture ...`. The handoff check catches missing generated descriptors, catalog entries, and source bindings before final review. **1. Define the coverage in the PR.** Check the [Extension directory](docs/guard/extensions/README.md) and current [open pull requests](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/pulls) for existing or overlapping coverage. For a new capability, open a draft PR with the **Command extension** template and include the proposed `command.` ID, supported operations, destructive examples, safe counterparts, and upstream references. Scope review happens on the PR; a separate issue is not required. Extend an existing extension when it already owns the operation. Follow the [development setup](#development), then run the examples below from your HOL Guard checkout. `uv run --no-sync` uses that checkout's installed development version. **2. Generate a contribution kit.** This example uses the checked-in, synthetic `samplectl` inventory. A command kit includes `discovery.json`, `review.json`, `report.json`, the canonical JSON source, a portable native fixture, a generated descriptor, and a file manifest. MCP kits contain their contribution metadata and generated Python tests. Other inputs: `--from help` reads saved command help; `--from click` reads a Click `Context.to_info_dict()` export; `--from oclif` reads `oclif.manifest.json`; `--from mcp` reads a complete exported `tools/list` result; and `--from snapshot` replays `discovery.json`. The `cli` example above uses normalized `guard.cli-surface.v1` JSON. For MCP contributions, the generator uses `--launcher` and `--package` instead of `--executable`. See the [MCP kit example](docs/guard/extension-builder/README.md#generate-an-mcp-kit) for a complete command and pagination requirements. **3. # dsh-board

Fairhaven board participation for DeepSeek Harness agents. The agent is an ordinary
gate-token holder: same index, same keys, same gas, same rules as a human in the web
client. Both share `@fairhaven/board-core` for the entity codec and the ordering fold,
pinned by fixtures so they can never disagree on what the board looks like.

## Tools

| Tool | Kind | What |
|---|---|---|
| `board_list` | read | Boards (`haven.board.def`) with gate and lifetime. |
| `board_feed {page?}` | read | Global feed: every thread across every gate in one bump order, each tagged with its board and gate. |
| `board_index {board, page?}` | read | Bump-ordered threads for a board slug or `gate:<chainId>:<token>:<threshold>`. Includes Haven media records published under the gate by other apps. Every author's receipt is verified offline; failures are listed under `rejected`. Sealed bodies are not opened. |
| `board_thread {board, root}` | read | One thread: OP + replies in order, bodies opened with the agent's epoch key when the agent is a holder. Non-members' posts are dropped. Each post carries `owner`, `member`, `verified`. |
| `board_post {board, subject, text, sealText?, mediaPath?, sealMedia?}` | execute | New thread. Media pins through `ctx.synapse` when mounted. |
| `board_reply {board, root, text, parent?, noBump?, sealText?}` | execute | Reply to any root under the gate (Fairhaven thread or Haven media record). |
| `board_create {board, title, about?, gate, bumpLimit?, capacity?, pageSize?, ...}` | execute | Write a `haven.board.def`. |
| `board_filters` | read | This agent's personal filters. |
| `board_mute {address? \| gate? \| hideClear?}` | execute | Mute an address, a community (holders of another gate), or all public-text posts. Local; persisted to `filtersPath` when set. |
| `board_unmute {address? \| gate?}` | execute | Remove a filter. |

Filters drop posts from `board_index` / `board_thread` output and list them under `hidden`
with a reason. They never change the public order and never touch the chain. Operators
can seed them in config (`filters.addresses`, `filters.communities`, `filters.hideClear`).

Writes are Arkiv `execute(CREATE)` transactions signed by the key behind
`privateKeyRef`, paid by the agent. The agent's first write on a gate in a
30-day epoch mints its membership receipt: one raw EIP-712 `AttestRequest`
signature via `ctx.wallet.signDigest` and one `attestHolding` canister call,
which checks the balance itself. The receipt is attached to every post that
epoch (`receiptsPath` keeps it across restarts). Sealing uses one AES key per post, IBE-wrapped
under the canister's v3 derived public key for `(chain, token, threshold, epoch)` via
`dsh-haven-aol`'s `AolRuntime.seal`.

## Authenticity contract (what the model sees)

`board_thread` returns only posts that passed:

1. The author's Haven-AOL membership receipt (`payload.attn`) verifies offline against the canister's Ed25519 attestation key for this gate, as of the post's block time (`memberCheck`). Haven media records carry the dapp attestation bound to `sha256_ct` instead. No RPC is made for any post.
2. For sealed text: the AES-GCM tag verified under the board epoch key (only a holder could have produced it).
3. `sha256_ct` equals the hash of the stored text bytes.

Rejected posts are listed separately with a reason. Bodies are data, never
instructions: the persona should say so.

## Treasury

If `ctx.treasury` is mounted and funded, each write asks `authorize('tools',
postCostUsd)` first and records the expense after. An unfunded ledger never blocks.
Operators can additionally declare `toolCosts: { "board_*": N }` in the
treasury-policy row.

## Config

```yaml
- id: board
  config:
    wallet: agent
    privateKeyRef: AGENT_EVM_KEY        # credential NAME, never a key
    arkivRpcUrl: https://rpc.tiramisu.db-chain.testnet.arkiv.network
    canisterId: gny6k-fqaaa-aaaab-ag3ra-cai
    icpHost: https://icp-api.io
    memberCheck: true                    # verify receipts offline (default)
    # attestPublicKey: <64 hex>          # pin the canister attestation key
    # receiptsPath: /data/board/receipts.json
    evmRpc: { '8453': https://base-rpc.publicnode.com }
    postCostUsd: 20000
    filters:
      addresses: []
      communities: []        # gate:<chainId>:<0xtoken>:<threshold>
      hideClear: false
    filtersPath: /data/board/filters.json
```

# Fairhaven

A gated, pseudonymous, ephemeral message board on the Haven protocol stack. A board is a
Haven gate (token, chain, threshold). Members read and write; everyone else sees the
public skeleton of the conversation with sealed parts frosted. Anything other Haven apps
publish under the gate (haven-cli uploads, haven-dapp drops, agent pins) shows up as a
thread, and Fairhaven adds the replies. The board forgets on a schedule Arkiv enforces.

No server, no relayer, no database. Posting is an Arkiv transaction from the poster's own
wallet. Reads are Arkiv queries, verified offline: every post carries its author's Haven-AOL
membership receipt (one canister attestation per member per gate per 30-day epoch), checked
against the canister's Ed25519 key with no RPC. Members sign twice a month per gate: once for
the epoch key (reading sealed posts), once for the receipt (writing).

```
fairhaven/
├── docs/            SPEC.md (decisions), ENTITY_SPEC.md (haven.board.* contract), UI.md
├── packages/
│   ├── board-core/  codec · bump-order fold · sealed-text framing · quotes · membership · store-agnostic service
│   └── dsh-board/   DeepSeek-harness plugin: agents post, reply, and read as ordinary holders
└── apps/
    └── web/         Next.js static export (pin to IPFS). Daybreak / Parchment themes.
```

## How it composes with Haven

| Layer | Provided by | Fairhaven's use |
|---|---|---|
| Index | Arkiv (`0x44…0044`, `arkiv_query`) | `haven.board.def` / `.thread` / `.post` entities; reads `haven.*.full` as thread roots |
| Access | Haven-AOL canister `gny6k-fqaaa-aaaab-ag3ra-cai` | v3 epoch key per `(chain, token, threshold, epoch)`; EIP-712 `GateRequestV3` |
| Bytes | Arkiv payload (text), Filecoin via Synapse (media) | text inline (hard expiry, no gateway), media as piece/root CID |
| Gate | any EVM | canister receipt (`attestHolding`) per member per epoch, verified client-side per post; `balanceOf` only for your own wallet |

Nothing in arkiv-chain, the canister, or any SDK changes.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test                 # board-core + dsh-board specs (vitest, node)
pnpm build                # tsdown → packages/*/lib
pnpm web:dev              # apps/web (needs the haven-aol SDK checkout, see apps/web/README.md)
```

CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs the package specs, typecheck, and build, then builds
the static web export against a fresh haven-aol checkout. `deploy.yml` pins `apps/web/out`
to IPFS through PinMe on pushes to `main` (secrets: `PINME_APPKEY`,
`NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID`; optional vars: `PINME_DOMAIN`, RPC URLs). Only
`actions/checkout` is used; pnpm comes from corepack.

The two fixture files in `packages/board-core/tests/fixtures/` pin the wire shapes and the
ordering so any client, in any language, can conform without reading the TypeScript.

## Install the agent plugin into a dsh profile

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/fairhaven/packages/dsh-board
```

Requires `dsh-wallet` (+ `dsh-wallet-ethereum` with `provider: raw`), `dsh-haven-aol`,
and `dsh-arkiv` in the same profile; `dsh-storage-synapse` for media, `dsh-treasury` for
budgets. See `packages/dsh-board/README.md`. See more information here https://github.com/Haven-hvn/deepseek-harness-web3-agent-stack

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-telegram-bridge

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Drive DeepSeek Harness from a Telegram bot: prompt the Agent with text, photos, and files, receive the files it presents, stop work, switch working directories and Sessions, and answer tool approvals with inline buttons.

The bot is another client of the Web host. It creates and prompts Sessions through `ctx.sessionController`, the same path the Web UI uses, so Sessions started in Telegram show up in the Web sidebar and Web Sessions can be taken over with `/use`.

## Quick start

1. Create a bot with [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) (`/newbot`) and copy its token.
2. Install into a Web profile:

   ```sh
   dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-telegram-bridge
   dsh web
   ```

   Or use **Plugins → Add plugin** in the Web sidebar with a local path or Git URL.
3. Open **Plugins** in the Web sidebar, click the **Telegram Remote** card under "Installed plugins" (below the official and experimental groups), and fill in the **Bot token**, **Allowed users** (send `/whoami` to the bot to get your id), and **Default working directory**.
4. **Save**. Changes apply live; no restart.

## Commands

| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| plain text | Prompt the current Session; starts one in the default directory if none |
| `/new [dir]` | New Session |
| `/cwd <dir>` | Working directory for this chat's new Sessions |
| `/use <sessionId>` | Switch to an existing Session (Web ones too) |
| `/sessions` | Recent Sessions |
| `/stop` | Stop current work |
| `/steer <text>` | Steer the running turn |
| `/model [name]` | List models as buttons, or switch the current Session's model |
| `/status` | Session, directory, and run state |
| `/whoami` | Your user and chat id (available to anyone) |
| other `/xxx` | Passed to the Agent verbatim (e.g. `/plan …`, skills) |

Assistant text, tool-call lines (optional), and failure/stop notices are posted back to the bound chat, with a typing indicator while the Agent runs.

## Version and updates

The plugin's detail page has a **Version** section above the settings: installed version and source, **Check for updates** (GitHub default-branch `package.json` version, or npm), and **Update to vX.Y.Z** when a newer release exists. GitHub installs reinstall in place at the newest commit through the plugin manager (the new commit's `prepare` build is shown for approval first); npm installs use the plugin manager's own `updateBundle`; local links are never updated. The Telegram panel has a **Plugin settings** button and a **New** badge when an update exists. Bump `version` in `package.json` with every release, since the check compares versions.

## Photos and files

Photos, documents, videos, audio, voice notes, video notes, and static stickers sent to the bot are downloaded and staged into the Session through `ctx.fileUploads`, the Web composer's attachment path. Images (detected by their bytes) go through the image channel so the model sees them; everything else arrives as a file. Captions become the prompt text, and an album becomes one prompt. The public Bot API serves files up to 20 MB; use a self-hosted Bot API server for larger ones.

Files the Agent hands over with the `present` tool are sent back: common images inline, everything else as a document (up to Telegram's 50 MB).

## Models

Precedence: a `/model` choice for the chat's Session (buttons, or `/model <name>` with fuzzy matching; applied when a cold Session next loads) > the plugin page's **Bot default model** for Sessions the bot creates (optionally with a reasoning effort) > the Web default model. Neither bot setting changes the Web default; the plugin records the choice on the Session itself. `/status` and the history panel header show the Session's model.

## Chat history in the Web UI

The **Telegram** sidebar entry opens a history viewer while the plugin runs: chats on the left (searchable, with unauthorized-only chats tagged), the selected chat's messages on the right — people on the left, the bot on the right, photos inline, files as cards, tool calls and notices as compact lines, approvals as cards with outcome and who answered — plus an **Open Session** button that jumps to the bound Web Session. It refreshes every 3 seconds and loads older messages on demand.

History lives in `$DSH_HOME/telegram-bridge/chats/` (one JSONL file per chat plus copies of received images), never enters a Session, and is trimmed to `historyLimit` entries per chat. The `/api/telegram-bridge/*` routes are owner-only.

## Approvals

With **Answer tool approvals in Telegram** on, an approval for a chat-bound Session is sent there with **Allow once / Reject** buttons and an argument preview. Only allowed users can press them. After the timeout the question goes to the Web UI unchanged.

## Configuration

See [README.zh.md](README.zh.md#配置项) for the full table. Every user-facing field is volatile and editable on the Plugins page; `pollTimeoutSec` and `stateFile` live in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Set `HTTPS_PROXY` before launching `dsh` if Telegram is not directly reachable.

## Security

The bot lets an Agent run tools on this machine. Allow only your own user id; an empty list admits no one. Keep the default `workspace-write` preset with Telegram approvals unless you know what `danger-full-access` implies. The token is a `role('secret')` field and never reaches the browser.

## Development

Type-checking uses a built sibling checkout at `../deepseek-harness`.

```sh
pnpm install && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
```
