# dsh-plugin-speech

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

![Read aloud — DeepSeek Harness speech plugin](docs/cover.jpg)

Read assistant replies aloud in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), one continuous voice per reply.

## What it does

Each finished assistant message gets a play control in its action row. Press it and the reply is spoken through a text-to-speech service; press it again and it stops. A settings row in General owns the service, the voice, and the tuning.

The whole reply goes out in **one request** and the host streams the audio back while the service is still synthesizing it. Playback starts once a few seconds are buffered — about a second for a typical reply — and from there it is one continuous voice to the last word: the pre-buffer is what keeps it from running dry in the middle of a sentence.

## Providers

| Service | Key needed | Voices |
|---|---|---|
| **Microsoft Edge** (default) | no | the service publishes its full catalog, every language it serves |

Adding a provider means adding one folder under `src/providers/` and one line in `src/providers/registry.ts` — the settings screen builds its fields from what the provider declares.

### The Edge token

Every handshake carries a short-lived `Sec-MS-GEC` token: the current time in Windows file-time ticks, rounded down to five minutes, digested together with the well-known client token. In October 2026 the endpoint moved to a **second generation** of that token — a patched SHA-256 paired with a 64-bit checksum — and began answering the first generation with a bare `403` (`Edge TTS WebSocket error: Unexpected server response: 403`), which is what a reply that never speaks looks like from the browser. `src/providers/edge/gec.ts` reproduces the accepted generation; `server.ts` hands it to `msedge-tts` by replacing the library's private URL builder, which is also what pins the token version the endpoint now expects. If read-aloud stops working again, test that token first: it is the only part of this plugin that can expire without the code changing.

## Requirements

- A DeepSeek Harness surface — `dsh web`, or the desktop app — version `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer.
- Network access to the speech service. Nothing else: there is no model to download, and the Edge provider needs no account.

The version floor is not decorative. The plugin's preferences are its own Cordis entry config, exposed to the settings screen as a form through `ctx.configForms`. Releases before `0.2.0-rc.2` had plugins register settings namespaces themselves (`settings.register`) and handed the browser a `ctx.settingsScope`; both services are gone.

## Install

This package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so it installs as a **profile bundle**: the package
manager links it, the launcher appends it to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, and the
bundle's own patch layer inserts the plugin row. Installing also enables it — in DeepSeek
Harness, installing a plugin and enabling it in a profile are separate steps, and a bundle
collapses the two.

**Desktop app** — sidebar → **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, then give one of:

- `@nakamuraia/dsh-plugin-speech` (the npm registry)
- `github:NakamuraIA/dsh-plugin-speech`
- an absolute path to a local checkout

**From the CLI** — the same operation, profile-scoped:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:NakamuraIA/dsh-plugin-speech
```

Restart the surface afterwards. The host half claims its HTTP routes when the plugin loads,
a desktop profile is owned by the app, and a newly installed out-of-tree bundle is not mounted
by a live recomposition — an app-internal row added to a patch does reload immediately, a
package that has to come from the profile's `node_modules` does not.

### One-off overlay, without installing

`cordis.patch.yml` is the same patch the bundle applies, so it also works as a temporary
command-line overlay:

```sh
dsh web --patch ./cordis.patch.yml
```

Do **not** do both. A profile patch that inserts `ui-speech` while the bundle is selected
collides with `duplicate loader entry id`; the profile layer is for overriding the row's
config, which is what the settings screen writes.

The **row name** is the package name and also the browser module id the built bundle registers
under; the **row id** (`ui-speech`) is the settings namespace the config form is keyed by.
Nothing works if either one drifts, so change the two together.

## Settings

Settings opens on **General**, where a **Read aloud** row owns:

- **Service** — which provider speaks.
- **Language** and **Voice** — the catalog entry to use.
- **Speed**, **Volume**, **Pitch** — sent to the service with every request.
- **Skip code** — leave fenced code and inline code out of the reading.
- **Test voice** — speaks a sample through the settings on screen, saved or not.

The row edits the plugin's own entry config, so the chosen values persist in the profile patch beside the entry rather than in a settings document. Resetting a field restores the schema default, and a write the Host refuses leaves the stored value untouched while the row says so.

Tables and pasted spreadsheets are never read, whichever way **Skip code** is set. That switch decides only whether fenced and inline code are read: with it off, the code itself is spoken and just the fences go. Links keep their label and lose their target; emoji, quotes, and standalone symbols are dropped. Sentence punctuation is kept, because the voice uses it for pauses.

## How it works

```
browser                    host                        service
───────                    ────                        ───────
click ─ ▶ POST /speech/speak { text }
                           select provider from
                           its own entry config
                           ────────────────────────── ▶ synthesize
        ◀ ─ audio bytes stream back ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ┘
buffer four seconds, then play while it keeps arriving
```

Synthesis lives on the host because a browser cannot hold an API key and cannot reach most services across CORS. The browser only posts text and plays bytes. Every editable leaf of the entry config is `.volatile()`, so a settings write lands in the running host without reloading it — the host reads the same value the browser wrote.

Playback goes through `MediaSource` and starts once **four seconds** of audio are buffered, then plays while the rest arrives. That pre-buffer is the whole design: streaming straight away stalled whenever the service synthesized slower than the voice spoke, and waiting for the whole file was seamless but could take ten seconds. Four seconds is early enough to feel immediate — measured at about a second on a warm connection — and late enough that nothing runs dry mid-sentence. When a link in that chain is missing (no `MediaSource`, a container the engine refuses, a buffer that dies mid-reply) the reply is still played, as one whole file assembled from the bytes in hand.

Only a reply larger than one request may carry (20 000 characters) is spoken sentence by sentence, which is where a pause between sentences can still be heard.

A voice can also end every sentence with a long silence of its own — `pt-BR-AntonioNeural`, the schema default, leaves about 0.9 s at each one, while the multilingual voices leave none. That silence is in the audio the service returns, not in how this plugin plays it.

## Development

This repository builds on its own against the published `@deepseek-ai/*` packages; no harness checkout is involved:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build      # tsc → lib/types, tsdown → lib/index.js + lib/client.js
pnpm test       # vitest
pnpm typecheck  # sources and specs
```

`build/plugin-bundle.ts` is the client-bundle preset. It emits the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` handoff, keeps every module-table row a `require`, compiles CSS Modules into one injected style tag, and fails the build on a cross-plugin value import. It is a self-contained copy of the harness preset, which is what lets the package be built here.

Three specs under `tests/checkout/` compose the real client registries, which only exist as sources inside a harness checkout; `tests/checkout/README.md` explains why and how to run them. Everything else, including the client wiring, runs through `pnpm test`.

### Migrating from 0.1.x

- The host half exports `Config` — the schemastery schema with `.volatile()` leaves — and no longer calls `settings.register`; the synthesis route reads the entry config it was handed at apply time.
- The client half takes `ctx.configForms.get('ui-speech')` instead of `ctx.settingsScope.bind(...)`, and a write reports acceptance directly (`Promise<boolean>`) instead of being checked against the settled section.
- Icons from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` are named by weight (`IconPlayOutlineRegular`), not by drawn size (`IconPlayOutline16`).

decision.reason: Held for authorization or trust boundary evidence. MIT, canonical Git and README DSH at least 0.2.0-rc.2 are explicit. Complete native host/client were captured. Direct webServer speech/voice routes bound text length and methods but do not establish connection authentication or an origin check before credential-backed speech requests. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# DDeck — плагин (сторона компьютера)

Показывает код подключения, принимает телефон и поднимает TLS-шлюз, через который
приложение DDeck работает с DeepSeek Harness. Ставится в профиль DSH одной командой.

## Установка

```sh
./plugin/install.sh                 # или: DSH_PROFILE=/путь ./plugin/install.sh
```

Скрипт делает три записи профиля (`package.json`, `dsh.profile.bundles`,
`cordis.patch.yml`) и подключает плагин **симлинком** на эту папку. `pnpm`/`npm install`
не нужны: QR и TLS-библиотека уже собраны в `lib/`.

- повторный запуск обновляет установку;
- `plugin/uninstall.sh` удаляет плагин, не трогая данные сопряжений;
- бэкап профиля — в `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/.dsh-remote-backups/<дата>`.

После установки **перезапустите DeepSeek Harness**.

## Что появляется

- панель **DDeck** в интерфейсе DSH: QR, шестизначный код, список устройств;
- HTTPS-шлюз на `0.0.0.0:3449` (меняется `DSH_REMOTE_PORT`);
- страница `/m` — мобильный интерфейс для телефона;
- данные сопряжений — в `~/.dsh/dsh-remote`.

## Разработка

```sh
./plugin/install.sh
# зависимости для пересборки бандлов:
cd plugin && npm install
npx esbuild vendor/entry.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node20 \
  --outfile=lib/gateway-bundle.js --external:@deepseek-ai/schemastery
```

Правки в `plugin/lib` при установке симлинком видны после перезапуска DSH; мобильный
слой (`lib/mobile/skin.*`) подхватывается при перезагрузке страницы.

## Лицензия

Apache-2.0. Вендоренный транспорт — Apache-2.0 (`NOTICE`, `vendor/gateway/VENDORED.md`);
лицензии встроенных библиотек — в `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md`.

# DDeck

[English version](README.en.md)

**DDeck** — пульт к вашему компьютеру с **DeepSeek Harness**: чат с агентом,
инструменты, очередь сообщений, файлы и терминал — с Android-телефона или планшета.
Компьютер и телефон соединяются напрямую по TLS с закреплённым сертификатом; дома —
по локальной сети, вне дома — через ваш Tailscale. Промежуточного сервера нет.

> Неофициальный клиент. Не связан с DeepSeek и не заменяет DeepSeek Harness.

## Что нужно

- macOS с установленным DeepSeek Harness (профиль `desktop`);
- Android 10+ (телефон или планшет);
- Tailscale на компьютере и телефоне — для доступа вне дома; в домашней сети достаточно LAN.
- Python 3 для установщика (входит в macOS Command Line Tools; `xcode-select --install`);
  Node.js не обязателен — зависимости плагина уже собраны в `lib/`.

## Установка

```sh
git clone https://github.com/nemezida1337/ddeck-client.git ddeck
cd ddeck
./plugin/install.sh
```

Скрипт добавит плагин в профиль DSH ссылкой, сохранит бэкап профиля и проверит,
что плагин импортируется. **Перезапустите DeepSeek Harness** — панель **DDeck**
появится в интерфейсе DSH.

Обновление — повторить `./plugin/install.sh` и перезапустить DSH.
Удаление — `./plugin/uninstall.sh`; данные сопряжений при этом сохраняются.

## Совместимость

Нужен DeepSeek Harness с поддержкой плагинов (`^0.1.5-rc.1 || ^0.2.1-rc.2`);
проверено на DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 / macOS. Другая версия DSH может не поддерживать
мобильный слой — проверьте панель DDeck после установки.

## Сопряжение

1. Если подключаетесь вне дома — включите Tailscale на компьютере и телефоне.
2. Откройте панель **DDeck** в DSH — появится QR и шестизначный код.
3. На телефоне установите APK из Releases и отсканируйте QR (или введите адрес и код).

## Ограничения беты

- Только Android; iOS/iPadOS — в планах.
- Уведомления в фоне работают, пока Android не остановит foreground-сервис; на длинных
  паузах возможны пропуски — это известное ограничение беты.
- Публикация в Google Play ещё не выполнялась.
- Языки беты: русский и английский — экран подключения, панель DDeck, брифинг и
  нижняя панель. Язык берётся из языка DSH, а для `/m` можно указать `?lang=en`.
- Приложение получает удалённый доступ к вашему компьютеру: используйте только свой
  tailnet и не передавайте QR/код посторонним.
- При ручном вводе адреса без приглашения/QR сертификат компьютера принимается
  по модели TOFU (первое доверие). Для строгой проверки отпечатка используйте QR
  или ссылку-приглашение.

## Безопасность и данные

- Параметры подключения и токены устройства хранятся локально: на компьютере — в
  `~/.dsh/dsh-remote`, на телефоне — в зашифрованном хранилище Android Keystore.
- TLS-сертификат компьютера закрепляется при сопряжении (TOFU с проверкой отпечатка
  из QR/intent).
- Данные не отправляются третьим лицам; сервера DDeck не используются.

## Обратная связь

Баги и предложения — GitHub Issues. Уязвимости — приватно через Security → Report a vulnerability.

## Репозиторий

- `android/` — Android-приложение;
- `plugin/` — плагин DSH: TLS-шлюз, страница `/m`, мобильный слой;
- `docs/` — установка, Tailscale, privacy, security.

# dsh-mem — 语义驱动记忆插件（DeepSeek Harness）

> 核心立场：**遗忘与巩固由语义而非时间决定。时间戳只作为元数据保存，永不作为衰减/删除的驱动。**
> 设计文档：`design/语义驱动记忆系统设计.md`（定稿 v1.0）。本包实现其 **P0 + P1 + P2** 里程碑。

一句话：一个 Cordis 插件，监听会话日志，把值得记的内容（经 M5 rubric 判分）连同嵌入向量写入持久记忆库；每次模型请求前按语义检索（余弦召回 + CSLS + 精排 + MMR）注入最相关的记忆；矛盾的新记忆把旧记忆**或语义节点**软失效（不删除，且只对时间上重叠的矛盾生效）；每次记忆进入最终上下文都按线索质量巩固其分数 S、被竞争压制的按小权重衰减、睡眠周期对全库施加慢兜底衰减——S 决定 hot/warm/cold 分层而非删除；离线"睡眠"周期把冗余的情景簇蒸馏成语义 gist 节点（聚类 → gist → QA 闸门 → M4 路由 → M6 评估 → 迁移），原始记忆压缩归档；`memory_search` 支持 `at` 时间旅行参数，可检索任意历史时点的记忆状态。时间从不参与排序或删除决策（唯一例外是慢兜底衰减，且只影响分层、永不删除）。

## 产出结果

### 1. 自动注入的记忆 section（每步系统提示词，库非空且命中时）

```
Relevant long-term memories (semantic retrieval; recency was not a factor):
1. 用户偏好用 PostgreSQL 作为生产数据库  [id=9f2ac1… score=0.812 tier=warm]
2. 部署延迟通常由配置复杂性导致  [id=41b7de… score=0.774 tier=warm]
```

评分排序是纯语义的：十年前相关的原则性记忆可以排在上一分钟的闲聊之前。同一轮内展开查询不变时复用检索结果，不重复调用嵌入/重排端点。

### 2. `memory_search` 工具（模型主动召回）

| 参数 | 类型 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | string，必填 | 自然语言检索请求 |
| `limit` | integer，可选 | 返回条数上限（默认 `tool.maxResults`=5；< 1 返回规范 error 值） |
| `at` | string，可选 | 时间旅行时点（ISO 8601 或 epoch ms，§2.5 完整版）：检索该时点的记忆状态——被取代的记忆在该时点之前重新可见；非法值返回规范 error 值而非抛异常 |

返回单个规范 JSON 值（模型可见文本由 `render` 从该值投影）。`layer` 区分原始记忆（`episodic`）与睡眠周期蒸馏出的 gist（`semantic`）；传了合法 `at` 时输出带 `at` 回显：

```json
{
  "query": "which database should we use?",
  "expandedQuery": "which database…\n---\n最近对话轮摘要",
  "memories": [
    { "id": "9f2ac1…", "text": "用户偏好用 PostgreSQL…", "score": 0.812, "cue": 0.65, "tier": "warm", "layer": "episodic", "createdAt": 1761273600000 }
  ],
  "suppressedCount": 2
}
```

### 3. 持久记忆库（ctx.storage，不自建数据库）

- KV unit（默认名 `dsh-mem`，`config.storage.unit` 可改），两张表：`episodic`（MemoryRecord）与 `semantic`（SemanticNode，睡眠周期填充）。
- 记录含 M5 判分（imp/valence/arousal/reasons）、邻域统计（r_m/red）、巩固分数 S、分层 tier（hot/warm/cold）、使用计数（used_count/suppressed_count/last_used_at/last_cue_quality/last_decay_at）——计数自 P2 起被 S 动态消费；语义节点带同构的可选 counters。
- **软失效**：被取代的记录或语义节点只设 `invalid_at` / `superseded_by` 并移出检索索引，永不删除。矛盾判定带**时间重叠闸**（§2.5 完整版）：只对同一时间框架的矛盾软失效，"过去用 MySQL"与"现在用 PostgreSQL"这类不同时期的矛盾两条都保留。
- **压缩归档**（P1）：被语义节点吸收的记录设 `flags.compressed_into` / `qa_passed` 与 `time_meta.compressed_at`（归档时点，时间旅行消费）并退出检索池；QA/epi 闸门拒收的簇标 `flags.incompressible`，全簇已标时需新成员加入才重试。
- 落盘位置由所选 storage 后端拥有（json / sqlite 各自决定介质），unit 格式版本见 `config.storage.version`。

### 3a. 巩固分数 S 的完整动态（P2，设计 §2.1）

```
初始：    S ← imp                                  （写入时）
成功使用：S ← S + α·(1 + cue)·g(arousal)           α = score.useGain = 0.5
                                                  g = 0.5 + 0.5·arousal（§3.5 乘法门；语义节点无 arousal，门恒 1）
被抑制：  S ← S − ε                                ε = score.suppressPenalty = 0.05（每查询至多一次）
兜底衰减：S ← S·e^(−Δt/τ)                          τ = score.decayTauDays = 180 天（半衰期 ≈ 125 天）
```

- **成功使用 = 进入最终上下文**（两条检索通道的 top 输出，scoring.ts 记账）。设计所列"被采纳"信号（ctx.messageFeedback）不在当前依赖集内（message-feedback 包类型未发布到 npm，P1 对 ctx.schedule 的同款取舍）：按"未被纠正"默认成立即时入账，接入后可改为确认制。
- **兜底衰减是工程保险**：只影响分层、永不删除。以 `counters.last_decay_at` 为锚**惰性求值**（事件路径先补衰减再加减增量，睡眠周期第 7 步全库批处理），与逐日衰减数学等价；只作用于仍在检索宇宙的记录/节点。
- **分层**：S ≥ 8 hot、2–8 warm、< 2 cold；cold 需更强语义线索（CSLS cue 再 +0.1）。tier 随 S 动态跃迁；**事件驱动的跃迁触发 M5 重判**（新判分按 `score.rejudgeEma` EMA 混入），衰减引起的跃迁不重判（衰减不构成重要性的新证据，防边界穿越烧调用）。
- 语义节点同构：使用/抑制事件、兜底衰减都作用（P1 只有挂入增益 attachGain）。

### 3b. 时间旅行（P2，设计 §2.5 完整版）

- 任意时点 t 的记忆状态 = `valid_at ≤ t < invalid_at` 且当时未压缩（`compressed_at` 未设或晚于 t）的记录 + 当时有效的语义节点（`MemoryStore.retrievableAt(t)`）。
- `memory_search` 的 `at` 参数走该视图；被取代的记忆在其失效前的时点重新可检索。近似边界：tier / r_m / 节点 gist 取当前落盘快照（历史 S 与邻域不重建）；P1 遗留的无 `compressed_at` 归档记录保守视为历来已压缩（无法定期则不复活）。

### 4. 睡眠巩固周期（P1，设计 §2.3/§5.3）

turn/end 信号门控触发（自上次周期新写入 ≥ `sleep.minNewMemories`，默认 10；fire-and-forget 不阻塞会话，运行中不重入）：

```
1. 聚类     pairwise 余弦 ≥ clusterCos 的有效未压缩记忆 → 连通分量；
           簇大小 ≥ clusterMinSize 且簇内平均 pairwise 余弦 ≥ clusterCos（链式传导被平均值拦截）
2. gist    LLM 对簇摘要抽象（"用户多次提到部署延迟与配置复杂性相关"）
3. QA 闸门  从簇生成 QA 对、仅以 gist 作答，平均 token 级 F1 ≥ qaF1Threshold(0.8) 才放行；
           拒收 → 保留原簇并标记"不可压缩"（防错误 gist 固化传播）
4. M4 路由  con = gist 对语义网络峰值余弦的 z 分数（基线 = 最近 conWindow 条记忆的分布）：
           con > +0.5σ 且 LLM 兼容复核通过 → 挂入已有节点（member_refs 追加、S += attachGain）；
           con < −1σ 且簇均 imp ≥ 7 → 建新节点；其余留情景层等下轮；空网络无条件建首节点（引导）
5. M6 评估  gist 的完整 epi = σ(z(实体密度)+z(时间密度)−z(探针相关度))，低于 epiThreshold 才迁移；
           epi 下降量 = "细节遗忘量"的量化
6. 迁移     成员 compressed_into 指向节点、记录 compressed_at 归档时点，退出检索池
7. 刷新     全库 r_m/red 与节点 r_m 重算（§3.2/§3.3"夜间刷新"；无簇时也执行）；
           兼施 S 兜底衰减（§2.1，P2）：留层记录与有效节点 S·e^(−Δt/τ)，衰减跃迁不触发 M5 重判
```

### 5. 仓库工件

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `src/` | 插件源码（模块地图见[开发](#开发)） |
| `lib/` | `npm run build` 产物（ESM + .d.ts） |
| `tests/` | 180 个离线单测（vitest，无需网络与 API key） |
| `scripts/eval-ndcg.mjs` | §7.1 检索四档消融脚手架 |
| `scripts/eval-sleep.mjs` | P1 睡眠周期脚手架（QA 保留率、压缩后召回存续） |
| `scripts/eval-semtime.mjs` | P2 语义 vs 时间消融脚手架（§7.4 关键消融 + 时间旅行） |
| `data/` | 示例语料与查询集（格式见[评测](#评测ndcg-四档消融)） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 组合包 patch（`dsh plugin add` 时使用） |

### 6. 当前验证状态

| 门禁 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `npm run typecheck`（strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess） | 0 错误 |
| `npm test` | 180/180 通过 |
| `npm run build` → `lib/` | 通过；`node` 导入 `lib/index.js` 与 Config 默认值校验通过 |
| 非法配置响亮失败 | Schema 加载时抛 `ValidationError`（如 `score.useGain: "not-a-number"`） |
| eval-ndcg 冒烟（deterministic 替身） | 四档管线全部跑通（数值无语义意义） |
| eval-sleep 冒烟（echo LLM + deterministic 替身） | 聚类→gist→QA→迁移→统计刷新→S 衰减全链路跑通（数值无语义意义） |
| eval-semtime 冒烟（deterministic 替身） | semantic / time / ga-product 三臂 + 时间旅行复活计数跑通（数值无语义意义） |

**尚未验证**（需外部资源，见验收目标）：真实嵌入/重排端点下的 nDCG 与语义 vs 时间消融数字、M5 判分与人工标注的 Spearman ρ > 0.7、真实 LLM 下 QA 闸门保留率 ≥ 0.8 与长程问答提升、messageFeedback"被采纳"确认制接线（message-feedback 包类型进入依赖集后），以及在真实 dsh 宿主中的端到端会话运行（本包的宿主对接均已对照 npm 上 `@deepseek-ai/*` 真实类型定义编写并通过类型检查，但未在活的 harness 进程里跑过）。

## 使用方法

### 前置条件

- Node ≥ 20；dsh 运行环境（`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`）。
- profile 里有 **storage 后端**（dsh-base 自带持久化层；纯自定义组合需自装 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json` 或 `dsh-storage-sqlite`）与 **llm 适配器**（如 `dsh-llm-deepseek` + 凭据）。
- 嵌入/重排端点的 API key（默认指向 SiliconFlow 的 bge-m3 / bge-reranker-v2-m3）。没有 key 可先用 `deterministic` 模式冒烟（离线替身，验证管线不验证语义）。

### 方式 A：本地源码加载（开发）

创建 `overlay.yml`（**插件路径必须是绝对路径**）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-mem
      name: 'C:/Users/you/Code/dsh_mem/src/index.ts'
      config:
        embedding:
          mode: http            # 无 key 冒烟改为 deterministic
          apiKey: !!js process.env.MEM_EMBEDDING_API_KEY ?? ''
        reranker:
          apiKey: !!js process.env.MEM_RERANKER_API_KEY ?? ''
        llm:
          provider: deepseek    # 必须与已注册的 llm 适配器路由一致
          model: deepseek-chat
```

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web --patch ./overlay.yml   # --dump-config 可检查最终组合
```

配置修改经 HMR 热重载生效（改 `config` 即卸载重载本插件，注册自动清理重建）。

### 方式 B：安装为组合包

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add C:/Users/you/Code/dsh_mem
```

包身份来自 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`；`remove` 同步移除。git 安装的授权坑（pnpm ≥10 `allowBuilds`）见 ref/README。

### 必要配置最小集

其余全部有 schema 默认值，通常只需：

1. `embedding.apiKey` + `reranker.apiKey`（或两者 `mode: deterministic`）；
2. `llm.provider` / `llm.model`：M5 判分与矛盾判定的调用路由，**必须是 ctx.llm 上已注册适配器的 provider 名**，模型随之有可用凭据。

### 确认插件在跑

- 启动日志：`[dsh-mem] started: 0 valid memories in store`；
- 每轮 `turn/end` 后（有写入时）：`turn N: wrote X, superseded Y, dropped Z`；
- 睡眠周期触发后：`sleep cycle: C clusters (M migrated, G gated), refreshed R records / N nodes, decayed R'/N'`；
- 聊天 UI 出现 `memory_search` 工具卡片；库非空且命中时，`memory_search` 结果与自动记忆 section 出现在上下文（语义节点带 `gist` 标记）；
- storage 后端介质上出现 `dsh-mem` unit。

## 评测：nDCG 四档消融（设计 §7.1）

数据格式（JSONL）：

```
corpus.jsonl   每行 {"id":"m01","text":"..."}          # id 可省略，自动编号
queries.jsonl  每行 {"query":"...","relevant":["m01","m09"]}
               # 或分级相关度 {"query":"...","relevant":{"m03":2,"m09":1}}
```

```sh
# deterministic 冒烟（离线，验证管线）
npm run eval:ndcg -- --corpus data/corpus.jsonl --queries data/queries.jsonl

# 真实端点（有语义意义的数字）
npm run eval:ndcg -- --corpus data/corpus.jsonl --queries data/queries.jsonl \
  --embedding-mode http --embedding-api-key $KEY \
  --reranker-mode http --reranker-api-key $KEY
```

deterministic 冒烟输出（数值仅证明四档可执行，**没有**语义意义）：

```
corpus=12 queries=8 embedding=deterministic reranker=deterministic
rung	nDCG@10	recall@50(L0 pool)
base	0.6124	1.0000
csls	0.6691	1.0000
rerank	0.6124	1.0000
full	0.5389	1.0000
```

验收目标：真实数据下 CSLS 档随库增大与 base 档拉开差距（hubness 恶化）；M5 判分另需人工标注集（Spearman ρ > 0.7），判分 prompt 已带 Generative Agents 锚定示例。

## 评测：睡眠周期（P1，QA 保留率与压缩存续）

```sh
# deterministic 冒烟（离线 echo LLM 替身，验证管线连通）
npm run build
npm run eval:sleep -- --corpus data/corpus.jsonl --queries data/queries.jsonl \
  --cluster-min-size 2 --cluster-cos 0.25
```

deterministic 嵌入是词袋哈希，同义句对余弦仅 ~0.27–0.35，冒烟需降低聚类阈值（如上）。输出（数值仅证明管线可执行，**没有**语义意义）：

```
corpus=12 queries=8 embedding=deterministic clusterCos=0.25 clusterMinSize=2
clusters=1 migrated=1 gated=0 compressed=2 nodes=1
  new_node   members=2 qaF1=0.941 gistEpi=0.745 memberEpi=0.533 node=e09d… :: GIST: Deployment delays…
QA-F1 of migrated clusters (retention, echo stand-in): 0.9412
mean epi drop of migrated clusters (detail forgetting):  -0.2112
nDCG@10 before=0.5389 after(remapped)=0.5474
```

- **QA-F1（保留率）**：迁移簇的平均 QA 闸门 F1——真实 LLM 下应 ≥ 0.8（闸门本身即按该阈值放行）；
- **epi 下降量**：成员均 epi − gist epi，即"细节遗忘量"（echo 替身的 gist 是成员原文回显，故为负；真实 gist 应为正）;
- **nDCG after(remapped)**：压缩后按"相关成员命中经其所属节点计数"重映射相关度再测——被压缩信息若仍能经语义节点召回，该值不显著低于 before（长程问答存续的代理指标）。

可调项：`--cluster-cos`、`--cluster-min-size`、`--qa-f1-threshold`、`--epi-threshold`；真实端点参数与 eval-ndcg 相同（`--embedding-mode http --embedding-api-key …`）。**真实 LLM 下的睡眠周期**（gist 抽取 / QA 闸门 / M4 兼容复核）需在宿主中以 `llm.provider` 指向已注册适配器运行，本脚本离线替身不覆盖该路径的语义质量。

## 评测：语义 vs 时间消融（P2，设计 §7.4 关键消融）

直接检验本项目核心假设——语义驱动的遗忘/检索优于 Generative-Agents 式时间衰减。数据格式：

```
corpus-times.jsonl   每行 {"id","text","imp"?,"time"?,"validAt"?,"invalidAt"?}
                     time/validAt/invalidAt = ISO 8601 或 epoch ms；
                     缺省 time 按行序在过去 30 天线性铺开（仅让时间 baseline 可执行）
queries-times.jsonl  每行 {"query","relevant":[id...],"at"?}
                     at = 时间旅行时点：semantic 臂检索该时点重建的记忆状态
```

```sh
npm run build
npm run eval:semtime -- --corpus data/corpus-times.jsonl --queries data/queries-times.jsonl
```

三臂：`semantic`（本插件全管线，含软失效与有效性模型）、`time`（GA recency 单因子 0.995^h）、`ga-product`（GA 完整乘积 imp × 0.995^h × cos）。两个 baseline 对**原始语料**排名——Generative Agents 没有取代/有效性模型，该差距本身是被测对象的一部分。deterministic 冒烟输出（数值仅证明三臂可执行，**没有**语义意义）：

```
corpus=8 queries=5 embedding=deterministic evalNow=2026-10-20T00:00:00.000Z recency=0.995^h
semantic  	nDCG@10=0.7328
time      	nDCG@10=0.4125
ga-product	nDCG@10=0.5752
time-anchored queries: 1 (resurfaced relevant ids via time travel: 1)
```

- `resurfaced`：时间旅行查询中，"当前视图已不可见（被软失效）但该时点有效"的相关记忆数——支柱五完整版的直接演示（示例数据里 2026-06 的 MySQL 记忆在 6 月时点重新可检索，而 8 月切换到 PostgreSQL 之后它被取代）；
- 验收目标：真实端点与真实标注下 semantic 显著优于两个时间 baseline（尤其"十年前的原则 > 一分钟前的闲聊"类查询）；LoCoMo 式端到端回放需活宿主 + 真实 LLM，见上文"尚未验证"。

## 开发

```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck                          # tsc --noEmit
npm test                                   # vitest run（全部 180 个）
npx vitest run tests/sleep-cycle.test.ts   # 单文件
npm run build                              # 产出 lib/
```

模块地图（全部相对导入带 `.js` 扩展，中文注释标注设计章节号）：

```
src/
  index.ts        插件入口（具名导出 name/inject/Config/apply；inject: storage,llm,tools,systemPrompt,sessions）
  config.ts       全超参 Config schema（Schemastery，默认值在 schema，无硬编码可调参数）
  types.ts        数据模型与共享接口（MemoryRecord/SemanticNode/ScoreCounters/RetrievableItem/Provider 接口）
  memory-store.ts ctx.storage KV 仓库 + 记录/节点软失效 + 检索宇宙与时间旅行视图 + 邻域统计（r_m/red）
  metrics.ts      cosine / CSLS / MMR / z 标准化 / sigmoid / QA-F1 纯函数
  vector-store.ts 精确 kNN 索引（P0 规模；接口留出 ANN 余地）
  retrieval.ts    四级检索管线 + 消融档（base/csls/rerank/full；L0 池 = 未压缩记录 + 语义节点；at 时间旅行选项）
  embedding.ts    嵌入/重排客户端（OpenAI 兼容 /embeddings、/rerank；deterministic 离线替身）
  llm.ts          内部 LLM 调用（ctx.llm 流服务 + BlockAssembler；适配器失败按终态 error/aborted 块识别）
  judges.ts       候选抽取 / M5 判分 / 矛盾判定（含 temporal 重叠）/ epi 词法 / gist 抽取 / QA 生成与作答 / M4 兼容复核（JSON 健壮解析 + 重试一次）
  scoring.ts      支柱一 S 完整动态（§2.1）：使用/抑制事件、arousal 乘法门、惰性兜底衰减、tier 跃迁 + M5 EMA 重判（ScoreKeeper）
  write-path.ts   写入管线（§5.1 七步 + §2.5 完整版：时间重叠闸 + 语义节点软失效；单候选失败不中断整轮）
  sleep-cycle.ts  睡眠巩固周期（§2.3 七步 + 第 7 步 S 兜底衰减；迁移带 compressed_at 归档时点）
  runtime.ts      编排：会话观察、agent 定域自动注入、ScoreKeeper 记账接线、睡眠周期触发
  tool.ts         memory_search 工具（含 at 时间旅行参数）+ section 文本渲染
```

实现选择说明：自动注入落在 `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall（agent 定域注册）而非 `ctx.systemPrompt.section()`——后者 text provider 是同步签名，承载不了异步检索链路；前者为官方文档同章节列出的扩展点。检索查询取自 `agent/inbox/claimed` 的待处理输入 ⊕ 最近对话尾部。

## 排障

| 现象 | 原因与处理 |
|---|---|
| 启动报 `storage backend '…' provides no kv facet` | profile 没有 storage 后端或 `storage.backend` 名不对：装 `dsh-storage-json`/`dsh-storage-sqlite` 并核对注册名 |
| 插件停在 PENDING 不加载 | `inject` 的服务（storage/llm/tools/systemPrompt/sessions）缺提供方；查 `--dump-config` 与启动日志 |
| 打开 unit 报 `version-mismatch` | `config.storage.version` 与介质上既有版本不一致；P1 仅向记录新增可选字段（旧记录缺字段按 undefined 容忍），保持 version=1 即可 |
| 判分调用失败（NO_ADAPTER / 空回复 / error finish） | `llm.provider` 未注册适配器或凭据失效；llm.ts 会抛出携带失败码的错误，见 dsh 日志 |
| 嵌入/重排 401、超时 | 核对 apiKey、endpoint、网络；临时可切 `deterministic` 模式隔离问题 |
| 睡眠周期从不触发 | `sleep.enabled` 为 false、新写入未达 `sleep.minNewMemories`、或聚类池小于 `clusterMinSize`；看启动后是否有 `sleep cycle:` 日志 |
| 睡眠周期全部 gated（qa_failed） | QA 闸门在拒绝：gist 质量不足（换更强判分模型）或 `qaF1Threshold` 过严；被拒簇已标 incompressible，需新成员加入才重试 |
| 压缩后检索不到原细节 | 设计行为：成员内容由节点 gist 承载（§2.3"记住要点、忘掉细节"）；回溯经 `flags.compressed_into` 索引原记录，或用 `memory_search` 的 `at` 参数在归档前的时点检索 |
| 记忆还在但排不上名 | tier 可能已沉到 cold（S 动态：长期未使用 + 兜底衰减）：cold 项需 CSLS cue ≥ `cueThreshold + coldCueBoost` 才保留；调 `tier.coldThreshold` / `score.decayTauDays`，或等使用事件把它推回 warm |
| `memory_search` 返回 `invalid 'at'` | `at` 需为 ISO 8601（以 4 位年份开头）或正整数 epoch ms；领域级错误写进规范值，不影响工具通道 |

## 明确不在 P2（后续里程碑）

messageFeedback"被采纳"确认制（S 增益目前按"未被纠正"默认即时入账，§5.0 所列 seam 的类型不在依赖集内）、LoCoMo 式活宿主端到端回放；语义图 PPR 联想检索、spacing 加权、sur、valence 情绪一致性检索（P3，设计 §6/§10）。

已知接受的取舍（P2）：跨写链并发 `updateRecord` 的丢失更新窗口延续 P1 声明（最坏一次 flag/计数/S 增量，可被下一周期自愈）；写入路径与睡眠周期可并发写同一 unit 的不同记录（KvUnit 单调用原子、整链不串行是宿主契约给调用方的自由度）；兜底衰减与全库统计刷新同门控（`sleep.enabled=false` 时离线维护整体停摆，事件路径的惰性衰减追补仍然生效）。

## 第三方组件与合规边界（不是许可证的一部分，但请一并阅读）

本项目（qq-bridge，将来的 QSH）采用 MIT 许可。**它不覆盖下列第三方组件**，这些组件各自
适用其原始许可，使用前请自行阅读并遵守：

| 组件 | 许可 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`@deepseek-ai/dsh`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 及其 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包 | MIT | DeepSeek Harness 本体与官方 API 客户端 |
| [`@snowluma/sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@snowluma/sdk) / [`@snowluma/mcp`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@snowluma/mcp) | ⚠️ **声明为 `SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE`，但包里没有 LICENSE 文件**（见下） | 本项目通过 npm 依赖使用；计划在 QSH 里**移除这两个依赖**（见下） |
| [SnowLuma](https://github.com/SnowLuma/SnowLuma) 本体 | SnowLuma 源码可见非商业许可（非 OSI 开源） | **本项目不在仓库内包含、也不分发 SnowLuma 的源码或二进制**，只通过 OneBot v11 协议与它通信（另只读其 `config/onebot_*.json` 以发现 token）。⚠️ 例外见下：`npm install` 会对两个 `@snowluma/*` **npm 包**的本地安装副本做一次机械修补（不触碰 SnowLuma 本体，也不触碰任何原生组件） |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`、`js-yaml`、`zod` 等 | MIT / ISC | 见各自包内 LICENSE |

#### ⚠️ 已知的依赖许可瑕疵（`@snowluma/sdk` / `@snowluma/mcp`）

**事实**（2026-09-20 实测，可自行复核）：

- 两个包的 `package.json` 都声明 `"license": "SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE"`；
- 但**发布的 npm 包里没有 LICENSE 文件**：`npm pack @snowluma/sdk --dry-run` 的文件清单只有
  `dist/`、`README.md`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`VERSIONING.md`；
- 原因在源头：仓库里 `packages/sdk/package.json` 与 `packages/mcp/package.json` 的 `files` 数组
  **没有包含 `LICENSE`**，且 `packages/sdk/LICENSE` 与 `packages/mcp/LICENSE` 在仓库中**不存在**（均 404）。

**这意味着什么**：这两个包的许可态**在包内不可判定**——`SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE` 指向一个不存在的文件。
但注意：SnowLuma LICENSE §1 对 "Software" 的定义是「the SnowLuma source code and assets **in this repository**」，
而 `packages/sdk` 与 `packages/mcp` **就在那个仓库里** ⇒ 它们在文本上**确实受同一份非商业许可约束**
（这是 §1 定义的直接结论，不是"推断"）。所以**移除依赖的理由比其他处理更硬**，不只是"消除不确定性"。

**本项目对它们的实际做法（据实陈述；不要写成"不修改"）**：

1. **仓库内不含、不分发**它们的代码：`node_modules/` 在 `.gitignore` 里，79 个已跟踪文件中
   没有任何原生二进制（`.node/.dll/.so`）或 `@snowluma` 路径下的文件；
2. **但 `npm install` 会改本地安装副本**：`postinstall` 运行 `scripts/patch-snowluma-sdk.mjs`，
   对 `node_modules/@snowluma/{sdk,mcp}` 的 `dist/**/*.js` 做**一次机械修补**（只给相对导入补 `.js`
   扩展名，绕开这两个包自身的 ESM 打包问题）。许可 §2(c) 允许"为自己的非商业使用而修改"，
   且**只作用于本机安装副本、不进入本仓库**；**所以"不修改 SnowLuma 的源码或二进制"这种说法是不准确的**，
   本项目文档已统一改为上述据实描述；
3. **在 QSH 里移除这两个依赖**（已列入 `QSH-plan` 的 M2 里程碑）——
   - `@snowluma/sdk` 在本项目里只用到两样东西：**1 处 WebSocket 客户端构造**（`bridge.js` 末尾）
     + **3 个 `text()` 调用点**（共 6 次调用；实测裸 `text(` 匹配数为 6；另有 3 个 `scripts/` 诊断脚本也 import 它）。
     OneBot v11 是公开协议规范，自己实现一个最小客户端即可（约 150 行 + 回归）；
     顺带可去掉 `postinstall` 补丁 —— ⚠️ **删依赖与换客户端必须同批落地**（补丁是 `postinstall` 载荷路径，
     只删依赖会让 `npm install` 或启动直接失败）；
   - `@snowluma/mcp` 在本项目里**运行时完全不用**（`src/` 里零引用，仅 `scripts/test-mcp-exec.mjs` 用到）
     ——改成**自建能力矩阵**（只取动作名与参数名这类接口事实，措辞自己写；
     ⚠️ **不要提交它的 `catalog.js` 快照**，那本身就是再分发其内容，会触发 §3(b)(c)）。
4. 若你要更彻底地消除不确定性，可以在给 SnowLumaDevs 的邮件里**顺带问一句**
   「`packages/sdk` 与 `packages/mcp` 适用哪个许可？」—— 这两个包**声明了却未附带**许可文件，
   属于他们该修的打包疏漏，以"用户反馈"的口吻问很自然。

### 使用风险提示

- SnowLuma 是独立第三方项目，与腾讯公司（Tencent）及 QQ **无任何隶属、合作、授权或背书关系**。
- 使用非官方协议工具接入第三方平台**可能违反该平台的服务条款并导致账号受限**，风险由使用者自负。
- 本项目会把 QQ 消息交给大语言模型处理，并可能让模型代替账号发言。请在
  [README.md](README.md) 与 [RULES.md](RULES.md) 说明的白名单/审计机制下使用，不要
  在未配置白名单的情况下直接暴露给任意群聊或陌生人。

#### 📡 数据出机清单（**完整列出，不要只看"发给 LLM"这一句**）

| 目的地 | 什么数据 | 默认 | 怎么关 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **本机 DSH**（默认 `127.0.0.1:3080`） | 群/私聊消息文本、图片、昵称、会话上下文 | 开 | 不运行 DSH 就没有这个桥接的意义 |

SnowLuma 采用「源码可见非商业许可」（[LICENSE](https://github.com/SnowLuma/SnowLuma/blob/main/LICENSE)，以中文为准）。

## 项目展示

## 架构

- **QQ 侧**：`@snowluma/sdk` 的 `SnowLumaWebSocketClient`（OneBot v11 WebSocket 客户端，自动重连）
- **DSH 侧**：适配 DSH 0.1.2 起引入、**0.2.0-rc.2 上逐项复核**的协议——用本机持久化签名密钥铸造会话 Cookie 鉴权、`/api/<namespace>/<method>` 斜杠 RPC、`/api/remote.mux` + `session/follow` 事件流（`session/control` 的队列读 `value.projections[<id>].values.inbox`，另有一元 `session/projections` 主路径）；复用 `AbstractApiClient` 传输层但不再依赖旧版 zod value schema。会话模型由桥接按 `config.json` 的 `dsh.model` 逐会话 `session.selectModel` 固定（默认 `deepseek-flash` = DeepSeek-V41-Flash，多模态）
- **agent 自主收发 QQ**：DSH 的 MCP 客户端（`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 配置）接入三个 MCP server：
  - `snowluma`（桥接自带 `src/mcp-snowluma-safe.js`）：QQ 动作**安全子集**（查状态/查群/查消息/发消息，发送强制白名单；发送工具支持可选 `replyToMessageId` 引用回复）
  - `snowluma-host`（桥接自带 `src/mcp-host-server.js`）：**只有** `snowluma_status`（只读探活 `get_login_info`）。
    ⚠️ **v0.1.5 起移除了 `start_snowluma` / `stop_snowluma`**（以及 `snowluma.allowProcessControl` 配置项）——
    原因是 **SnowLuma EULA §5.4** 规定「将其并入第三方安装包或 Docker 镜像、**通过自动化脚本部署**」
    须事先取得书面授权，而原生组件属专有组件。本程序**只探测、不部署**：SnowLuma 的安装、启动与扫码
    始终由你自己完成（详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 与 [RULES.md](RULES.md)）。
  - `web-search-safe`（桥接自带 `src/mcp-web-search-safe.js`）：只读 `web_search` / `web_fetch`（带 SSRF 防护），供 agent 查网络用语/资料。
    **搜索优先复用 DSH 原本的联网搜索**（同一个 DeepSeek Anthropic 兼容端点 + `web_search` 服务端工具，凭据按 `config.webSearch.apiKey` → 环境变量 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` → DSH 的 `.credentials.yaml` 顺序解析），
    因而结果质量与 DSH 内的搜索一致、且**不再默认把群聊关键词发给 Bing**（Bing RSS 只在 DeepSeek 不可用时兜底）。
    抓取仍由桥接自己做 SSRF 校验并限制正文大小；**黑话学习默认开启**，会把群聊里提取的词条交给所选的搜索后端。
    数据出机清单见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 的「数据出机清单」，不需要就关掉黑话自动研究（`slang.autoResearch`）或把 `webSearch.provider` 设为 `bing`。
- **会话模型**：每个 QQ 会话（私聊/群）对应一个独立的 DSH 会话，统一归组到「QQ 聊天」工作区（不再散落未分组）；映射持久化在 `state/sessions.json`
- **性格定制**：QQ 会话默认使用 `qq-chat` agent preset，`reserved2` 使用 `qq-chat-v2`。DSH 0.1.7 起 preset 不再是 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/<名>/` 目录，而是 `plugins/qq-agent-presets/` bundle 生成并插入 profile 的一条 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` 行（重启 DSH 后生效）；人格与默认 DSH 一致（coding agent），仅附加 QQ 场景规则；**角色扮演**是可选机制——由控制台或管理端设置 `state/current-role.json` 注入（群友无法更改）
- **本地控制台**：桥接自带 Web 控制台 `http://127.0.0.1:3100`——左侧按操作任务分为「运行总览 / 会话与审批 / 人格与角色 / 二代仿真 / 一代仿真 / 黑话词库 / 令牌与花费 / 访问与安全 / 调试与运维 / 工具参考」十个页面，右上角搜索框可跨页定位任意功能项；支持**浅色 / 深色双主题**（顶栏一键切换，未选择时跟随系统）；切换运行模式（chat / closed-agent / reserved / reserved2）、设置角色、静默开关、查看活动日志、修改管理员/控制台令牌，全部即时生效；访问需要令牌（`config.json` 的 `consoleToken`，未配置时自动生成并打印在启动日志；控制台内可手动修改或重新生成）
  - **令牌与花费看板**：实时显示 AI 的 token 消耗与折算金额（元），可下钻到**每个群 / 每个好友 / 每一轮对话**（轮次、步数、缓存命中/未命中输入、输出、命中率、花费、峰谷时段），并有**按时间的消耗走势图**（24 小时 / 3 天 / 7 天 / 30 天，柱子按高峰/空闲着色，一眼看出什么时候烧得凶、哪几个小时是 2 倍价）。累计总量取自 DSH 的 `tokenUsage` 投影（精确，含桥接启动前的历史），逐轮明细由 `assistant/message` 的 `usage` 折叠而来；金额按 DeepSeek 官方价目表折算并区分**高峰 / 空闲时段**（高峰单价为空闲的 2 倍，已内置中国法定节假日）。详见 [docs/guides/TOKEN_USAGE_CONSOLE.md](docs/guides/TOKEN_USAGE_CONSOLE.md)
  - **人格（角色扮演）管理**：列表点选即可载入查看/编辑提示词，支持新建、保存修改、改名（自动重命名文件）、另存为副本、删除；超过注入上限或含一代专用指令会实时提示
  - **两层提示词可分别查看与修改**：「仿真提示词」（预设内置，管行为与协议，保存后同步到 DSH，需重启生效）与「人格提示词」（`roles/*.md`，管人设与语气，保存即生效）；仿真层保存前做安全不变量校验与自动备份，可一键还原
  - **会话初始提示词**（二代仿真）：「二代仿真 → 初始提示词」里可以给某个群/私聊预写一段环境说明（圈子主题、群内氛围、常见话题、忌讳），AI **只在该会话第一次唤醒时收到一次**（之后已在会话上下文里，不再重复注入）。可在群还没说过话时提前写；AI 既读不到也改不了这份设置（仅控制台接口）。会话被重置（「会话映射」里的重置或「重置二代状态」）后，下一次首次唤醒会重新带上它。字数上限见 `socialV2.initialPromptMaxChars`
  - **DSH 思考强度**：默认 `max`，可选 `high` / `low`，档位从 DSH 实际公布的能力读取，保存后下一条消息生效；控制台会明示该设置同时写入 DSH 全局默认（`~/.dsh/settings.yaml`）
- **运行模式**：
  - `chat`：白名单群 + 白名单私聊 → qq-chat 安全聊天
  - `closed-agent`：仅私聊 owner（config.json 的 ownerQQ，可在控制台设置）→ 完整工具（默认用 DSH 自己声明的默认 preset，即 `standard`；可在控制台「closed-agent preset」下拉改为任意 DSH preset），可在 QQ 上操控 DSH
  - `reserved`（一代仿真）：仿真群友，观望/活跃/试探/退场状态机，选择性参与、按空格分句发送、主动收尾
  - `reserved2`（二代仿真，运行 `setup-dsh.mjs` 后 DSH 默认）：文本不自动转发，AI 通过 `qq_get_unread_messages` / `qq_send_message` 等工具自主看消息、发言、等待、设置唤醒/潜水；DSH 端使用 `qq-chat-v2` preset
- **交互增强**：
  - agent 通过 `ask_user_question` 提问时，问题会转发到 QQ，回复即自动应答
  - agent 请求工具审批时，转发到 QQ，回复「通过」/「拒绝」即可决策
  - 支持 DSH 斜杠命令（如 `/model`）与 `/reset`（重置会话上下文）
  - 群聊引用/回复会解析成「被引用人 + 原文」注入 DSH（如 `[引用 Derp：El Psy Kongroo是啥]机关的走狗`），让 AI 判断这句话是对谁说的，不会把群友之间引用第三方的对话误当成指向自己；引用机器人自己时会被视为必回
  - **图片/表情（含动图 GIF）**：表情包优先走 QQ 的 CDN 直链，`get_image` 失败时用 `emoji_id` 推出 CDN 地址兜底；媒体元数据保留 `emoji_id`/`summary`/`sub_type` 等字段。下载走同一套 SSRF 防护传输，并修掉了「DNS 先返回 IPv6、本机没有 IPv6 出口 → 每次白等 20 秒」的根因（改为 **IPv4 优先 + 逐地址故障切换**），动图表情不再时好时坏。单条消息上限默认 8MB / 64MP / 5 张（`socialV2.media`）
  - MCP 发送工具支持可选 `replyToMessageId`，并新增专用 `qq_reply` 工具：AI 可以先用 `qq_get_group_history` 拿到真实消息 id，再引用/回复某条消息（是否允许 AI 主动使用由人格/策略决定；桥接会检测发送类工具调用并自动跳过该回合的重复自动转发）
  - 一代仿真模式（`reserved`）下，AI 可以只输出 `[SILENT]` 表示“潜水/不接话”，桥接会静默不发送
  - 一代仿真模式（`reserved`）按空格分句：AI 用空格表示拆成多条消息；中英文/数字之间的空格也会被当成分条信号，不想分条就不要加空格（`reserved2` 不适用，分条请用 `qq_send_message` 数组）

## 前置条件

1. 运行中的 DeepSeek Harness Web（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`）
2. 运行中的 SnowLuma，且配置好 OneBot WebSocket 与 HTTP API（默认 `ws://127.0.0.1:3001` / `http://127.0.0.1:3000`，`accessToken` 视配置填写）
3. Node.js ≥ 22.13

## 安装与配置

```bash
npm install        # 安装依赖（postinstall 会自动修补 @snowluma/sdk 的 ESM 打包 bug）
```

复制 `config.example.json` 为 `config.json` 后编辑：

> Windows CMD 用户请用：`copy config.example.json config.json`

> ⚠️ 真实 `config.json` 与 `state/` 不会进入公开仓库，仓库只提供脱敏的 `config.example.json` 模板。

| 字段 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh.baseUrl` | DSH Web 地址，默认 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` |
| `dsh.provider` / `dsh.model` / `dsh.reasoningEffort` | DSH 会话使用的模型/推理强度；若你的 DSH 没有示例中的模型，改成 DSH 设置页里可用的模型即可（选择失败只打日志，不阻塞启动） |
| `dsh.authToken` | DSH launch token（进程启动凭据）。**通常应留空**：留空时桥接用 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 里持久化的签名密钥**离线铸造**会话 Cookie，不依赖任何进程期状态（DSH 0.1.7 起启动 token 只存在于内存、日志里那条是上一个进程的陈旧值，换 Cookie 只会 401）。只有显式填了才会优先走 token 交换 |
| `dsh.authHeader` / `dsh.authPrefix` | 保留字段，当前新版 DSH 链路使用 Cookie 交换，不再直接发送该鉴权头 |
| `snowluma.wsUrl` | SnowLuma OneBot **WebSocket** 地址（如 `ws://127.0.0.1:3001`） |
| `snowluma.httpUrl` | OneBot **HTTP API** 地址（如 `http://127.0.0.1:3000`）；不要填 WebSocket 端口，否则会报 HTTP 426 |
| `snowluma.accessToken` | OneBot accessToken，未配置留空 |
| `snowluma.followDiscoveredEndpoint` | 默认 `true`。换 QQ 账号后 token 与端口都会变，桥接会自愈：重新发现并**跟随** SnowLuma 的端点（同时写回 `config.json`）。**想跑第二个实例 / 指向另一份 SnowLuma 安装（多账号、测试）时设为 `false`** —— 那时只自愈 token，绝不动 URL，也不写回 URL。详见「已知行为」 |
| `snowluma.silenceWarnMs` | 上游静默告警阈值（毫秒），默认 `600000`（10 分钟）。已连接但这么久没收到任何事件包（含心跳）时打警告；这只是**提示**，不确定性的判断交给 `good` |
| `snowluma.launcherPath` / `homeDir` | SnowLuma 安装目录（用于 token/端点自发现）。⚠️ 桥接**不会**启动或停止 SnowLuma（见 `LICENSE`） |
| `agentPreset` | QQ 会话使用的 DSH agent preset，默认 `qq-chat`（改性格见下文） |
| `socialV2.agentPreset` | `reserved2` 模式使用的 DSH agent preset，默认 `qq-chat-v2` |
| `socialV2.initialPromptMaxChars` | 会话「初始提示词」（控制台为某个群/私聊预写的环境说明）的字数上限，默认 2000，允许 100~8000。越界值会在启动时收敛并保持原文件不动 |
| `socialV2.media` | 图片/表情的上限：`maxBytes`（单条消息总字节，默认 8MB）、`maxPixels`（单张像素，默认 64MP）、`maxCount`（单条最多处理几张，默认 5）。越界值启动时收敛 |
| `webSearch.provider` | 联网搜索后端：`auto`（默认，优先 DeepSeek、失败回退 Bing）/ `deepseek`（仅 DeepSeek，无凭据时报错）/ `bing` |
| `webSearch.apiKeyEnv` / `apiKey` | 搜索凭据的环境变量名（默认 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`）/ 直接写死 key（不推荐）。都不设置时读 DSH 的 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` 里同名 ref |
| `webSearch.baseURL` / `model` / `maxUses` / `maxResults` | 搜索端点（默认 `https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1`，必须 https 且解析到公网）、模型（默认 `deepseek-v4-flash`）、单次搜索最多用几次工具、返回条数上限 |
| `workspaceTitle` | QQ 会话在 DSH 界面中的归组名称，默认「QQ 聊天」 |
| `allow.private` / `allow.groups` | 白名单（QQ 号/群号数组）；留空且 `allowAllWhenEmpty: true` 时放行全部 |
| `deny.*` | 黑名单，优先于白名单 |
| `ackMessage` | 消息投递后的立即回复，空字符串关闭 |
| `sendDelayMs` | QQ 连续发送间隔，防止触发频率限制 |
| `consolePort` | 本地控制台端口，默认 `3100` |
| `consoleToken` | 控制台访问令牌；留空时启动自动生成并保存到 `state/console-token` |

> ⚠️ `allowAllWhenEmpty: true` 表示「白名单没填就全部放行」——把 agent 接入 QQ 等于把账号控制权交给了模型，建议先填白名单。

### DSH 端安装（必做：装 preset + 挂 MCP）

桥接和控制台能跑起来还不够，DSH 端还需要安装两个聊天 preset（`qq-chat` / `qq-chat-v2`）并挂载 MCP。**单机新装同样必须执行这一步**（不是只有「另一台设备」才需要），装完还要**重启 DSH**：

```bash
node scripts/setup-dsh.mjs
```

> 全新环境下脚本会把 DSH 默认模式设为 **`reserved2`（二代仿真）**，并创建本地 `state/mode.json` 兜底；这样 AI 使用 `qq_send_message` 等工具收发消息时，DSH 会自动使用 `qq-chat-v2` 模式。如果本机已存在旧的 `state/mode.json` 或 DSH 设置值，脚本会保留不覆盖。之后可在**桥接控制台**（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:3100`）顶部按钮切换模式，控制台会同时写入 DSH 设置与本地兜底文件。

详细步骤见 **[docs/guides/DSH_SETUP.md](docs/guides/DSH_SETUP.md)**。

## 完整启动流程（从零开始）

共 6 步。DSH 已安装并运行，缺的是 SnowLuma 本体 + 桥接侧的 DSH 端安装（**第 2、3 步最容易漏，漏了 QQ 上会毫无反应**）：

1. **DSH**（已运行，无需操作）
   确认 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` 能打开即可。

2. **装桥接并复制配置**
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/Derpyu520/qq-bridge.git
   cd qq-bridge
   npm install
   ```
   Windows CMD 用 `copy config.example.json config.json`，其他平台用 `cp config.example.json config.json`。
   **示例模板里 `allow.private` / `allow.groups` 是空数组**——空白名单 + `allowAllWhenEmpty: false` 时桥接不响应任何消息（这是刻意的 fail-closed 默认值）。白名单在第 5 步填。

3. **装 DSH 端（preset + MCP），然后重启 DSH**
   ```bash
   node scripts/setup-dsh.mjs
   ```
   装完**必须重启 DSH**——preset 与 MCP 只在 DSH 启动时加载。
   跳过这步桥接不会崩，但群聊会话拿不到 `qq-chat` preset，桥接会**拒绝建会话**（有意的安全设计：绝不回退到带 bash/文件工具的默认 preset），表现同样是 QQ 上没反应。

4. **下载并解压 SnowLuma**
   - 下载：<https://github.com/SnowLuma/SnowLuma/releases/latest> 选 `SnowLuma-v<版本>-win-x64.zip`（完整版，自带 Node 运行时；Lite 版需本机 Node 22.13+）
   - 解压到任意目录（例如 `C:\SnowLuma`），双击 `launcher.bat`

5. **首次引导（WebUI）+ 填写桥接配置**
   - 打开启动日志里的 WebUI 地址（README 写的是 `http://localhost:5099`，以你启动日志里实际打印的为准）
   - 用**启动日志中的初始密码**登录，按引导：同意条款 → 设置密码 → 接入 QQ 进程（扫码登录）
   - 在 WebUI 里配置 OneBot 连接：开启 **WebSocket 服务端** 和 **HTTP API**，分别记下**端口**（默认 WS `3001`、HTTP `3000`）和 **accessToken**（若配置了）
   - 回到 `config.json` 填好 `snowluma` 段，并把 `allow.private` / `allow.groups` 换成**你自己的 QQ 号 / 群号**：

     ```json
     "snowluma": {
       "wsUrl": "ws://127.0.0.1:3001",
       "httpUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:3000",
       "accessToken": "你在 WebUI 里配置的 token（没配置就留空）"
     }
     ```

   `wsUrl` 是 OneBot **WebSocket** 端口，`httpUrl` 是 OneBot **HTTP API** 端口（不要填成同一个 WS 端口，否则 MCP 工具会报 HTTP 426）。

6. **启动桥接**
   ```bash
   npm start          # 前台运行（崩溃不自动重启）
   ```
   看到 `SnowLuma 已连接` 即成功；然后 QQ 上给机器人账号发条消息测试。
   Windows 想要「崩溃自动重启」请改用 `start.bat`（见下节）。

里面是拆件伪骨骼动画的立绘（`assets/pet/whale/` 的 30 张立绘件 + 25 个表情件，由 Coopanion 的

## 运行与运维

```bash
npm start          # 或双击 start.bat（守护模式：崩溃自动重启，关闭窗口即停止）
```

**⚠️ 重要**：
- **桥接只能运行一个实例**（有单实例锁，重复启动会被拒绝并提示"已有实例在运行"）
- **用 start.bat 启动**（守护模式），窗口别关——桥接崩溃会在 5 秒后自动拉起
- 桥接异常/消息无反应时：双击 `restart.bat`（自动杀旧实例 → 清理锁 → 重新启动守护）
- **重启 DSH 通常不需要动桥接**：每 5 秒探活，DSH 不可用期间收到的 QQ 消息在桥接进程内排队（最多 50 条/会话，满后丢最旧项），恢复后尝试补投。桥接进程退出会丢失内存队列；断线期间已经结束的回复暂不保证补发。
- 修改 `config.json` / `roles/` / `state/current-role.json` 后重启桥接生效；修改 `dsh/agent-presets/`（改完要跑 `node scripts/build-agent-preset-patches.mjs` 重新生成 bundle patch）或 MCP 配置后重启 DSH 生效

12:00:02 [bridge] 新会话 private:12345678 -> sess_xxxx
12:00:02 [bridge] 已投递 private:12345678: 你好

## SnowLuma 版本与上游健康（「连上了但收不到消息」）

「注入」在这个技术栈里只发生在一处：**SnowLuma 用原生组件挂进 QQ 客户端进程**（它自己日志里叫
`[Hook]`，载体是安装目录的 `native/snowluma-win32-x64.{dll,node}`）。**本桥接没有任何原生/注入面**
（依赖全为纯 JS，源码里没有 `.dll` / `.node` / FFI / 进程注入），也不启动、不控制 SnowLuma 或 QQ ——
所以「QQ 注入失败」不可能是本桥接造成的。但**桥接过去无法把这个失败讲清楚**，于是它经常被误报成
「qq-bridge 的问题」。现在桥接会主动把上游健康报出来。

### 已知行为：连上了 ≠ 收得到

SnowLuma 的 `[Hook]` 会退化：它的进程和 OneBot WebSocket **都还活着**，但收不到 QQ 侧的数据。
它自己的日志长这样：

```
WARN [Hook] receive path stale: PID=… UIN=… silentFor=136193ms; reporting good=false
WARN [Hook] process enumeration timed out after 4000ms (worker abandoned)
```

这时桥接这边**一切正常**：WebSocket 通、日志打过 `SnowLuma 已连接`、控制台没有异常，但群里一条消息都不来。
桥接现在对此做两件事：

1. **主信号**：每 30 秒一次的 `meta_event/heartbeat` 载荷里的 `status.good`（SnowLuma 对「QQ → 原生 hook → 我」这条**接收链路**的自评，静默约 105 秒后翻 `false`）。心跳是 SnowLuma 自己的定时器无条件发的，所以这条信号免费且及时，且不需要较新的运行时。
   兜底：每 60 秒问一次 `get_status`（`{online, good}`）。加分项：`bot_status`（账号会话上下线，**SnowLuma 1.14.20 才真的有**）+「距最近一个事件包的时长」（只能证明进程/WS 还活着，**不能**证明收得到 QQ 数据 —— 心跳会一直来）。
   > ⚠️ **不要用 `get_login_info` 取 `good`**：它只返回 `{user_id, nickname}`，而 SDK 不校验 data 载荷 ⇒ 不会报错、`good` 永远是 `null`、这条判断变成永不触发的死代码。（本功能的第一版实现正是这么写错的，回归里已加反面断言钉住。）
2. 判定退化时：日志打**明确指向 SnowLuma `[Hook]`** 的警告、控制台「运行总览」出现 `SnowLuma 上游` 卡片、
   「访问与安全」页出现告警条，`GET /api/status` 的 `snowluma` 字段给出 `degraded` / `good` / `hint`。

排查顺序：控制台看 `SnowLuma 上游` 卡片 → 看 SnowLuma 的 `logs/snowluma-*.log` 里的 `[Hook]` 行 → 再考虑升级 SnowLuma（**升级不换原生组件，见下**）。

### 版本要求

| 组件 | 要求 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SnowLuma **运行时**（QQ 网关本体） | **1.14.20 已实测**（1.14.9 亦兼容） | **实测记录（2026-10-03，SnowLuma 1.14.20 + QQ 在线）**：包 SHA256 与官方发布摘要一致；心跳 `status.good=true`／`interval=30000`；桥接走完「首次 1006 → 自愈 WS token → 已连接」；收到群消息（`lastPacketKind: message/group`）；完整往返成功（唤醒 → DSH 建会话挂 `qq-chat-v2` → 工具发送 1/1 条 → 实际发出两条回复）。 ⚠️ **升级运行时不会更换注入用的原生组件**：实测 `native/snowluma-win32-x64.{dll,node}` 与 `websocket-win32-x64.node` 在 **1.14.9 与 1.14.20 之间逐字节完全相同**（三方对比：官方 1.14.9 包 == 本机安装 == 官方 1.14.20 包），变的只有 `index.mjs`（+414 KB）等 JS 层。所以**升级能带来 OneBot 事件流水线、收发与新区块链路上的修复（`bot_status`、markdown 带 text、事件种类订阅更全），但不会修「原生 hook 挂不上 QQ」这类问题** —— 那种要走 SnowLuma 自己的排查。**升级 SnowLuma 是使用者自己的事**：本桥接只探测、不部署（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 与 [RULES.md](RULES.md)） |
| `@snowluma/sdk` / `@snowluma/mcp`（本仓库依赖） | 已钉 `^1.14.20` | 客户端库；OneBot v11 是稳定契约，新库可连旧运行时（本项目实测：库 1.14.20 + 运行时 1.14.9 可正常收发） |
| `bot_status`（账号上下线） | **1.14.20 有；1.14.9 没有** | 逐一核对的只有这两个版本：`bot_status` 在 1.14.9 的 `index.mjs` 里出现 **0** 次、1.14.20 里 **3** 次（带 `sub_type`/`user_id`）。**具体从哪个版本引入未逐版核对**。桥接对老运行时**优雅降级**：订阅不到就只靠心跳 `good` 与 `get_status` |

### 已知行为：HTTP token 与 WS token 是**两个不同的值**

SnowLuma 同一个账号的 **HTTP token（默认 3000 端口）与 WebSocket token（默认 3001 端口）并不相同**
（实测；`snowluma.accessToken` 里通常只能存一个 —— 存的是 HTTP 那个）。因此：

- **桥接每次启动的首次 WS 连接几乎必然失败一次**（日志里 `SnowLuma 连接断开（code=1006）` →
  `SnowLuma 首次连接未成功（将在后台自动重连并尝试自愈 WS token）`），随后自愈重新发现 WS token、
  重连成功，才打出 `SnowLuma 已连接`。**这条序列是正常的，不是故障。**
- 真正会一直连不上的情况：**自愈无从下手** —— `snowluma.homeDir` 没配 / 被移动 / 读不到
  SnowLuma 的 `config/onebot_<QQ号>.json`，或权限不足。这时日志里会有 `token 自愈失败`，
  而 QQ 侧表现为**完全收不到消息**。先确认 `homeDir` 指向真正的 SnowLuma 安装目录。

### 已知行为：端点自愈会覆盖你写的 `wsUrl`

换 QQ 账号后 OneBot 端口与 token 都会变，所以桥接在连不上时会自愈：重新发现 SnowLuma 的端点并
**写回 `config.json`**。这在主场景下是对的，但它不区分「配置里是个过期值」和「你就是要指向别处」——
想跑第二个实例或指向另一份 SnowLuma 安装时会连错账号。要关掉：

```json
"snowluma": { "followDiscoveredEndpoint": false }
```

关掉后**只自愈 token**（换账号仍能恢复），绝不动 URL、也不写回 URL。

## 已知限制

- agent 回复在回合结束时一次性发送（不做流式逐字转发）；回复超过 `socialV2.send.maxMessageChars`（默认 500 字，可用 `social.maxReplyChars` 调整）自动按句读/URL 边界分段
- 图片及部分表情可以通过安全下载接入多模态模型；语音/视频以及无法取得图片字节的消息仍使用占位文本
- **发**语音是支持的（独立工具的图形界面 / 命令行 / AI 工具，见 `docs/README.md` 的文档索引）；但**收**到的语音目前只显示占位文本，不做语音转写入上下文
- **AI 发语音默认关闭**（`socialV2.voice.enabled` 与 `tools.sendVoice` 默认 `false`）：先把音频放进 `audio/`，再到控制台打开开关；你自己发语音不受这个开关影响
- agent 的 Markdown 回复会转成纯文本（链接保留 `文字 (url)` 形式）
- `@snowluma/sdk` 的 npm 发布版存在 ESM 扩展名 bug，本仓库通过 postinstall 补丁修复（见 `scripts/patch-snowluma-sdk.mjs`）

## 合规提醒

SnowLuma 是独立第三方项目，与腾讯/QQ 无隶属关系，仅供学习与技术研究；使用前请阅读其 EULA 与《QQ 用户协议》。

# dsh-peak-cost [![CI](https://github.com/ogidimitrov/dsh-peak-cost/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ogidimitrov/dsh-peak-cost/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://github.com/ogidimitrov/dsh-peak-cost/actions/workflows/release.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ogidimitrov/dsh-peak-cost/releases) [![CodeQL](https://github.com/ogidimitrov/dsh-peak-cost/actions/workflows/codeql.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ogidimitrov/dsh-peak-cost/security/code-scanning) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) A [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/guide/quickstart) plugin that adds one ambient line under the composer: ```text ● Off-peak · ≈ $0.338 · bal $7.27 ``` ![The composer dock line in DeepSeek Harness: peak status, session estimate and account balance, to the right of the shipped step counter and token meter](assets/composer-dock.png) It answers three questions about the session you are in: 1. **Is DeepSeek billing in peak hours right now?** 2. **How much has this session cost so far, in US dollars?** 3. **What is left in your DeepSeek account?** Hovering the line opens a panel with the cost attribution: the billing window and the time until it flips, the account balance and both wallets, and a per-category table showing what each kind of content cost when it first entered the context versus what it costs on every later call that re-sends it. The screenshot above is unedited: the line sits beside the shipped turn/step counter and token meter, and reads `● Off-peak · ≈ $0.338 · bal $7.27` for a session at 9 turns and 264 steps with a 99.6% cache hit rate.

## Behavior | | | |---|---| | Slot | `conversation.composer.dock` (below the composer card, beside the shipped activity and context-usage entries) | | Scope | Per session | | Updates | Spend follows every settled model call; the status label re-evaluates against the clock every 30 s; the balance refreshes every 60 s | | Locales | English and Chinese, following the app's language setting | ### Balance Next to the session estimate the line also shows your DeepSeek account balance: ```text ● Off-peak · ≈ $0.18 · bal ¥7.26 ``` It is read from the Host's account Remote (`ctx.remote.account.getBalance`) every 60 seconds and whenever the window regains focus — the same call the Settings → Account page makes — and **both wallet kinds are summed**: the recharge wallet plus any bonus/grant wallet, which is why it can differ from a single number on a top-up page. The panel always lists both. The account face is a Typert Remote namespace rather than a plain service, so the plugin captures it through a scoped `ctx.inject(['remote.account'], …)` and still falls back to `ctx.remote.account` on the root context. That keeps it independent of load order: the cost line renders immediately, and the balance appears as soon as the transport is reachable. The balance is optional in every direction: a signed-out account, an API-key-only setup, a failed read, or a build without the account transport all simply drop it, leaving the cost line intact. Nothing is cached to disk. ## Where the money went Hovering the line opens a themed panel (fixed-positioned above the composer, closes on leave or Escape) with the attribution: ```text Content In context First time Re-sent Tool results 40k $0.021 $0.0047 Web results 18k $0.0014 $0.0110 Assistant replies 12k $0.0048 $0.00 Your messages 4.2k $0.0003 $0.0028 Model thinking 6k $0.0024 $0.00 Tool schemas 8.8k $0.0013 $0.00 System prompt 1.4k $0.0002 $0.00 Model output $0.028 Session total $0.423 ``` Each row answers two different questions: - **First time** — what that content cost when it entered the context, billed as cache-miss input, once. - **Re-sent** — what it has cost on every later call that carried it, billed as cache-hit input. So "what did the web search data cost in this session?" is one row: the first fetch at the miss rate plus every re-send at the hit rate. A search result that arrives once and stays in the conversation is billed as input exactly once and as cache for the rest of the session — which is why 18k tokens of web data cost about a cent rather than 18 × the input rate. ### How the split is made Every call reports real billed usage. The fold keeps a running estimate of the context by category and splits each call's prompt: - **cache-miss tokens** go to the content added since the previous call, proportional to its size — a new search result, a new tool output, a new reply; - **cache-hit tokens** go to everything already in context, proportional to its size. Per-call totals are the provider's own numbers, so category costs add up to the real bill and only the split between categories is an estimate (four characters per token). Output is listed separately because it is not context. Replaced or compacted content is subtracted as it leaves the context, so the "In context" column tracks the live surface rather than a running sum. ## Install The package is a Harness **bundle**: it declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and a `dsh.client` half, so installing it in a profile mounts both the Host projection and the Web entry. Install the package spec `github:ogidimitrov/dsh-peak-cost` as a bundle — from the Plugins page of the app, or from an agent session through the plugin manager's `install_bundle` action with that spec as the target. The plugin needs a Harness build that provides the session projection registry, the `conversation.composer.dock` slot, and the client locale service — that is, the current DeepSeek Harness desktop/web app. It has no npm dependencies and no build step. To remove it, uninstall the bundle from the same Plugins page. ## How the number is computed Money is not inferred on the client from a token total. The Host half folds the durable session log and registers one session projection, `peakCost`, whose wire view carries the cumulative spend. The Client renders that value; it never re-folds events, so the figure survives paging, reloads, and compaction. Each `assistant/message` in the log is priced on its own: - **model** — from the message's own provider metadata, so a session that switches between `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro` stays correct; - **tokens** — cache-miss input, cache-hit input, cache-write, and output are priced separately from the provider-reported usage (falling back to the usage chunk in the message's stream); - **billing window** — from the message's own timestamp, so a session that crosses a peak boundary is priced correctly in both windows; - **discount** — off-peak rates are half of peak rates. Because the fold is a pure function of committed events, replay and fork produce the same figure. ### Cache hits are part of the calculation Harness sends the whole conversation on every model call, so a long session burns a large prompt each time — and nearly all of it is a **cache hit**, billed at the hit rate rather than the input rate. That discount is the whole reason one session can move millions of prompt tokens for cents. A real session from this plugin, mid-conversation, off-peak on `deepseek-flash`: | | tokens | rate (off-peak) | cost | |---|---|---|---| | cache-miss input | 184,312 | $0.15 / 1M | $0.028 | | cache-hit input | 21,805,952 | $0.003 / 1M | $0.065 | | output | 102,878 | $0.60 / 1M | $0.062 | | **total** | | | **$0.155** | The same 22M prompt tokens billed without prompt caching would be **$3.36** at the miss rate; the per-row **First time** / **Re-sent** split in the panel shows the same discount for the session you are looking at. ### Why this number and your balance can disagree The figure is a **list-price equivalent**, computed from the session log; it never reads your wallet. Three things make a wallet diverge from it: - **Granted or bonus credit is consumed first.** DeepSeek deducts from granted/bonus balances before a topped-up balance, so a topped-up number can stay flat while usage accrues. - **The balance is not streamed.** It is read on demand from the platform; a panel left open shows what it read. - **Not every call is in the log.** Session-title generation and some compaction work never commit an `assistant/message`, so they cost money this estimate cannot see. Use the platform's usage page for the authoritative charge; this line is for watching a session's shape while it runs. ### Rates and calendar Defaults follow [DeepSeek's published pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/) (USD per 1M tokens): | Model | Cache hit | Cache miss | Output | |---|---|---|---| | `deepseek-flash` | 0.006 | 0.30 | 1.20 | | `deepseek-v4-pro` | 0.044 | 1.32 | 3.96 | Peak hours are **01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday**, excluding Chinese public holidays. Every other hour, all weekend, and Chinese public holidays are off-peak. Off-peak prices are half of the table above. Both the rates and the calendar are constants at the top of [`index.js`](index.js): - `MODEL_RATES` — add or change a model card when DeepSeek changes prices; - `PEAK_WINDOWS`, `PEAK_WEEKDAYS_ONLY` — the billing calendar; - `PEAK_HOLIDAYS` — Chinese public holidays as UTC `YYYY-MM-DD`. **Empty by default**: on a holiday the indicator reports "peak" while billing is actually off-peak, until you add the dates. Legacy aliases (`deepseek-v4-flash`, and the older `-chat` / `-reasoner` names) bill at the flash card. ## Known limitations - **An estimate.** It prices reported tokens at list rates. It is not a bill: nothing here reads your balance or the provider's invoice. - **Only settled model calls count.** Calls that never commit an `assistant/message` — session-title generation, some compaction work — are not in the log and are not counted. Failed attempts that report usage without a settled message are likewise skipped. - **One session.** Subagent sessions have their own logs and their own dock lines; this number is the session you are looking at. - **Unknown routes.** A model id that matches no card is counted in the message total but priced at zero; the tooltip reports how many. - **Search/Fetch.** Standalone Search and Fetch API charges are not modelled. ## Development ```bash npm test # node --test: fold semantics, window edges, wire schema, client rendering ``` The suite needs nothing beyond Node 22+: - [`test/fold.test.mjs`](test/fold.test.mjs) drives the Host fold directly — peak edges, weekends, cache buckets, model routing, unknown routes, stream fallback, checkpoint safety; - [`test/client.test.mjs`](test/client.test.mjs) loads the client module with a stubbed module loader and React, then renders the dock entry against projection values shaped like the wire view. Bundle layout: ```text index.js Host half: the `peakCost` session projection client.js Client half: the composer-dock entry and locale dictionaries cordis.patch.yml Loader row inserted by the bundle locale/{en,zh}.json Plugin Manager title and description icon.svg Plugin artwork ``` ## License MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

# dsh-advisor

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/dsh-advisor)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-advisor)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-339933.svg)
![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.1--rc.3-4B32C3.svg)
![dsh tui](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh%20tui-compatible-4B32C3.svg)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/omdsh-dev/dsh-advisor)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/omdsh-dev/dsh-advisor?ref=badge)

A standalone dsh (DeepSeek Harness) plugin bundle porting the omp "advisor" subsystem: a per-session independent reviewer model that observes the primary transcript, reviews each stepped turn with an explicitly configured model (provider + model are required), and injects severity-ranked advice (nit / concern / blocker) back into the session. After each completed turn it can also predict your likely next prompt and show it as a one-click suggestion tip below the web composer (web GUI only). Neither surface pollutes or recursively reviews itself.

**Advisory only.** The advisor never approves or rejects the primary agent's actions, and never issues commands as if it were the primary agent. Every delivered message is self-described advisory content, and a misbehaving reviewer is bounded end to end (emission guard, immuneTurns cooldown, failure policy) so it can never stall or pollute the primary loop.

Works in both dsh front ends: the **web** profile (sidebar → Plugins → dsh-advisor → Advisor card) and the **dsh-tui** terminal profile (`/advisor` + `/advisor config`).

## Quick start

### Install

#### Web / Desktop (Plugins page)

In the dsh web client or the desktop app, open the sidebar **Plugins** page, use **Add plugin**, enter the package name `dsh-advisor`, press **Install**, then **Enable now**.

#### `dsh` CLI

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-advisor      # web profile (Settings → Advisor card)
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add dsh-advisor  # dsh-tui terminal profile

dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-advisor@latest   # update — the same --profile flag picks the target
```

Same plugin, either front end — the only difference is the `--profile` flag. Pin a version with `@<version>` (e.g. `dsh-advisor@0.1.0`). A registry install fetches the published tarball, which ships the built artifacts (`lib/` + `cordis.patch.yml`) — nothing builds on the target machine, and runtime dependencies (`@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peers) resolve through the dsh installation's flat profile module fallback — no extra install step. Registry / git / tarball / local-directory variants (local-dir from a built checkout: `dsh plugin --profile web add .` or `dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add .`), web Settings exposure, uninstall, and `--dump-config` verification → [docs/install.md](docs/install.md).

### Configuration

Edit the `config` of the `advisor` row in your profile's patch layer (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`). All nine fields are schema-volatile live fields (dsh ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1): the web card and the TUI `/settings` screen write this same entry config — persisted in the profile patch, committed without a remount. (A pre-0.1.7 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` `advisor:` section no longer exists: dsh imports it into the active profile once and renames the file `.imported`.)

> **Breaking change (2026-09-26): the `enabled` config key was removed.** The plugin-row enable/disable toggle in the host UI is the master switch — a running row is enabled, and there is nothing left to configure for it. A stored profile still carrying an `enabled:` line keeps working: the line is **silently ignored** (accepted, never read, never re-persisted — 2026-09-27 ruling, no manual deletion needed); the key is deprecated and the write paths no longer persist it.

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml — the advisor row's config
- id: advisor
  config:
    provider: deepseek-official  # REQUIRED (non-empty) for the advisor to run
    model: deepseek-flash        # REQUIRED (non-empty); fallback: deepseek-v4-flash (or another V4 id) until the gateway enables the V41 route
    systemPrompt: ""             # optional; "" = built-in reviewer prompt
    immuneTurns: 3               # int ≥ 0, default 3 — cooldown after a delivered steer
    maxDeltaMessages: 60         # int ≥ 0, default 60 — delta window; 0 = unbounded
    proseFallback: false         # boolean, default false — deliver a frame-less prose reply as a nit note (opt-in)
    reasoningEffort: ""          # optional; absent/"" = automatic — the smallest thinking effort the selected model declares (values: that model's declared effort ids)
    nextPrompt: true             # boolean, default true — predict the next prompt and show it as a tip below the web composer (web GUI only)
    defaultEnabled: true         # boolean, default true — new sessions start enabled; false = opt-in per session (enable with /advisor on)
```

`provider` and `model` are **mandatory**: either missing or empty is a hard gate — the advisor never starts a model call and reports a disabled-with-reason status; unknown config keys are rejected.

There is **no model-side token budget** (2026-10-18 user ruling): on OpenAI-compatible APIs `max_tokens` caps reasoning + content together, so with thinking models the old `maxTokens` budget intermittently starved the final content (empty reply → `EMPTY_RESPONSE` → silent delta drops). The advisor call sends no `maxTokens` at all; output is bounded at extraction by `ADVISOR_NOTE_MAX_CHARS` (768 chars) and latency by the 60 s call deadline. A `maxTokens:` line still present in a stored profile is tolerated and silently dropped, like the removed `enabled` key.

If the advisor is enabled and its runtime looks healthy but it never speaks, check `/advisor status`: a non-zero `Dropped:` line names the class — `empty` replies mean the model returned a completed response with no content, `unparsed` replies mean prose without a JSON frame is being dropped (enable `proseFallback`, which delivers the cleaned prose as a low-severity note; JSON frames stay primary). Details → [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md).

The same keys are read and edited from **three surfaces** (one store — the advisor entry config above; every surface shares the same hard gate, with the host-side gate as the final line of defense on every path; the web-only prediction key is deliberately absent from the `/advisor config` readback and the TUI section — it is web-surface-only):

1. **Plugin-row config** — the profile patch layer (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`). This is where the config lives.
2. **dsh web Plugins page — the dsh-advisor bundle's own page** — the Advisor **card** (bundle key `dsh-advisor`), a flat settings form (the page's title/description come from the plugin's locale meta) with provider / model selects restricted to system-configured providers and their models, and the optional fields. Saving writes the advisor entry's config (landed through the config editor into the profile patch) and applies to running sessions immediately — no restart. The card requires a dsh web build whose shell declares the `plugins.bundle.config` card slot (dsh ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1) and loads packages that declare `dsh.client`; it reads and writes the config through the official `GatewayService` RPC channel (`/api/advisor/get` + `/api/advisor/set`), which is not gated by the settings exposure allowlist. It additionally blocks saving while a required field is empty.
3. **`/advisor` command** — per-session and ephemeral: it flips a session override and pins a per-session reviewer model, never the persisted config (see [Verify](#verify)).

In a **dsh-tui** profile seven keys are editable in the TUI `/settings` screen: run `dsh --profile dsh-tui`, open `/settings`, and edit the **Advisor** section (`provider` / `model` / `immuneTurns` / `maxDeltaMessages` / `proseFallback` / `defaultEnabled` / `reasoningEffort`, each with zh/en label + hint). Edits are staged and written on save through the revision-fenced `settings.mutate` into the same advisor entry config the web card writes, and re-apply live without a restart. `systemPrompt` is NOT a TUI field (the TUI text control is single-line; a multi-line prompt would be truncated) — edit it via the web card or the profile patch layer. The section requires dsh-tui ≥ v0.8.0 (shipped in the `dsh-tui-settings-sections` row of the v0.8.0+ bundle); older dsh-tui versions no-op it cleanly and the profile patch layer remains the edit path. `/advisor config` stays a read-only readback whose edit hint names the `/settings` screen when the seam is mounted. Save behavior differs from the web card: the TUI seam has no cross-field validation, so a save may leave `provider`/`model` empty — the explicit model gate resolves that to disabled-with-reason at runtime (visible via `/advisor status` and `/advisor config`); the web card blocks such a save outright. Full reference → [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md).

![Advisor card on the dsh web Plugins page (the dsh-advisor bundle page)](docs/screenshots/advisor-settings-card.webp)

### Verify

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # shows a "# == dsh-advisor" layer with the advisor row
```

With the advisor installed and its plugin row enabled (the row switch on the Plugins page is the master switch), control it in-session with the `/advisor` command (available when a command registry is composed):

```
/advisor            toggle the advisor for this session
/advisor on         enable the advisor for this session
/advisor off        disable the advisor for this session
/advisor status     show state, model, runtime status, pending count, last activity, and drop counters when non-zero
/advisor model      show the effective reviewer model and its source (session override or global default)
/advisor model set <provider> <model>   pin a reviewer model for this session only
/advisor model reset    drop the session pin and re-inherit the global defaults
```

`/advisor on|off|toggle` are session-scoped and ephemeral: they flip a per-session override, never the persisted config. Enabling a session whose config lacks `provider`/`model` starts no model call — `/advisor status` (and the `/advisor on` reply) shows the gate reason: the advisor runs only with both configured. `/advisor on` is also the manual recovery path: a session advisor paused by a quota/rate-limit (`quota_exhausted` — no auto-resume timer) resumes in place, and a halted advisor (permanent model error, e.g. invalid credentials) is rebuilt fresh for the session.

`/advisor model set` pins a reviewer model for the **invoking session only** — an in-memory, atomic `provider + model` pair that lives for the live session (cleared on dispose, owner teardown, cold resume, or restart; a forked/new session inherits the global defaults). It rides above the persisted global defaults without rewriting them: a complete session pair is used even when the global config has no pair yet, a malformed global config still blocks every session, half-pairs are never merged, and setting/resetting never touches the enable switch. Validation resolves the pair through the LLM service before commit (60 s bound, cancellable, no auto-retry); on failure the previous selection stays untouched. `/advisor config` remains the readback of the **global defaults**, not the session state.

In a **dsh-tui** profile, `/advisor config` additionally reads back the composed configuration — the global defaults, read-only, with edit hints naming the real write paths: the TUI `/settings` screen (Advisor section, dsh-tui ≥ v0.8.0) and the profile patch layer. The `/advisor` / `on|off|status|config|model` commands are listed in the TUI `/` menu with subcommand completion (command discovery requires the `dsh-tui-command-trees` row — the shipped dsh-tui bundle has it).

On the **web**, the same session model controls ride the session header's **Advisor action** (requires a dsh web build whose shell declares the `conversation.session.header.actions` slot — dsh ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1). The action is bound to the session it sits on: it shows the effective reviewer pair, its source (`session override` / `global default`), and the live-session lifetime; **Pin this model** pins a provider + model for that session, and **Use global default** drops the pin (the reset path). It writes ONLY through the plugin's session endpoints (`/api/advisor/getSession` + `/api/advisor/setSessionModel`) — the same controller, validation, and fencing as `/advisor model`, never the persisted config — and it never falls back to the global config write when the session surface is unavailable. The control refreshes when you open it (plus on reconnect/focus while open); there is no background polling. The global card on the Plugins page stays global-only.

![Session header Advisor action popover showing the effective reviewer pair, its source, and the pin controls](docs/screenshots/advisor-session-action.webp)

## Features

- **Independent reviewer per session**: a separate model call observes the primary transcript and reviews each stepped primary turn; advisor messages are excluded from later deltas, so the advisor does not read its own advice back. The exclusion recognizes the advisor's current producer kind (`advisor`) AND both historical shapes a still-openable log can carry: the prehistoric direct `{ kind: 'advisor' }` note and the 0.1.6-era note as the V3→V4 in-memory migration rewrote it (`kind: 'plugin:advisor'`) — no generation of persisted notes is orphaned by the identity migration.
- **Severity-ranked advice with inject/steer semantics**: at most one note per review — **nit** (a minor style, clarity, or quality suggestion; delivered via non-waking `agent.inject`, consumed at the next pre-step boundary), **concern** (a material risk or clearly better direction to weigh before continuing; delivered via waking `agent.steer`, subject to the `immuneTurns` cooldown), **blocker** (continuing clearly wastes work — contradicts an explicit user instruction, going in circles, fundamentally unsound; delivered via `agent.steer`). Delivered messages carry the `[advisor:{severity}]` prefix and are self-described advisory content:

  ```
  [advisor:concern] extract the helper into a module and unit-test it
  ```

- **Explicit model gate**: a missing `provider` + `model` never starts a model call — status reports disabled-with-reason. The gate applies to the *effective* route after session resolution: a complete per-session override pair satisfies it for that session; a malformed global config cannot be bypassed. Unknown config keys are rejected — the removed `enabled` key is the one legacy exception (silently ignored; the plugin-row toggle is the switch).
- **Zero-tool minimal start**: the reviewer is an independent model call only — no advisor tools, nothing it can do to the session besides advisory messages.
- **No-stall failure policy**: a failing or quota-limited advisor only drops its own bounded backlog — it can never park or pollute the primary loop.
- **Session-scoped controls**: `/advisor on|off|status|config|model` work per session; the toggles and the per-session model pin are ephemeral overrides, never persisted config — `/advisor config` always reports the global defaults. On the web, the session header's **Advisor action** drives the same per-session pin through dedicated session endpoints (see [Verify](#verify)).
- **Next-prompt suggestion (web only)**: after each completed turn the advisor makes one best-effort prediction of the user's likely next prompt and shows it as a suggestion tip below the web composer — click the tip (or press → with an empty input box) to accept it. Web GUI only (no TUI equivalent); predictions are best-effort and silent on failure. Config: `nextPrompt` (boolean, default on); the off switch is the checkbox on the Advisor config card (web Plugins page).

![Next-prompt suggestion tip below the web composer, with the accept hint](docs/screenshots/advisor-next-prompt-tip.webp)

![Advisor note injected into the session stream](docs/screenshots/advisor-injected-note.webp)

## Mount-only (no dsh modification)

The plugin installs as a **pure mount**: bundle insert + client card (the web Plugins page) + its own gateway channel (`/api/advisor/get|set` for the global config plus `/api/advisor/getSession|setSessionModel` for the per-session model surface, claimed by the host's typertGateway — the same mechanism the dsh `goals` service uses, not gated by the settings exposure allowlist) + the `/advisor` commands — no dsh patches, no postinstall step, and dsh upgrades never require re-patching.

## Limitations & roadmap

The MVP deliberately drops full omp parity. Accepted gaps (tracked in the harness iteration roadmap):

- **Single advisor per session** — no parallel advisor roster or WATCHDOG-style file discovery (next iteration).
- **No advisor tools** — the reviewer is an independent model call only; it cannot verify claims itself (next-next iteration).
- **No in-session advisor panel** — advice surfaces only as tagged injected messages; the web Advisor card is a config surface, not a session view (next-next iteration).
- **No transcript persistence or cost stats** — no resumable advisor history or cost observability (next-next iteration).
- **No secret obfuscation of delta content** — secrets present in the transcript can reach the advisor model; mitigate by configuring a trusted reviewer model.
- **No quarantine of unsafe advisor output** — a misbehaving note can carry directive text; the JSON frame + validation + advisory-only framing are the only mitigation, and the note is delivered as-is (roadmap).
- **No `syncBacklog` catch-up wait** — a far-behind advisor does not wait for the primary loop; its backlog is bounded and dropped, so notes may arrive after the next primary turn started (roadmap: context-maintenance batch).
- **Bounded advisor context** — long-session full replays are truncated (`maxDeltaMessages`), so the advisor may lose early context after compaction (roadmap: next-next iteration).

**Sessions written by earlier versions — pre-V3 logs are not repaired here.** Advisor notes in them carry the former custom `source.kind` (`kind: 'advisor'`), which the dsh V2→V3 session-format edge refuses, so those **pre-V3** logs cannot be migrated (the raw file is intact, only unopenable). Logs already at V3 still open — they are affected only by the self-review caveat above. Repairing the pre-V3 logs is upstream work: a unified pass over this defect class is being developed in [`omdsh-dev/dsh-llm-fallbacks`](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-llm-fallbacks) and is **not yet available**. Logs written from this version onward are unaffected.

| [docs/install.md](docs/install.md) | Web/Desktop UI install / profile install (web + dsh-tui) / registry / git / tarball / local-directory variants / web Settings exposure / uninstall / `--dump-config` verification |
| [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md) | full advisor config reference: keys & defaults, explicit model gate (S4), config surfaces (web card / TUI `/settings` / patch layer), example YAML, live re-apply behavior |
