English · 简体中文 · Development notes

--- **Give your DSH agent hands inside the Chrome you are already using** — your logins, your tabs, your session. Install once, no Connect button, ever. > **What it is:** a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets the model operate the Chrome you already use: open pages, click, type, fill in forms, read pages, take screenshots and work across tabs, with your existing logins. > > **Use it for:** "fill in this web form", "check this admin page for me", "screenshot this site", or anything else the model has to do inside a browser. > > **Install:** `dsh plugin add https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-chrome-bridge/releases/latest/download/dsh-chrome-bridge.tgz`, restart DSH, then add the DSH Bridge extension from the [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo). Needs macOS, Windows or Linux, Chrome 116+ and Node.js 18+. ![the in-page cursor driving a real page](assets/cursor-demo.gif) Every click flies a cursor to the target and labels what it is doing. It renders *inside the page*, so it lands in screenshots too — you and the model look at the same picture. ## ✨ Why another browser bridge? Every existing option makes you click something, every time: | Option | What goes wrong | |---|---| | `chrome-devtools-mcp --autoConnect` | Chrome asks *"Allow remote debugging?"* on **every** connection | | Browser MCP (store extension) | You must click the extension icon → **Connect** on **every** tab | | WebSocket-based bridges | Open a TCP port and trust anything that can reach it | | **dsh-chrome-bridge** | Nothing to click. Nothing listening on a port. | Three things make the difference: - 🔌 **Native messaging, not a port.** The extension talks to a local Node host over Chrome's native messaging pipe; the CLI reaches the host through a `0600` Unix socket guarded by a token. No TCP port to scan, no origin to spoof. - 🎯 **`chrome.debugger`, not injected scripts.** Clicks and keystrokes are dispatched as real CDP `Input.*` events, so they carry a user gesture — popups open, focus works, and sites that reject synthetic events behave normally. Screenshots, network, console and raw CDP come for free. - 👀 **A cursor the human can see.** A translucent light-blue arrow with a "🌐 DSH" name tag glides along a gentle arc to the target; the tag says what it is doing (click / type / drag / scroll) and each click leaves a soft ripple. It shares one style with the desktop cursor of [dsh-mac-computer-use](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-mac-computer-use) (solid there, with a monitor icon), so you can tell at a glance whether the work is in the browser or on the desktop. It sits above modals and fullscreen, and picks up where it was after a navigation. Because it is rendered inside the page, **it appears in screenshots**. ## 🏗 Architecture ``` DSH's agent (provided by the harness — this repo ships none) ├── browser_* tools (DSH plugin) ─┐ └── cb CLI (shell) ─┤ ▼ Unix socket /tmp/dsh-bridge-/ (0700 dir + token) ▼ Node native host ←─ native messaging (stdio) ─→ Chrome extension (MV3) │ chrome.debugger ▼ real CDP ``` **This repo ships no agent** — the agent above is DSH's own; we only give it hands. The extension ID is fixed by the public key embedded in `plugin/vendor/extension/manifest.json`, so it is **identical on every machine** and the native-host registration never needs editing. The Web Store build has its own store-assigned ID; the host accepts both. ## 🚀 Install **The host ships inside the plugin package.** Adding the plugin copies the native host and the MV3 extension into place and registers native messaging for you — no `git clone`, no `install.sh`, no `python3`. Requirements: **macOS, Windows or Linux**, **Google Chrome 116+**, **Node.js 18+**. **1.** Sidebar → **Plugins** → **Add plugin** → paste this → Install → Enable → **restart DSH**: ``` https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-chrome-bridge/releases/latest/download/dsh-chrome-bridge.tgz ``` **2.** The plugin installs the host on first load (`~/.dsh/chrome-bridge`, `~/dsh-bridge-extension`, plus `com.dsh.bridge.json` in Chrome's `NativeMessagingHosts`). All that's left is getting the extension into Chrome — pick one: **Recommended: install from the Chrome Web Store** — open the [DSH Bridge store page](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo) → **Add to Chrome**. No Developer mode, and the extension updates itself. **Or: load it unpacked** (to run the newest extension from the repo). Chrome 137+ removed `--load-extension`, so that click has to be yours; the plugin walks you to it: - the first time a `browser_*` tool finds nothing to talk to, it **opens `chrome://extensions` in a background tab** and **puts `~/dsh-bridge-extension` on your clipboard** (once per session; the error text repeats the steps); - in the file picker press **⌘⇧G**, then **⌘V**, then Enter — no folder hunting (Windows: paste into the picker's address bar, then Enter; Linux: **Ctrl+L**, paste, Enter). Do it once, ever: 1. open `chrome://extensions` 2. enable **Developer mode** (top right) 3. **Load unpacked** → **⌘⇧G** → **⌘V** → Enter (the folder is already on your clipboard; Windows / Linux: see above) From a source checkout, `./bridge setup` does exactly this in one command: installs the host, opens the page, copies the path, and waits until the extension connects — printing ✅ when it does. **3.** Verify (the `cb` CLI is installed along the way): ```bash cb status # host pid … | extension connected: ✅ cb tabs ``` Until step 2 is done the `browser_*` tools fail **loudly with exactly these steps** — never silently. ### 🧩 The eleven native tools | Tool | What it does | |---|---| | `browser_tabs` | list / find / open / close / activate tabs | | `browser_read` | **numbered list of clickable / fillable elements** (`snapshot`), visible text, HTML, attributes, page info | | `browser_click` | click by element number (`ref`), selector, text, or coordinates | | `browser_input` | type, press keys, select, upload, hover, scroll | | `browser_nav` | go to a URL, **back / forward / reload**, and wait for load | | `browser_screenshot` | screenshot **returned as an image** (viewport / full / element) | | `browser_eval` | run JS in the page | | `browser_wait` | wait for an element, **a piece of text, or a URL** — or for it to go away (`gone`) | | `browser_dialog` | release alert / confirm / prompt | | `browser_drag` | drag by element number, selector, **visible text** or coordinates — HTML5 drag-and-drop and mouse-driven widgets (sliders, sortable lists) | | `browser_devtools` | **console output + uncaught JS errors, network requests (status, timing), a request's response body** | > A freshly installed bundle is not hot-loaded; DSH must be restarted once. > `dsh plugin add` from the CLI refuses the app-managed profile — use the sidebar there. > Plugin updates are not automatic in DSH yet: to upgrade, uninstall and install again. ### 👀 What you see while it works - **Click the toolbar icon** for a live panel: whether Chrome ↔ local host ↔ DSH are connected, **which DSH sessions are driving which tabs** (jump to a tab, or release it with one click), the last actions with their errors, a **pause switch** that makes the browser off-limits until you turn it back on, and *copy diagnostics* for bug reports. The icon badge shows how many tabs are under control (`!` = host down, `⏸` = paused). - **In DSH, Plugins → Chrome Bridge** has a settings card too: connection status, whether the extension is the local or the Web Store build, which tabs are under control (release them all with one click), plus pause and on-page-cursor switches. When it isn't connected it tells you the missing step and can open the install page for you. **Resuming control only works from the Chrome extension panel** — the model can reach the DSH side as well, so that click has to be yours. - **The agent never falls back to the tab you are looking at.** A `browser_*` call without `tab` keeps using the tab that session opened or last named; if there is none it fails and says so. Acting on your current tab takes an explicit `tab="active"`. - Every tab the agent touches **joins a blue tab group titled "DSH agent 正在操作"** (pinned tabs and tabs already in one of your groups are left where they are), and the group is taken apart the moment it lets go — after 60s idle, on `cb detach`, if the tab is closed, or if you press *Cancel* on Chrome's debugging banner. - The little mouse (favicon + toolbar icon) means **there is actually a cursor in that page**: it lights up when the agent draws its on-page cursor (clicking, typing), and goes away when that cursor is hidden, the page navigates, or the agent lets go. Reading a page never lights it up. - Inside the page, the on-page cursor draws every click, keystroke, drag and scroll — and it appears in screenshots, so you and the model see the same picture. If it gets in your way, switch it off in the panel (the actions still happen, it just isn't drawn). Password fields only ever show dots. ### 🛠 From source (development) ```bash git clone https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-chrome-bridge.git cd dsh-chrome-bridge ./install.sh # same layout as the plugin's auto-install, plus the manager CLI ./bridge status # repo / installed / running version + connection ``` Then point DSH at the checkout for the native tools: **Plugins → Add plugin** → `/absolute/path/to/dsh-chrome-bridge/plugin` (a `link:`, so a `git pull` is enough to update). ## 📖 Usage ### `cb` — from the shell ```bash cb status / cb version / cb reload # health, hot-reload the extension after edits cb tabs # list tabs (* = active) cb find # filter by title/URL cb info active # title, URL, viewport, pending dialog cb text active [selector] # visible text (best first read) cb html active [selector] cb attr active cb wait-for active "" # wait until it exists and is visible cb eval active "" # run JS in the page cb click-el active "" # real mouse event cb click-text active "Sign in" cb click active cb type active "text" --into "" cb key active Enter # combos: "meta+a" cb focus / cb select / cb upload / cb hover / cb scroll cb dialog active accept # release an alert/confirm — otherwise the page hangs cb nav active https://example.com cb shot active --out /tmp/x.png # --full whole page, --sel "" one element cb console active / cb network active --reload cb cursor active click 400 300 # drive the cursor by hand cb cdp active Page.reload '{}' # raw CDP escape hatch ``` `active` can be replaced by a tab id. Add `--json` for raw output. Clicks and typing move the visible cursor by default; pass `--no-cursor` to skip it. ### Management ```bash dsh-chrome-bridge status # repo / installed / running version + connection dsh-chrome-bridge update # sync code + hot-reload the extension (no Chrome clicking) dsh-chrome-bridge test # end-to-end self test dsh-chrome-bridge logs # extension log + host log dsh-chrome-bridge uninstall ``` ## 🔒 Security Be honest about what this is: **the extension can read and control every page you are logged into.** - The bridge is **local-only**. Native messaging is a private pipe; the CLI socket is `0600` and additionally token-guarded. **It opens no network listener of its own** (the DSH settings card goes through DSH's built-in local web server; that route only accepts loopback, rejects cross-site requests, and cannot resume control). - Chrome shows a permanent *"… is debugging this browser"* banner while attached. That banner is the point — you can always see that it is active. - Anything that can already run as your user can read your Chrome profile; this does not widen that boundary. It does make it *convenient*, which is worth a thought before leaving an agent unattended. - **Once the DSH plugin is installed, the model drives your browser without asking.** Plugin tools run inside the DSH host process, so they are *not* gated by the workspace sandbox or the approval prompts that guard `bash`. That is what "native" buys you — and it means an unattended agent holds your browser. Disable the plugin in the sidebar if you want that gate back. - Detach any time: click **Cancel** on the banner, or `cb detach `. ## ⚠️ Limitations - **Windows and Linux support is new** — a daily CI run on GitHub's Windows and Linux machines installs it, connects a real Chrome and reads a page, but it has not been used on a real person's PC yet. Please open an issue if something breaks. On Windows it also registers for Edge (untested). - **`chrome://` pages are unreachable** — Chrome forbids injection there. Use a normal tab. - An `alert()` blocks the page: `cb info` warns you, `cb dialog accept` releases it. - Chrome defers `alert()` in background tabs until the tab is focused. - Without the Web Store, Chrome 137+ (no more `--load-extension`) needs one manual load through `chrome://extensions`. - The Web Store build lags the repo a little: new extension versions wait for store review. ## 🔎 Related projects The DSH browser-plugin space is already busy — these are worth a look: - [dsh-plugin-browser-use](https://github.com/fatmind/dsh-plugin-browser-use) — reuses your logged-in Chrome, exposes `wc3_*` tools - [dsh-plugin-browser](https://github.com/menotbobbybrown/dsh-plugin-browser) — Playwright-based browser automation plugin - [dsh-browser-bridge](https://github.com/liyongzheng666/dsh-browser-bridge) — localhost WebSocket bridge with a Firefox extension - [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) — the curated catalog of DSH plugins What is different here: **no listening port** (native messaging), **real CDP input events** via `chrome.debugger`, and an **on-page cursor that shows up in screenshots**. ## 💬 Feedback Found a bug or want a feature? [Open an issue](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-chrome-bridge/issues/new/choose). Including your DSH and plugin versions helps a lot. ## 🤝 Contributing Issues and PRs welcome. `docs/NOTES.zh.md` is the running log of every pitfall hit while building this — read it before changing the extension or the plugin; it will save you a day. It also documents a way to **verify the plugin without restarting your app** (throwaway profile + headless). MIT licensed.

decision.reason: Held for versioned DSH compatibility, package or companion artifact mapping, runtime execution policy acceptance. MIT and canonical Git source are explicit, but no versioned DSH contract was established. Native host, MV3 extension and auto-installed native helper form a companion chain not closed here. Documented unattended browser operations require execution-policy acceptance. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

简体中文 · English

> **一句话**：DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，模型做网页、App 界面、海报、幻灯片时，右侧栏画布实时显示每一屏，套上手机 / 浏览器外框；点一下元素或框一块区域，补一句话就改。每轮自动存版本，能导出展示图、手机扫码看。 > > **什么时候用**：「做个落地页」「设计一个 App 界面」「做张海报」「做几页幻灯片」。 > > **安装**：`dsh plugin add https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio/releases/latest/download/dsh-design-studio.tgz`，重启 DSH。 让 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）做界面设计时像 Google Stitch / Claude Code 桌面端那样：模型做网页、App 界面、海报、幻灯片时，右侧栏「设计工作台」实时显示——一屏一屏生成出来，在画布上并排摆好，套上手机 / 浏览器外框；看到哪里不对，点一下那个元素、或拖出一块区域，它就整理成一段文字放进输入框，补一句「改成橙色」发出去，模型照着源码改，改过的地方在预览里闪一下。 ![demo](assets/demo.gif) 改一句「主色换成深海蓝」→ 三屏一起变；翻到上一版、左右拖动对比；一键导出整套展示图： ![版本对比和导出](assets/demo-versions.gif) 导出的展示图（插件直接生成，没有再加工）： ![展示图](assets/showcase.jpg) ## 安装 ```sh dsh plugin add https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio/releases/latest/download/dsh-design-studio.tgz ``` 装完**重启 DSH**（客户端代码在 DSH 启动时打包）。DSH「插件」页里显示为「设计工作台」。 开发时可以直接链到本地目录：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/dsh-design-studio`，改了客户端代码同样要重启（`lib/picker.js` 每次现给，不用重启）。 ## 用起来是什么样 1. **做设计时自动打开**：模型加载了设计技能、调了 `preview_page`，或页面写了设计类型标记（``）之后，再写 `.html` 文件或用命令起开发服务器（`npm run dev` 这类），右侧栏自动弹出「设计工作台」。别的任务写的网页不弹，只在标题栏按钮上亮个蓝点，点开能一键预览；`curl`、浏览器工具去看别的端口，一律不当成要预览的页面。 2. **分类型显示**：网页（浏览器窗口）、App（手机外框带灵动岛）、平板、海报（1080×1350）、幻灯片（16:9）、邮件。模型调工具时说明类型，或在页面里写 ``（可带尺寸，如 `poster 1080x1920`）；工具栏「类型」菜单随时能换。 3. **多屏画布**：同一个目录里的几个 HTML 文件按生成顺序排成网格，能拖、能缩放（触控板双指滑 = 平移，捏合 / ⌘ 滚轮 = 缩放，右下角适合画布）。点一下选中一屏，双击只看这一屏；工具栏「画布 / 单页」切换。开发服务器可以让模型给几个路由并排看。 4. **看着它生成**：模型干活时右侧先放一个占位；新的一屏写出来，元素从上到下依次浮现，一道扫描光带过去；这一轮里还在出新屏时，画布末尾留一个「生成中…」的占位。 5. **实时刷新，不白屏**：本地 HTML 所在目录里任何文件一改，后台先载好新的一帧，再淡入换上来（滚动位置不丢）；开发服务器走它自己的热更新（Vite / Next 等的 WebSocket 照常通）。 6. **改了哪里一眼看到**：刷新 / 热更新前后各记一份页面「指纹」，改过、新加的元素在预览里亮一下（带一道扫光），都不在屏幕里就先滚过去；底下报「已更新 index.html · 1 处改动」。改的是共用的 CSS，画布上每一屏都会换帧、各自闪改动；只改某一屏的 HTML，别的屏不动。 7. **模型在干活时**：预览四周一圈流光，底下标「模型正在工作」或「正在写 style.css」。 8. **选择**：点工具栏「选择」，鼠标移到哪个元素就框哪个（带标签和尺寸，画布缩小时标签照样看得清；画布里点哪一屏都行）： - 点一下：选这个元素 - 拖一块：选区域，里面的主要元素一起带上（最多 10 个） - Esc：取消 9. **进输入框**：选好的内容整理成一段文字插进输入框（插不进时复制到剪贴板），选中的地方留一个虚线框，例如： ``` 〔选中元素〕a.btn-order「立即点单 →」 文件：/Users/me/site/index.html 位置：section.hero > div.actions > a.btn-order HTML：立即点单 → 样式：165×56 · color: rgb(255, 255, 255) · padding: 16px 36px · border-radius: 999px ``` React / Vue / Svelte 的开发模式下还会带上组件名和源码位置。 10. **内置设计规范**：插件带一个 DSH 技能 `ui-design`，模型做界面前会加载：先定类型和画幅、先写 `tokens.css`（设计变量）、一屏一个文件；排版 / 间距 / 字号阶梯 / 配色 / 对比度 / 中文排版的规则，避开「AI 味」的清单，写完的自查表；网页、App、海报、幻灯片、邮件各有细则。在输入框打 `/ui-design` 也能手动加载。 11. **设计规范面板**：工具栏调色板按钮，列出这套设计 `:root` 上的设计变量，按颜色、字体、字号、间距、圆角、阴影分组，带色块和样例。点一个放进输入框（`〔设计变量〕--brand: #c26a32` 加文件位置），补一句「换成墨绿」，模型改这一个变量，所有屏一起变。还没有变量时，一键让模型按规范建一份。 12. **导出图片**：工具栏下载按钮，或画布上选中一屏后标签旁的按钮。可以导出这一屏（带手机 / 浏览器外框，或纯画面）、整页长图，以及几屏合成的一张展示图（品牌名做大标题、背景和主色取自设计变量，适合直接发朋友圈 / 小红书 / 作品集）。图片存到设计目录的 `exports/`，同时复制到剪贴板，点「打开文件夹」直接定位。 13. **版本**：每轮对话开始前、结束后各自动存一版（只存设计文件，名字就是你那句话，例如「主色换成深海蓝」；点选元素发出去的，名字是「「3.2 km」 · 改成绿色」这样，不会是一长串选择器）。工具栏时钟按钮列出所有版本；点一版就看当时的样子（画布 / 单页都行），点「对比」左右拖动把手，比较那一版和现在；「回到这一版」把文件写回去（回之前先把现在的存一版，随时能再切回来）。 14. **深色模式**：页面写了深色样式（`@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`，或 `[data-theme="dark"]` / `.dark`），工具栏多一个月亮按钮，一键切换看深色版，导出的图片也是深色的。 15. **再出两版**：画布上选中一屏，点标签旁的闪光按钮，让模型给这一屏出两版不同方向的设计（`login-b.html`、`login-c.html`），紧挨着原版排在画布上，挑一版留下。 16. **在手机上看**：工具栏扫码按钮，右侧栏出一个二维码，手机（和电脑连同一个 Wi-Fi）相机一扫就在手机浏览器里打开这套设计，按真机尺寸看、点得动。电脑上点哪一屏，手机跟着跳；模型改了设计，手机自动刷新。面板上看得到「手机已打开」，也能复制链接、随时停止；30 分钟没人看自动关。 17. **可点原型**：屏和屏之间用链接连起来（`` 或 `data-href`，内置技能会让模型这么写），画布上选中一屏，就画出它跳去哪、从哪跳来的箭头；隔着别的屏的箭头从屏和屏之间的空当、标题上面绕过去，不穿过中间那屏。点工具栏播放按钮进入演示：在预览里点按钮跳到对应那一屏，前进从右边滑进来、返回从左边；顶上能后退、从头来、退出（Esc）。 18. **多尺寸并排**：工具栏第三个视图按钮，把现在这一屏按几档宽度并排看：网页是手机 / 平板 / 桌面，App 是小屏 / 标准 / 大屏（小屏是 SE 那种矮屏，没有灵动岛），平板是三种尺寸，小屏挤不挤一眼看出来。并排时也能选择元素，带上是哪一档屏宽。 19. **预览里直接改字**：工具栏「改字」按钮，点页面里的任意文字就地改，回车保存、Esc 取消。本地 HTML 直接写回源文件（只改那一处，改前改后各存一版，能回退）；开发服务器的页面，或源码里找不到那段字时，改成一句「把「…」改成「…」」放进输入框，交给模型改。 20. **参考图**：把图片拖进右侧栏、在右侧栏里粘贴，或在设计规范面板点「照参考图改风格…」。图片存进设计目录的 `refs/`（还没有设计目录时存插件缓存），右侧栏从图里取出主要颜色（带占比，少见的鲜艳点缀色也会单独挑出来）和整体深浅，连同图片路径和一句「照这张图的风格改，先更新 tokens.css」放进输入框。 工具栏还有：地址（点一下能改，输文件路径 / 端口 / localhost 地址都行）、刷新、在浏览器里打开。右侧栏拉窄时，不常用的几个按钮收进「更多」菜单。会话标题栏右边有个「设计工作台」按钮，随时打开。DSH 重启后，每个会话接着预览原来的页面（类型、视图也记着）。 `preview_page` 工具的参数：`target`（文件路径 / 端口 / 地址）、`kind`（web / app / tablet / poster / slides / email）、`size`（如 `1080x1920`，可选）、`screens`（开发服务器上并排看的几个路由，可选）。 ## 能预览什么 | 输入 | 怎么预览 | | --- | --- | | 本地 HTML 文件 / 目录 / `file://` | 插件起一个本机服务器给这个目录，目录里的文件一改就刷新 | | 端口、`localhost:端口`、`127.0.0.1:端口` | 插件起一个代理转给开发服务器，热更新照常（只听 IPv6 `::1` 的也行，比如 Mac 上的新版 Vite） | | 外网地址 | 不支持（只预览本机页面） | ## 安全 每个预览目标一个独立的 `127.0.0.1` 随机端口，和 DSH 不同源，页面里的脚本碰不到 DSH。 - **只给这个目录**：路径按真实位置算，`../`、编码过的 `../`、指到目录外的软链接都拒。 - **防 DNS 重绑定**：Host 必须是本机名加这个端口。 - **和右侧栏通信**：只和 DSH 自己的源说话（桌面版 `dsh-app://app`、DSH 网页端的地址）：发消息指定收件的源，收消息要来自父窗口且源对得上。别的网站把预览嵌进去，收不到也指挥不动。用反向代理或域名打开网页版 DSH 时，这个地址得写在 DSH 的 `trustedHosts`（`dsh-client-connection` 配置）里才认；没写的话点选、改字、导出不起作用。 - **接口**（`/dsh-design-studio/api/*`）：交给 DSH 自己的 `connection` 服务验登录态；老版本 DSH 没有这个服务时只收本机、同源请求。 - **手机上看**：默认不开，点了才在局域网开一个入口；只监听本机在局域网里的那个地址（不是 0.0.0.0），Host 也得对。链接带一次性的随机口令（128 位），手机第一次打开换成只给这个端口的 Cookie（HttpOnly），地址栏里不留口令；没口令、口令不对一律 403。停止或 30 分钟没人看就关端口，再开换新口令。同一个 Wi-Fi 里拿到这个链接的人也能看，所以别把链接发到群里。 - 代理开发服务器时会拆掉 `X-Frame-Options` 和 CSP（不然嵌不进右侧栏），只影响预览端口，开发服务器本身不动。 ## 架构 ``` 服务端 preview_page 工具 / 自动发现（session/event：写 HTML、命令输出里的地址） → tracker（每个会话预览什么、模型在不在干活，存 ~/.dsh/cache） → hub（每个目标一个本机端口：静态文件 + 改动推送 / 代理 + WebSocket 透传） /dsh-design-studio/api/state|open|view|close 右侧栏轮询、地址栏、类型 / 视图 / 换屏 /dsh-design-studio/api/history|restore 版本列表、回到某一版 /dsh-design-studio/api/export|reveal 存导出的图片、在文件夹里显示 /dsh-design-studio/api/phone 手机上看：开 / 关局域网入口、给二维码、电脑换屏手机跟着跳 /dsh-design-studio/api/edit|ref 预览里改的字写回 HTML、存参考图 页面 picker.js 注入到 HTML：悬停框选、点选 / 拖选、屏间链接、演示时接住跳转、就地改字、postMessage 回右侧栏、改动后刷新 客户端 右侧栏标签页（sidebarRightTabs）+ 标题栏按钮（session.header.utilities） ``` - `lib/index.js` —— 服务端：工具、接口、自动发现接线 - `lib/core.js` —— 地址解析、自动发现、会话状态和存盘、每轮前后存版本、改字写回（只在看得到的文字里找，认 HTML 实体） - `lib/history.js` —— 设计版本：按内容存（没改的文件只存一份），最多 40 版，回到某一版 - `lib/serve.js` —— 预览服务器：静态文件 / 代理 / 改动推送 / 注入 - `lib/phone.js` —— 手机上看：局域网入口（口令换 Cookie、转发到预览服务器、补 viewport、跟随跳屏、WebSocket 透传、闲置自动关） - `lib/qr.js` —— 二维码生成（字节模式、纠错 M、版本 1–10，不引第三方库） - `lib/picker.js` —— 页面里的脚本：选取、改动高亮（指纹比对）、生成动画、和右侧栏握手换帧（关闭的 shadow DOM，不污染页面样式）、把页面画成 PNG（样式、图片、字体都内联）、深色模式切换、报告屏间链接、演示时把点链接变成跳屏、就地改字 - `lib/client.js` —— 右侧栏、工具栏、画布（排版、拖动、缩放）、设备外框、动画、两帧 iframe 交替（新的载好再淡入）、设计规范面板、版本面板和左右对比、导出（套外框、合成展示图）、把选取整理成文字插进输入框、原型箭头和演示、多尺寸并排、改字、参考图取色、窄栏「更多」菜单 - `skills/ui-design/` —— 内置设计规范（DSH 技能）：`SKILL.md` 流程和原则、`references/` 各类型细则、`tokens.css` 起手模板 - `assets/demo.gif`、`assets/demo-versions.gif` —— 演示动图（测试台里跑插件真代码录的）；`assets/showcase.jpg` —— 导出的展示图样例 - `docs/feasibility.zh.md` —— 做之前的可行性调研 ## 测试 ```sh node test/test-serve.mjs # 静态文件、跳不出目录、Host 把门、改动推送、代理、WebSocket、只听 ::1 的开发服务器、连不上的提示页 node test/test-core.mjs # 地址解析、自动发现（只在做设计时，后台跑的开发服务器也认）、模型 / 用户指定的不被顶掉、重放不动手、存盘恢复（恢复中先不显示空状态）、类型 / 几屏 / 换屏、改字写回 node test/test-client.mjs # 右侧栏标签页 / 标题栏按钮注册、只给当前会话自动弹出、选中内容整理成的文字、页面 meta、画布排版、设计变量分组、原型箭头（隔屏的绕开别的屏）、多尺寸排版、矮屏手机没有灵动岛、参考图取色 node test/test-skill.mjs # 内置技能：名字 / 来源合规、内容读得到、引用的细则文件都在 node test/test-history.mjs # 版本：存一版 / 没变不存 / 只存设计文件 / 回到某一版 / 上限、每轮前后存、版本名（点选 / 变量 / 参考图换成短名字）、旧版本文件、导出的图不算改动 node test/test-phone.mjs # 手机上看：二维码结构、挑网卡、补 viewport、口令换 Cookie、没口令 / Host 不对 403、转发、跟随跳屏、WebSocket、停止、闲置自动关 ``` ## 已验证 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端实测：让模型「设计一个咖啡外带 App 的三屏界面」，它先自己加载 `ui-design` 技能、建 `tokens.css`、一屏一个文件，右侧画布套手机外框一屏屏长出来（末尾带「生成中…」），写完按自查表找出文字重叠和对比度问题自己改掉；在「设计规范」面板点主色进输入框，模型问清方向后只改 `tokens.css` 一个变量，三屏一起变色、改动处高亮。之后又实测了第三期：每轮对话前后自动存版本（名字就是那句话）、版本面板、看第 1 版、左右拖动对比、导出整套展示图（3144×2541）；点「再出两版」后模型没动原版和 tokens.css，写了 login-b / login-c 两个方向，画布上紧跟在登录屏后面。更早还测了：模型写好 HTML 后右侧栏自动弹出预览；地址栏手动打开；选择模式下点选元素后文字进输入框；改文件后预览自动刷新；DSH 重启后每个会话接着预览原来的页面。浏览器里另测了悬停框、点选、拖选区域、改 CSS 后自动刷新。测试台（插件真代码 + 仿 DSH 外壳）里测了：生成占位、一屏屏生成的动画、四屏 App 画布、画布里点选、改一屏只刷一屏、改共用 CSS 全部刷新、双击单看、类型切换、窄侧栏排版、设计规范面板（分组、点一个进输入框、没有变量时的提示）、导出（单屏带外框、深色页面、三屏合成展示图）、版本列表 / 看旧版 / 左右对比拖把手 / 回到这一版、深色模式切换、再出两版的提示和排序；手机上看：面板里的二维码用系统识别读得出链接，模拟 iPhone（390 宽）扫码打开，地址栏不留口令，「手机已打开」亮起，电脑上选别的屏手机跟着跳，改设计文件手机自动刷新，点停止后链接立刻失效。还测了第五期：原型箭头和演示里点按钮跳屏、多尺寸三档并排、点字改字写回文件并存版本（单页，和画布上的另一屏）、拖入 / 粘贴参考图后取色进输入框、窄侧栏的「更多」菜单。第五期又在 DSH 桌面端实测：非设计任务（命令里 curl 本机端口）不弹出；模型调 `preview_page` 后画布上带跳转箭头，侧栏窄时次要按钮进「更多」；演示里点「获取验证码」滑到首页；多尺寸三档并排；改字回车后写回源文件，版本里多一条「改字「…」」；手机二维码能识别出局域网链接、能打开，点停止后端口关掉；在右侧栏粘贴参考图后，图存进设计目录的 `refs/`，主要颜色和点缀色（如 `#C8763E 1%（点缀）`）进了输入框；发出去后模型先写 `tokens.css`，四屏一起换成参考图的深色加焦糖色；选图按钮能弹出系统选文件框。从访达拖图进来这一步模拟不出系统拖拽，只在测试台验过。之后在 DSH 里从零跑了一遍：模型自己加载技能、调 `preview_page`，三屏宠物领养 App 一屏屏长出来，页面之间自己连好了跳转；点选进输入框、模型改完高亮、版本 / 对比 / 回到第 1 版（文件确实回去了）、导出展示图、窗口在前台时导出也复制进剪贴板、设计规范面板、单页改字写回、多尺寸都正常。这一轮在 DSH 里找出并修了四个只在真 DSH 出现的问题：画布 iframe 刚载完时视口是 0×0，跳转箭头和演示认不出按钮（现在尺寸到了会补报）；模型用后台任务（`run_in_background` + `job_output`）起的开发服务器认不出；新版 Vite 在 Mac 上只听 `::1`，代理只连 127.0.0.1，全是「连不上」；DSH 重启时右侧栏先闪一下空状态。修完后实测开发服务器：五个路由并排、改源文件热更新、开发服务器页面上改字变成一句请求、模型改完自动刷新、手机扫码打开（没口令 403）、停止后端口关掉。再下一轮修了几个小毛病，也在 DSH 里验过：新屏播生成动画时底部按钮是透明的，跳转箭头漏了它（现在播动画的按钮也算，播完再补报一次位置）；隔着一屏的箭头改成绕到标题上面走；点选后的版本名从「〔选中元素〕em…」变成「「3.2 km」 · 把这个距离文字改成绿色…」；先打字再点选时，选中的内容另起一行，不再粘在那句话后面；多尺寸里的小屏不再画灵动岛；提示条和顶上的提示消息不再叠在一起。 ## 反馈 遇到问题或想要新功能，[提一个 issue](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio/issues/new/choose)。报问题时写上 DSH 版本和插件版本，修起来最快。 ## License MIT

evidence.readmeExcerpt: ![hero](assets/hero.png) 让 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的对话流里直接播放本地视频 / 音频：模型录屏、转码、配音生成的文件，回合结束时播放器自动出现在回复正下方——Claude 桌面端 / Codex 同款位置，不用点任何东西，也不用模型专门调工具。说一句「播一下 ~/Movies/a.mp4」也行。 > **一句话**：DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，在对话里直接播放本地视频和音频。模型录屏、转码、配音做出来的文件，播放器自动出现在回复下面；别的文件用 `play_video` 工具播。 > > **什么时候用**：「录个屏」「把视频转成 mp4」「生成一段配音」之后，想直接在对话里看、听。 > > **安装**：`dsh plugin add @orderg-x/dsh-video-preview`（npm 包），重启 DSH。 > > **English:** a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that plays local video and audio inline in the chat. Files the model makes (screen recordings, transcodes, voiceovers) get a player under its reply automatically, and the `play_video` tool plays any other file. Install with the `dsh plugin add` command above, then restart DSH. ![demo](assets/demo.gif) ## 安装 ```sh dsh plugin add @orderg-x/dsh-video-preview ``` 也可以直接装发布包：`dsh plugin add https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-video-preview/releases/latest/download/dsh-video-preview.tgz`。装完**重启 DSH**（客户端代码在 DSH 启动时打包，不重启看不到播放器）。DSH「插件」页里显示为「视频播放」。 > **从 0.3.x 升级**：0.4.0 起包名改成 `@orderg-x/dsh-video-preview`（npm 上的 `dsh-video-preview` 是别人的包）。装上新版后，到「插件」页把旧的「dsh-video-preview」移除，再重启 DSH。旧版还在时新版不会启动，旧版照常能用；以前对话里的视频链接都还能播。 开发时可以直接链到本地目录：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/dsh-video-preview`，改了代码同样要重启。 ## 它解决什么 DSH 的消息渲染块只有 text / image / file / table，**没有 video**，工具调用块又默认折叠。这个插件用纯官方插件 API 补上内联播放（零 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖，和官方 `present` 工具同款机制）。 一次 `play_video` 调用后，用户能看到： 1. **回复下方的播放器**（主显示位）——小卡片，一个一行： - 视频只露画面（200 高、按原比例），角上标时长；鼠标移上去静音预览、浮出文件名 / 大小 / 下载，点一下从头带声音播 - 音频是一条细条：圆形播放键、文件名、大小、时长、可拖的进度条 - 超过 3 个先折叠成「还有 N 个媒体文件」；同一时间只有一个在出声 - 配色、圆角、字体用 DSH 自己的设计变量，深浅色主题跟着走 2. **交付文件芯片**——点「在侧边栏预览」打开大屏播放器（DSH 原生把 mp4 列为「不可预览」，这里接管） 3. **工具块里的小播放器**（兜底）——展开工具调用块后可见 模型用自带 `present` 工具交付的媒体文件，也会自动出现播放器。 ## 自动播放（不用调工具） 模型这一轮里生成的视频 / 音频（录屏、ffmpeg / avconvert 转码、`say` 配音……），回合收尾时自动挂上播放器： - **怎么找**：从这一轮的命令参数、命令输出、回复正文里挖出媒体文件路径（带空格、中文、`~`、相对路径、shell 转义都认） - **挂哪些**：只挂这一轮里新写出来的文件（刚下载、解压出来的也算），以前就有的不挂；回复正文提到的优先，没提才用命令里的，中间文件不刷屏；一轮最多 8 个 - **不重复**：已经用 `play_video` / `present` 播过的不再挂 - **中途停掉**：来不及在收尾时挂，会在回合结束后补上（重新打开会话可见） ## 用法 对话里直接说「播一下 /Users/me/Movies/a.mp4」，模型会调 `play_video`。参数： | 参数 | 必填 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `path` | 是 | 本地文件路径（支持 `~`；相对路径按会话的工作目录算） | | `title` | 否 | 播放器标题，默认文件名 | | `autoplay` | 否 | 自动播放（浏览器通常会拦） | | `loop` | 否 | 循环播放 | ## 能播什么 DSH 的播放器是 Chromium 内核，能播什么由它决定： | | 格式 | | --- | --- | | 能播 | 视频 mp4 / m4v / mov / webm / ogv，音频 mp3 / wav / ogg / m4a / aac / flac / opus | | 看编码 | mkv / 3gp：要看文件里的编码，播不了会在播放器下面说明并给出转码命令 | | 播不了 | avi / flv / wmv / wma / ts / mpg / rmvb 等 —— `play_video` 会直接说明，并给出转码命令 | 转码（需要 [ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/)，macOS 上 `brew install ffmpeg`）： ```sh ffmpeg -i in.avi -c:v libx264 -c:a aac -movflags +faststart out.mp4 # 视频 ffmpeg -i in.wma -c:a aac out.m4a # 音频 ``` 播放出错时，播放器下面会告诉你是哪种情况：文件被移走了、没有权限、插件没加载（要重启 DSH），还是编码不支持（附转码命令）。 ## 安全 DSH 的本地网页服务本身不做鉴权，浏览器里任何网页都摸得到 `127.0.0.1`，所以两条播放路由自己把门： - **只给媒体文件**：按扩展名判断，软链接按它指向的真实文件算；别的文件一律 403。 - **防 DNS 重绑定和跨站**：Host 必须是本机名或 DSH 自己的地址；跨站请求、Origin 不是 DSH 自己的都拒。 - **签名地址**（`/dsh-video-preview/media`）：token = HMAC(密钥, 文件绝对路径)，密钥存在 `~/.dsh/cache/dsh-video-preview.secret`（0600），同一台机器上跨重启、跨宿主都有效。 - **侧边栏 / 回复下方的地址**（`/dsh-video-preview/preview`，没有 token）：交给 DSH 自己的 `connection` 服务验登录 cookie；老版本 DSH 没有这个服务时只收本机连接。 v0.3.0 之前的版本只看 cookie 名字，网页能伪造 cookie 读到任意文件，请升级。 ## 架构 ``` 服务端 play_video 工具 ──校验文件──▶ 返回带签名的 URL │ └─append deliverables/presented 事件（官方 present 工具同款通道） 自动 session/event 收集这一轮的路径 → agent/turn-stopping 时挑出新文件 → 同一条通道 路由 /dsh-video-preview/media 签名 token · HTTP Range 流式（大文件不进内存） /dsh-video-preview/preview DSH 登录态 · 供侧边栏 / 回复下方的播放器 客户端 turnTail 槽 / documentPreviews 渲染器 / toolview 槽 ``` - `lib/index.js` —— 服务端：工具 + deliverables 事件 + 两条流式路由（读盘出错只断当前请求，不会带崩 DSH） - `lib/auto-present.js` —— 自动播放：挖路径、挑新文件、回合收尾前呈现（回合结束后才 append 的话，界面要重开会话才刷出来） - `lib/client.js` —— 客户端：回复下方播放器 / 侧边栏预览 / 工具块兜底 / 出错诊断（`exports.inject` 是客户端**短服务名**，写包名会一直 pending） - `locale/*.json`、`icon.svg` —— DSH 插件页的卡片标题、说明和图标 - `cordis.patch.yml` —— bundle patch（insert 行的 `name` 必须是完整包名，客户端按它解析 bundle） ## 测试 ```sh node test/test-routes.mjs # 把门、Range、HEAD、读盘出错、工具的格式提示 node test/test-client.mjs # 三个挂载点、视频卡 / 音频条、折叠、出错诊断 node test/test-auto.mjs # 自动播放：新 / 老文件、正文优先、各种路径写法、不重复、重放不动手 ``` ## 已验证 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 桌面端端到端实测：回复下方播放器（mp4 / HEVC 的 mov / m4a，中文文件名）、侧边栏预览和播放、avi 的转码提示、文件被移走后的出错提示；伪造登录 cookie 的请求被拒；模型用 say / avconvert 生成的 m4a、mp4（含带空格的中文文件名）没调 `play_video`，回合结束时播放器实时出现且能播；视频卡悬停预览 / 点击播放 / 下载、音频条播放、超过 3 个时折叠展开、深浅两种主题下的配色。 参考实现：[@goodandready/dsh-image-gen](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@goodandready/dsh-image-gen)（客户端插件套路）与官方 `dsh-tool-present`（deliverables 通道）。 ## 反馈 遇到问题或想要新功能，[提一个 issue](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-video-preview/issues/new/choose)。报问题时写上 DSH 版本和插件版本，修起来最快。

# {{pkgName}} A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin scaffolded by [`dsh-plugin-dev new`](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-guide). ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `{{dshBaseline}}` (npm `alpha`); `latest`/`next` = `0.2.0-rc.2` | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network) | ## What it does Registers the `{{name}}_echo` tool. Calling it replies with `: `, where `` comes from the plugin config and `` is the argument. ## Install ```sh pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile add ./{{pkgName}}-{{version}}.tgz dsh --profile --dump-config | grep '{{pkgName}}' ``` ## Configuration | Key | Type | Default | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `greeting` | string | `Hello` | Prefix for the echo reply | Configuration is validated by the Schemastery `Config` schema in `index.js`; no tunable is hardcoded. ## Development ```sh pnpm install pnpm test ``` ## License [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE) © {{year}} {{pkgName}} contributors.
# 🐳 dsh-plugin-guide **Your agent stops inventing DSH plugin APIs.** The DeepSeek Harness plugin-development knowledge base, installed *as an agent skill* — official docs, a version-compatibility matrix, migration seams and battle-tested pitfalls, plus a scaffolder/checker CLI. ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-guide ``` Then just ask: *"Use the dsh-plugin-guide skill to build me a … plugin."* [![Gitee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gitee-mirror-c71d23?logo=gitee)](https://gitee.com/perrylink/dsh-plugin-guide) [![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-guide?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-guide?ref=badge) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-guide/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-guide) > **Official repository.** This is the only official repository of dsh-plugin-guide, maintained by PerryLink. Same-name repositories under other accounts are not affiliated. [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-✅-green)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![dsh-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/main/badges/PerryLink__dsh-plugin-guide.svg)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor#verified-徽章) [![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-top-rated.svg)](https://dsh.market/) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-brightgreen.svg)](#) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-guide/verify.yml?branch=main&label=CI)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-guide/actions) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-guide?label=version)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-guide/releases) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-guide)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-guide) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-plugin-guide)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-guide) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md) ```sh dsh plugin --profile add dsh-plugin-guide ```
--- ## Install & uninstall - **npm channel** (published releases — **the default; start here**): `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-guide`. The published tarball already contains `dist/`, so no build step runs. - **git channel** (latest `main`, or an unreleased commit): `dsh plugin --profile web add github:PerryLink/dsh-plugin-guide#` — pin a commit for reproducibility. ⚠️ `dist/` is not committed, so pnpm must run this package's `prepare` and will refuse until the build is allowlisted; add it to the profile's `allowBuilds` (see [publish.md](references/official-docs/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md)). - **tarball channel**: `pnpm pack` in this repo, then `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plugin-guide-.tgz`. - **uninstall**: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-guide`. ## Why not just read the official docs? Because the official docs are written for someone who already knows which page to open, and DSH ships a **prerelease every 1.7–2.8 days** with breaking changes. This plugin closes the three gaps that costs authors the most time: | Gap | What this plugin adds | |---|---| | **"Which DSH am I even targeting?"** | A [version matrix](guide/version-matrix.md): the four different values that all call themselves "latest", the frozen sub-package `latest` tags, the breaking-change seams, and how to pick a `peerDependencies` range. **There is no stable line** — every published version is a prerelease. | | **"What does this break?"** | A [migration guide](guide/migration-0.2.md) covering `0.1.6-alpha.2` → `0.2.1-alpha.2` as **citable seams** with symptom *and* fix, each with its official source — including a data-loss hazard and a change that makes prompts fail before a model request is built. | | **"Is my plugin actually correct?"** | A [zero-dependency CLI](SKILL.md) (`dsh-plugin-dev new / check / verify`) plus an [offline verbatim mirror](references/official-docs/) of the official docs, so your agent can cite the exact page instead of guessing. | **Prove it works in 60 seconds:** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-guide npx dsh-plugin-guide new hello-plugin # scaffold a plugin cd hello-plugin && npx dsh-plugin-guide check --json # 16 static checks ``` **📖 Prefer reading it as a site?** [perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/) — every chapter as its own page, plus a machine-readable [llms.txt](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/llms.txt) for assistants. **Also on the 1024 store channel:** `npm i -g dsh1024`, then `dsh1024 plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-guide` (counts toward the [deepseek1024.com](https://deepseek1024.com) install ranking). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（95 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 95 plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-plugin-guide? Everything you need to build [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugins. Official docs archive · Cordis primer · community deep-dives · battle-tested pitfalls · agent skill · CLI toolchain ![Workflow diagram for dsh-plugin-guide: request → policy / review → verdict.](docs/assets/dsh-plugin-guide-flow.svg) *Workflow overview: request → policy / review → verdict. The examples below use the real command surface.* ## Comparison ![Measured comparison chart for dsh-plugin-guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-guide/main/docs/assets/dsh-plugin-guide-evidence.png) content counts as stated in the README (What you get) ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.2` (`d743267388641bc76f17c45ce8b4c231aed1d32c`, the newest master tag **and** master HEAD, 2026-10-09); npm `latest` = `next` = `0.2.0-rc.2`, `alpha` = `0.2.1-alpha.2`. **There is no stable line** — all 31 npm versions and all 26 GitHub Releases are prereleases. The official-docs mirror is pinned to that same commit (429 md pages, re-synced 2026-10-13; see [references/official-docs/SNAPSHOT.md](references/official-docs/SNAPSHOT.md)). `guide/migration-0.2.md` covers `0.1.6-alpha.2` → `0.2.1-alpha.1` in §0–§12 and `0.2.1-alpha.1` → `0.2.1-alpha.2` as 19 citable seams in §13; the 20 breaking-change guides added since the previous baseline (19 under `v0.2.1-alpha.1` plus one backfilled into `v0.2.0-rc.2`) are all in the mirror. | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (DeepSeek Harness runtime) | | Platforms | All (plain ESM bundle; no native code, no network) | | Model | Any (no model interaction) | ## What you get `dsh-plugin-guide` is the DSH plugin-development knowledge base plus a CLI toolchain, packaged as one installable bundle. The knowledge base registers as the `dsh-plugin-guide` agent skill (visible in every session catalog, loading workflow steps, official docs, and community deep-dives on demand); the `dsh-plugin-dev` CLI adds three mechanical layers on top of it. - **Plugin contract & hard rules** — effects/disposers, waterfall `next()`, host-owned session events, `MessageSourceMap`, the weakest-mechanism ordering, Schemastery config, UI and performance rules. - **Official docs archive** — a verbatim copy of the official repo docs (EN + ZH), byte-identical to upstream at the last verified snapshot, including the pages that never reach the documentation site. - **Version adaptivity** — [guide/version-matrix.md](guide/version-matrix.md): the five different "latest" values, the frozen sub-package `latest` tags, the four breaking-change seams, the canonical peer range and how to pick one, the session-format lineage V0→V4, and the 19 breaking changes that landed in `0.2.1-alpha.2`. - **Migration guide** — [guide/migration-0.2.md](guide/migration-0.2.md): every breaking change from `0.1.6-alpha.2` to `0.2.1-alpha.1` (session format V4, the settings rebuild, invariant removal, `readBytes`, new slots, retired `plugin` message source), each with its official source and a 12-item checklist. - **Official in-repo skill, distilled** — [references/official-plugin-dev-skill.md](references/official-plugin-dev-skill.md): the harness's own `cordis-plugin-development` workflow, prohibitions, display-metadata checklist, practices, and UI/performance rules. - **Cordis primer** — the five concepts and the mechanism timeline (repository-plugin introduced 0809, removed 0811; the two install channels). - **Verified issue index** — [guide/unfixed-issues.md](guide/unfixed-issues.md): 22 unfixed + 11 newly verified items with `path:line`, workarounds, fixing commits, design-vs-bug table, and an explicit "unreproducible" section. - **30+ real-world pitfalls** with root cause + fix (cordis dual copies, tsconfig trio, multi-frame zstd sessions, Windows junctions, stale npm `latest`, `file:` installs loading a copy, live patch writes, …). - **Community deep-dives** — 114 community repositories archived (15 deep-dived), plus a full source index where every fact links to its origin. - **CLI toolchain** — `dsh-plugin-dev new / check / verify`: scaffold, static-check (including display metadata and multi-patch manifests), and pack-verify DSH plugins; every check links back to the skill section it enforces. ## Knowledge base | Path | What it is | |---|---| | `SKILL.md` | The `dsh-plugin-guide` agent skill: hard rules + task-based development paths | | `package.json` · `cordis.patch.yml` · `index.js` · `locale/` · `icon.svg` | The installable DSH bundle: `dsh.bundle.patch` manifest, entry point that registers the skill, and the display metadata Plugin Manager reads | | `guide/plugin-dev-guide.md` | The complete development guide (10 chapters) | | `guide/version-matrix.md` | **Version adaptivity matrix**: the five "latest" values, frozen sub-package `latest` tags, breaking-change seams, peer-range selection, session-format lineage, and the 19 changes in `0.2.1-alpha.2` | | `guide/migration-0.2.md` | Breaking-change migration guide for the 0.2 generation | | `guide/unfixed-issues.md` | Source-verified bug index + fixed-on-master list + design-vs-bug table | | `guide/quick-reference.md` | One-page cheat sheet (5 languages) | | `guide/links.md` | Curated URL index: official dev docs (site ↔ local copies) + community doc links + repo-only pages | | `guide/when-to-retire-a-plugin.md` | Retiring and freezing plugins: the criteria and the measured data behind a portfolio audit (EN + ZH) | | `guide/choosing-a-plugin.md` | Choosing a plugin: who leads each capability surface, with the measured numbers and the verification caveats (EN + ZH) | | `references/official-docs/` | Verbatim copy of the official repo docs (EN + ZH) | | `references/official-plugin-dev-skill.md` | Distilled official in-repo plugin-development skill | | `references/*.md` | Research reports: repo docs, website, Cordis, the paper, community ecosystem, 114-repo archive (15 deep-dived) | | `scripts/` | Idempotent download scripts + integrity checker + topic snapshot generator | | `bin/` · `src/cli/` · `dist/` | The `dsh-plugin-dev` CLI: scaffolder, checker, verifier (TypeScript, tsdown-bundled) | | `templates/` | TS + JS scaffold skeletons: contract template, Config, tests, cordis.patch.yml, locale metadata, icon, five-language READMEs | | `downloads/` | Raw snapshots — generated by `scripts/`, not committed | ## CLI toolchain The bundle ships the zero-runtime-dependency `dsh-plugin-dev` CLI (`bin/` → tsdown-bundled `dist/dsh-plugin-dev.js`). Each check cites the skill section it enforces, so an agent can keep auditing manually. ```sh dsh-plugin-dev new [--lang ts|js] [--dir ] [--force] [--git] dsh-plugin-dev check [--cwd ] [--json] [--strict] dsh-plugin-dev verify [--cwd ] [--dsh ] [--pnpm ] dsh-plugin-dev seams | --since # is this API in my target host? ``` | Subcommand | What it does | |---|---| | `new ` | Scaffolds a TS or JS plugin repo: `src/index.ts` contract template, Schemastery Config, tests, tsdown/vitest, commented `cordis.patch.yml`, five-language READMEs. Idempotent; refuses non-empty targets without `--force`. | | `check` | Static checks: `cordis.patch.yml` validity, `package.json` metadata (`dsh.bundle.patch` pointer, peer deps, engines, files whitelist), five-language README consistency, engineering red-line patterns. Emits CI-consumable JSON. | | `verify` | `pnpm pack`, then install/start/uninstall the bundle in a clean mkdtemp `DSH_HOME` profile (aligned with `verify:self-contained`). Failures report the log tail plus suggestions. | ### CLI configuration The CLI has no hardcoded tunables — each is a flag or an environment variable. | Tunable | Flag | Env | Default | |---|---|---|---| | Templates directory | — | `DSH_PLUGIN_DEV_TEMPLATES` | `/templates` | | dsh binary | `--dsh` | `DSH_PLUGIN_DEV_DSH` | `dsh` | | pnpm binary | `--pnpm` | `DSH_PLUGIN_DEV_PNPM` | `pnpm` | | Install/pack timeout | `--timeout` | `DSH_PLUGIN_DEV_TIMEOUT` | `300000` ms | | Headless smoke timeout | `--smoke-timeout` | `DSH_PLUGIN_DEV_SMOKE_TIMEOUT` | `120000` ms | ### Upstream roadmap `dsh-plugin-dev` is an upstream candidate for the official plugin-development CLI (planned item C12): the scaffolder/checker/verifier are the mechanical layers, while `SKILL.md` + `guide/` stay the cognitive layer. ## Quick start ```sh # 1. install the bundle into your profile — npm first dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-guide # 2. restart and verify the row dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 'id: dsh-plugin-guide' ``` ⚠️ **Use the npm channel, not the git channel, for a first install.** The git channel pulls source, and `dist/` is not committed, so pnpm has to run this package's `prepare` build script — which pnpm 10+ blocks until you explicitly allowlist it (`allowBuilds`). That is a documented pitfall of git installs, not a defect, but it makes the git channel a poor first experience. See [Install & uninstall](#install--uninstall) for the git and tarball channels when you specifically want an unreleased commit. Then just ask your agent: *"Use the dsh-plugin-guide skill to build me a … plugin."* Or drive the CLI directly: ```sh npx dsh-plugin-guide new hello-plugin # scaffold a TS plugin repo npx dsh-plugin-guide check --json # static-check it npx dsh-plugin-guide verify # pack + clean-profile smoke ``` ## Copy as a plain agent skill You can also copy the whole folder into your agent's skill directory (relative paths stay intact): ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) pwsh -File scripts/install-skill.ps1 ` -Target "$env:USERPROFILE\.deepseek\skills\dsh-plugin-guide" # or \.agents\skills\dsh-plugin-guide ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux pwsh -File scripts/install-skill.ps1 -Target ~/.deepseek/skills/dsh-plugin-guide # or /.agents/skills/dsh-plugin-guide ``` The installer skips `downloads/` (generated) and `.github/`, then verifies every copied file byte-for-byte. A manual `Copy-Item -Recurse` of the whole folder also works. ### Examples These are the plugin's real entry points; install once, then call one. #### Detailed example **Command** ~~~sh dsh-plugin-dev seams L3 ~~~ **Output** ~~~text 1 seam(s): L3 webRuntime service replaced by webStartup kind service-renamed lands in 0.2.1-alpha.2 confidence documented official docs/upgrade-guide/v0.2.1-alpha.1/web-listener-trust-config/guide.md removed service webRuntime; row web-runtime; ctx.webRuntime.lanAddresses; wildcard --host instead webStartup (row web-startup), concrete host literals detectable yes — inspect: src/**/*.ts, cordis.patch.yml ~~~ *Observed from `README.md:152 (CLI toolchain); src/cli/commands/seams.ts:54; data/seams/index.json:44`* #### Failure branch **Input** ~~~text node bin/dsh-plugin-dev.js seams no-such-seam-xyz ~~~ **Output** ~~~text no seam or capability matches "no-such-seam-xyz". This is an absence of evidence in the knowledge base, not evidence that the API is absent from your target host — check references/official-docs/ before concluding either way. ~~~ *Observed from `plugins/dsh-plugin-guide/src/cli/lib/seams.ts:122-130; plugins/dsh-plugin-guide/src/cli/commands/seams.ts:87-92; plugins/dsh-plugin-guide/tests/seams.test.ts:88-90`* #### Brief examples ## Configuration The skill bundle exposes no Schemastery `Config` — it registers the knowledge base as an agent skill with no tunable keys. The `dsh-plugin-dev` CLI reads its tunables from flags and `DSH_PLUGIN_DEV_*` environment variables (see [CLI toolchain](#cli-toolchain)). ## Tools & surfaces | Surface | Kind | Notes | |---|---|---| | `dsh-plugin-guide` | skill | Registered via `ctx.skills`; loads `SKILL.md` + `./guide/` + `./references/` on demand | | `dsh-plugin-dev` | bin (CLI) | `new` / `check` / `verify` subcommands; not a DSH plugin row | ## Permissions & data - **Permissions**: declares `filesystem:read` in its workshop manifest. - **Data**: read-only — reads its own bundled `guide/` and `references/` files. No network requests, no writes, no model calls. ## Security boundaries - **Read-only knowledge base.** The bundle only reads its own files; it never writes, never calls the network, and never invokes a model. - **Official docs are verbatim copies.** `references/official-docs/` is never edited here; report issues upstream and re-sync only with `scripts/sync-official-docs.ps1`. - **Distribution boundaries.** Bundled third-party content keeps its upstream license; see [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) (e.g. `downloads/` is local-only; `awesome-dsh-plugins` must not be redistributed). ## Known limitations - **Official docs are a snapshot.** Re-sync with `scripts/sync-official-docs.ps1` when upstream moves; the freshness stamp and commit hash reference `references/official-docs/SNAPSHOT.md`. - **`downloads/` is generated, not committed.** Raw snapshots (community repo archives, Discussions, articles) must be generated with the scripts before use. - **`awesome-dsh-plugins` content is local-only.** Its upstream declares an internal-use constraint, so it is not redistributed with the repo. ## Release channels Every channel resolves from this repository or from npm, so one tag reaches all of them; only the Gitee mirror is a scheduled copy: | Channel | Source of truth | How it updates | |---|---|---| | npm (`dsh-plugin-guide`) | this repo's `package.json` | `.github/workflows/release.yml` on a `v*` tag: `verify-kit` gate → CHANGELOG section check → `npm publish --provenance` (skipped when the version already exists) | | GitHub Release | the same tag | the same workflow creates it idempotently from the tag | | Discovery badges (npm version, GitHub tag, DSH Market, dsh-doctor) | live lookups | nothing to publish — they read npm/the registry on each render | | Gitee mirror | this repo | a **read-only scheduled mirror**, not a publish target: it is force-aligned to the GitHub tip (`--force-with-lease`) by the family's `gitee-sync` workflow, so `main` is normally one scheduled run behind. Gitee never receives a tag push from here; compare `git ls-remote` against GitHub before reporting the mirror stale | | DSH Desktop Market / dsh1024 | npm | the market installs the npm package, so a published version is immediately installable; no per-version submission | ## Keeping it fresh ```sh pwsh -File scripts/sync-official-docs.ps1 # verbatim docs copy from a local checkout pwsh -File scripts/download-sources.ps1 # official site/docs, Cordis, paper pwsh -File scripts/download-community-repos.ps1 # community repositories (codeload tarballs) pwsh -File scripts/download-community-articles.ps1 # zh/en/HN community articles pwsh -File scripts/archive-discussions.ps1 # official Discussions (needs $env:GH_TOKEN) pwsh -File scripts/gen-topic-snapshot.ps1 -OutDir # dsh-plugin topic census pwsh -File scripts/verify-kit.ps1 -Checkout # critical paths + link scan + docs drift ``` ## Development The skill bundle (`index.js`) is plain ESM with no build step; the `dsh-plugin-dev` CLI is TypeScript built by tsdown. Gates: ```sh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:ci pnpm test pnpm run build pnpm run verify:artifacts # dogfood self-check + scaffold smoke (no network) pnpm run verify:self-contained # pack + clean-profile install/start/uninstall smoke pnpm run check:readmes # five READMEs share section structure pnpm run check:parity # translations have identical block counts pnpm run check:facts # self-stated numbers match data/facts.json pnpm run check:ps1-bom # PowerShell scripts keep their UTF-8 BOM pnpm pack pwsh -File scripts/verify-kit.ps1 # critical paths + link scan (+ docs drift with -Checkout ) ``` ## Topics `dsh`, `deepseek-harness`, `dsh-plugin`, `cordis`, `agent-skill`, `plugin-development`, `knowledge-base`, `cli`, `scaffold`, `checker` ## Contributors - [PerryLink](https://github.com/PerryLink) — creator and maintainer: knowledge-base content, the installable-bundle transformation, ecosystem submissions, and community engineering. - [@Yisa-yi](https://github.com/Yisa-yi) — **product manager**. Took part in the whole design arc, from the first outline to the shipped bundle, and owned the shape of the product rather than its code: the call to ship it as an installable bundle that registers an on-demand agent skill (the docs site renders those same sources rather than carrying a separate content set), the information architecture of the 10-chapter guide, the "every fact links to its origin" rule, and the split between the cognitive layer (`SKILL.md` + `guide/`) and the mechanical layer (`dsh-plugin-dev new / check / verify`). Set the evidence standard behind `guide/unfixed-issues.md` — `path:line` against a named host commit, a design-vs-bug table, and an explicit unreproducible section — and the freeze/retire criteria in `guide/when-to-retire-a-plugin.md`. Held the scope line (read-only, no network, no model calls, no tunable keys) and the five-language README parity requirement. - Day-to-day maintenance is assisted by DeepSeek Harness agents (they hold no GitHub account and are listed here for transparency, not as contributors). ## PerryLink DSH Plugin Family This project is part of the DeepSeek Harness plugin family from [PerryLink](https://github.com/PerryLink). The roster stays collapsed below so every README keeps a short first screen; expand it to see every row and its status.

# {{pkgName}} A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin scaffolded by [`dsh-plugin-dev new`](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-guide). ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `{{dshBaseline}}` (npm `alpha`); `latest`/`next` = `0.2.0-rc.2` | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network) | ## What it does Registers the `{{name}}_echo` tool. Calling it replies with `: `, where `` comes from the plugin config and `` is the argument. ## Install ```sh pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile add ./{{pkgName}}-{{version}}.tgz dsh --profile --dump-config | grep '{{pkgName}}' ``` ## Configuration | Key | Type | Default | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `greeting` | string | `Hello` | Prefix for the echo reply | Configuration is validated by the Schemastery `Config` schema in `src/config.ts`; no tunable is hardcoded. ## Development ```sh pnpm install pnpm run typecheck pnpm test pnpm run build ``` ## License [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE) © {{year}} {{pkgName}} contributors.

--- ## Install & uninstall - **npm channel** (published releases — **the default; start here**): `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-guide`. The published tarball already contains `dist/`, so no build step runs. - **git channel** (latest `main`, or an unreleased commit): `dsh plugin --profile web add github:PerryLink/dsh-plugin-guide#` — pin a commit for reproducibility. ⚠️ `dist/` is not committed, so pnpm must run this package's `prepare` and will refuse until the build is allowlisted; add it to the profile's `allowBuilds` (see [publish.md](references/official-docs/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md)). - **tarball channel**: `pnpm pack` in this repo, then `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plugin-guide-.tgz`. - **uninstall**: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-guide`. ## Why not just read the official docs? Because the official docs are written for someone who already knows which page to open, and DSH ships a **prerelease every 1.7–2.8 days** with breaking changes. This plugin closes the three gaps that costs authors the most time: | Gap | What this plugin adds | |---|---| | **"Which DSH am I even targeting?"** | A [version matrix](guide/version-matrix.md): the four different values that all call themselves "latest", the frozen sub-package `latest` tags, the breaking-change seams, and how to pick a `peerDependencies` range. **There is no stable line** — every published version is a prerelease. | | **"What does this break?"** | A [migration guide](guide/migration-0.2.md) covering `0.1.6-alpha.2` → `0.2.1-alpha.2` as **citable seams** with symptom *and* fix, each with its official source — including a data-loss hazard and a change that makes prompts fail before a model request is built. | | **"Is my plugin actually correct?"** | A [zero-dependency CLI](SKILL.md) (`dsh-plugin-dev new / check / verify`) plus an [offline verbatim mirror](references/official-docs/) of the official docs, so your agent can cite the exact page instead of guessing. | **Prove it works in 60 seconds:** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-guide npx dsh-plugin-guide new hello-plugin # scaffold a plugin cd hello-plugin && npx dsh-plugin-guide check --json # 16 static checks ``` **📖 Prefer reading it as a site?** [perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/) — every chapter as its own page, plus a machine-readable [llms.txt](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/llms.txt) for assistants. **Also on the 1024 store channel:** `npm i -g dsh1024`, then `dsh1024 plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-guide` (counts toward the [deepseek1024.com](https://deepseek1024.com) install ranking). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（95 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 95 plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. That is a documented pitfall of git installs, not a defect, but it makes the git channel a poor first experience. See [Install & uninstall](#install--uninstall) for the git and tarball channels when you specifically want an unreleased commit. Then just ask your agent: *"Use the dsh-plugin-guide skill to build me a … plugin."* Or drive the CLI directly: ```sh npx dsh-plugin-guide new hello-plugin # scaffold a TS plugin repo npx dsh-plugin-guide check --json # static-check it npx dsh-plugin-guide verify # pack + clean-profile smoke ``` ## Copy as a plain agent skill You can also copy the whole folder into your agent's skill directory (relative paths stay intact): ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) pwsh -File scripts/install-skill.ps1 ` -Target "$env:USERPROFILE\.deepseek\skills\dsh-plugin-guide" # or \.agents\skills\dsh-plugin-guide ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux pwsh -File scripts/install-skill.ps1 -Target ~/.deepseek/skills/dsh-plugin-guide # or /.agents/skills/dsh-plugin-guide ``` The installer skips `downloads/` (generated) and `.github/`, then verifies every copied file byte-for-byte. The `dsh-plugin-dev` CLI reads its tunables from flags and `DSH_PLUGIN_DEV_*` environment variables (see [CLI toolchain](#cli-toolchain)). ## Tools & surfaces | Surface | Kind | Notes | |---|---|---| | `dsh-plugin-guide` | skill | Registered via `ctx.skills`; loads `SKILL.md` + `./guide/` + `./references/` on demand | | `dsh-plugin-dev` | bin (CLI) | `new` / `check` / `verify` subcommands; not a DSH plugin row | ## Permissions & data - **Permissions**: declares `filesystem:read` in its workshop manifest. - **Data**: read-only — reads its own bundled `guide/` and `references/` files. No network requests, no writes, no model calls. ## Security boundaries - **Read-only knowledge base.** The bundle only reads its own files; it never writes, never calls the network, and never invokes a model. - **Official docs are verbatim copies.** `references/official-docs/` is never edited here; report issues upstream and re-sync only with `scripts/sync-official-docs.ps1`. - **Distribution boundaries.** Bundled third-party content keeps its upstream license; see [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) (e.g. `downloads/` is local-only; `awesome-dsh-plugins` must not be redistributed). ## Known limitations - **Official docs are a snapshot.** Re-sync with `scripts/sync-official-docs.ps1` when upstream moves; the freshness stamp and commit hash reference `references/official-docs/SNAPSHOT.md`. - **`downloads/` is generated, not committed.** Raw snapshots (community repo archives, Discussions, articles) must be generated with the scripts before use. - **`awesome-dsh-plugins` content is local-only.** Its upstream declares an internal-use constraint, so it is not redistributed with the repo. ## Release channels Every channel resolves from this repository or from npm, so one tag reaches all of them; only the Gitee mirror is a scheduled copy: | Channel | Source of truth | How it updates | |---|---|---| | npm (`dsh-plugin-guide`) | this repo's `package.json` | `.github/workflows/release.yml` on a `v*` tag: `verify-kit` gate → CHANGELOG section check → `npm publish --provenance` (skipped when the version already exists) | | GitHub Release | the same tag | the same workflow creates it idempotently from the tag | | Discovery badges (npm version, GitHub tag, DSH Market, dsh-doctor) | live lookups | nothing to publish — they read npm/the registry on each render | | Gitee mirror | this repo | a **read-only scheduled mirror**, not a publish target: it is force-aligned to the GitHub tip (`--force-with-lease`) by the family's `gitee-sync` workflow, so `main` is normally one scheduled run behind. Gitee never receives a tag push from here; compare `git ls-remote` against GitHub before reporting the mirror stale | | DSH Desktop Market / dsh1024 | npm | the market installs the npm package, so a published version is immediately installable; no per-version submission | ## Keeping it fresh ```sh pwsh -File scripts/sync-official-docs.ps1 # verbatim docs copy from a local checkout pwsh -File scripts/download-sources.ps1 # official site/docs, Cordis, paper pwsh -File scripts/download-community-repos.ps1 # community repositories (codeload tarballs) pwsh -File scripts/download-community-articles.ps1 # zh/en/HN community articles pwsh -File scripts/archive-discussions.ps1 # official Discussions (needs $env:GH_TOKEN) pwsh -File scripts/gen-topic-snapshot.ps1 -OutDir # dsh-plugin topic census pwsh -File scripts/verify-kit.ps1 -Checkout # critical paths + link scan + docs drift ``` ## Development The skill bundle (`index.js`) is plain ESM with no build step; the `dsh-plugin-dev` CLI is TypeScript built by tsdown. evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Task Board Plugin for DeepSeek Harness

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-agent-board)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-agent-board)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dw/dsh-agent-board.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-agent-board)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/node/v/dsh-agent-board.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-agent-board)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-agent-board)](https://github.com/PPawnsir/task-board-plugin/blob/main/LICENSE)
![category](https://img.shields.io/badge/awesome--dsh--plugin-workflow-blue)

智能看板插件 — agent 团队的持久台账与治理层：把「派发 → 执行 → 验收 → 度量 → 复盘」跑成全链路闭环，每一张卡都是可审计、可度量的长期资产。

## 定位

**dsh-agent-board 是 agent 团队的持久台账与治理层——看板只是界面，内核是「派发 → 执行 → 验收 → 度量 → 复盘」的全链路闭环。** 它与「一次性组队、跑完即散」的冲锋型编排器、「人建卡、agent 认领、人逐张验收」的手工看板不是一个代际：

- **持久台账**：任务卡是长期资产。完成 / 驳回 / 歧义裁决 / 验收结论 / Token 消耗 / 自测指南，每一笔都落账留痕，看板文件即审计底稿；卸载不删数据，重启自动继承。
- **池化 Worker + 独立 Verifier**：执行与验收分离——Worker 负责动手（可续跑，续跑只认新增产出），Verifier 独立复跑验收脚本、以实证为准，不听 Worker 的一面之词。
- **独立验收**：`acceptance` 硬性脚本命令由 Worker 实跑、Verifier 独立复跑；结论分通过 / 驳回并逐条给证据。人只看该看的——风险队列「待你过目」把该亲自确认的卡推到眼前，其余交给机器闭环。
- **可运维度量栈**：记分卡（模型表现 / 质量趋势 / 驳回聚类）、运行时健康自检、异常驱动审视（风险队列 / 质量异动告警 / 批次摘要）三层，让成本与质量从「感觉」变成「数字」。

> **流水线归机器，审计台归人。** 我们不造「跑完就散」的冲锋队，也不做「人逐张盯着验收」的手工看板；我们的信念只有三条：**验收独立复跑、人只看该看的、数据沉淀成资产**。别人负责冲锋，agent-board 负责记账与验收——互补，不对抗。

### 适合谁 / 什么时候用

- **长期多任务并行**：一个会话里几十张卡、有依赖有先后、还不断追加新需求——需要一份不随会话结束而消失的台账，而不是每次重开都从零描述。
- **关心成本与质量趋势**：想看清哪个模型在什么场景更省、驳回率在涨还是跌、哪些文件反复成为锁热点——需要记分卡与趋势，而不是拍脑袋。
- **不想逐张审卡**：接受「独立复跑 + 风险队列兜底」的治理方式——机器把「该我亲自看」的卡筛出来，其余信任验收闭环。
- **缺一层治理而非缺一个编排器**：已有冲锋型的团队 / 编排工具，缺的正是「记账、验收、度量、复盘」这一层——agent-board 补上它。

## 安装

### 前置条件

- DeepSeek Harness（dsh）已安装并能正常启动：`dsh --profile web`
- Node.js ≥ 22（与 dsh 运行时一致）

### 版本兼容性（先按宿主选插件版本）

| 宿主 DSH 版本 | 应装插件版本 | 原因 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **≥ 0.2.0**（含 rc） | **≥ 1.3.0（必须）** | 0.2.0 起宿主在启动/安装时强制校验 peerDependencies，区间不含 0.2.0 的包**直接拒绝激活**（路由不挂载、面板不出现）。1.3.0 声明 `^0.1.7 \|\| 0.2.0-rc.2 \|\| ^0.2.0`——注意 semver 预发布不命中宽区间，`0.2.0-rc.2` 必须显式枚举。运行时 API（subagents/systemPrompt/agents/uiWorkspace.openSession/sessions/v4 日志格式）在 0.2.0 全部兼容，已过 0.2.0-rc.2 实测（E2E 23+8 断言全绿） |
| **0.1.7 ~ 0.1.7-x**（含 rc） | **≥ 1.2.2（必须）** | 0.1.7 会话日志升级为 format v4：插件消息 `source.kind` 必须是生产者自有 kind。1.2.1 及更早会在**任务完成/阻塞回执**落盘时抛 `SessionFormatError: format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind`，并连带使主窗口当前轮次失败（表现为「本轮运行失败」）；同时「跳转会话」因宿主移除 `sessions.open` 而失效（控制台 `sessionsSvc.open is not a function`），卡片活动心跳读不到 v4 日志（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`） |
| 0.1.5-rc.1 ~ 0.1.6 | ≤ 1.2.1 | 1.2.2 起按 0.1.7 协议编写（v4 source kind、`uiWorkspace.openSession` 跳转），旧宿主未做回归验证，建议停留 1.2.1 |

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agent-board@latest   # 0.1.7+/0.2.x 宿主（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agent-board@1.2.1    # 0.1.5/0.1.6 宿主
```

> 从 ≤1.2.1 升到 ≥1.2.2 必须重启 DSH（host 端代码在启动时加载；1.2.2 之前的老版本还有一个路由残留 bug：禁用/启用热重载会撞 `duplicate exact route`，只能重启恢复，1.2.2 已修复）。

### 从插件市场安装（推荐）

已发布至 npm 官方 registry（[dsh-agent-board](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-agent-board)）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agent-board
# 重启 dsh 生效
dsh --profile web
```

### 从源码安装（开发/调试）

```sh
git clone https://github.com/PPawnsir/task-board-plugin.git
dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库绝对路径>/packages/dsh-agent-board
# 重启 dsh
```

### 验证安装

1. 启动日志无 `plugin tree failed to load`
2. 打开任意会话，标题栏出现 **智能看板** 按钮（Lucide 线性图标）
3. RPC 路由可用：

```sh
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-agent-board \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"method":"get-tasks","args":{"sessionId":"<sessionId>"}}'
```

返回 JSON 即正常；405 空 body 说明路由未挂载。

### 升级

```sh
# 市场版
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agent-board@latest
# 源码版
git pull
# 两者都需重启 dsh
```

### 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-agent-board
# 重启 dsh
```

> 看板数据存在 `~/.dsh/tasks-<sessionId>.json`，卸载不删数据。
>
> - **归属**：看板文件按**会话**分文件，同时在文件里记 `ownerCwd`（创建该看板的会话工作区路径，取不到则省略该字段）——`~/.dsh/tasks-*.json` 每个文件是一块看板，`list-boards` 全局视图可看到本机所有板。
> - **重启继承**：DSH 重启后同一会话的根 id 可能漂移，此时新 id 没有对应文件——若同工作区（`ownerCwd` 严格相等）存在**唯一**「原主已不在 `agents.roots()`」的看板，则自动继承：文件重命名为新 id、文件内 `ownerSession` 改写为新 id、`console.error` 留一行 `[task-board] 继承看板 <旧sid> → <新sid>`；**多个候选一律不自动接管**（记一行日志后按空板处理，防误合并，旧板仍可在 `list-boards` 全局视图里看到）。
> - **写盘保护**：落盘走 临时文件+rename 原子写（EPERM/EBUSY 退避重试）；瞬时读失败/坏文件隔离后返回的空板**禁止回写**（防一个"读不到"的瞬间把看板覆成空板），坏文件隔离为 `.corrupt-<时间戳>` 留档不丢数据。

## 数据安全

看板数据（`~/.dsh/tasks-<sessionId>.json`）是本插件唯一的持久化状态，按三层防线保证数据不丢、事故可见：

- **原子写盘（防撕裂写）**：落盘一律「写临时文件 → `fsync` → `rename` 覆盖目标」——`rename` 在同分区是原子的，进程在写盘中途被强杀时磁盘上最多残留一个 `.tmp` 残件，看板本体永远不会是截断的半个 JSON。Windows 上 `rename` 覆盖已存在目标原生支持（实测直接覆盖成功），仅当目标被并发读句柄/Defender/索引器瞬时占用（`EPERM`/`EBUSY`/`EACCES`/`ENOTEMPTY`）时做有限退避重试；重试耗尽仍失败则降级「先 `unlink` 目标再 `rename`」并留日志——绝不丢整板。
- **腐坏隔离可见化（不再静默）**：加载时若 JSON 解析失败（撕裂写/重启打断导致文件中部夹杂另一版本残片），坏文件改名 `.corrupt-<时间戳>` 留档隔离（防反复 poison），同时在「架构健康」区亮一条 **err 级红条**（`healthHints`）提示「看板数据文件腐坏已隔离，历史在 `.corrupt-<ts>`，可联系恢复」，并向 owner 会话推送通知——数据不丢，也不再静默从空板重启。
- **自动 salvage（截断抢救）**：隔离前先尝试抢救——从首字节起截到第一个完整 JSON 值（`JSON.parse` 报错 `position` 截断法，与人工恢复同款手法），成功则以抢救出的完整板为底自动写回继续（`healthHints` 红条记「已抢救保留 N 张卡，丢弃撕裂残片」），失败才回退空板。两种情况下原始文件都留档 `.corrupt-<ts>`，可随时人工恢复。

## 功能总览

**核心能力一页速览**（`★` 为 v1.7.5–1.8.4 新栈）：

- **看板**：六列状态流、拖拽 / 多选批量 / 文本·优先级·标签筛选、归档留档、会话隔离
- **派发**：一次性 Worker / 独立 Verifier、依赖调度（DFS 环检测）、touches 文件级排他、可续跑 Worker、Team 托管、**spawn 落闸锁内重验**（spawnGateOk：claim 占位与落闸决策读同一把锁的同一份快照，terminate/dependsOn 后补 落在 spawn 在途窗口即弃权——竞态与后补依赖双双根治）、**高优干预分态**（intervene 无活跃 run 时区分「续跑窗口，干预随续跑注入」与「真无 run」，返回体带 state 字段）、**建卡派发预警**（将自动派发时 lintWarnings 瞬态提示「约 1s 内被领取，想占位请 draft:true」）、**宿主 spawn API 双兼容**（v0.2.1 宿主把 `subagents.start/startContinuable` 统一重构为 `startActivation(spec)`——能力探测自动选路：新契约按 `delivery` 语义分发（continuable=`parent` 结算留言 / 一次性=`caller` 只回 result），Activation 适配旧 run 形状下游零改动；老宿主逐字走旧双路径）+ **continuable 结算兜底臂**（`activation.result` 在子会话被宿主拆除时落定即接失败结算——rate-limit/模型崩溃的死子不再挂到硬超时）
- **验收治理** `★`：硬性验收脚本独立复跑、驳回全量带回重派、Verifier 自测指南（userTest）、风险队列「待你过目」、验收时序防护（Verifier 在场时主窗口抢批需显式 `force:true`；有活跃 run 的卡禁止归档；Verifier 迟到结论落 `lateVerdict` 留痕+直投告警）、**迟到 verdict 三保险**（①入参校验：`verdict` 非 approved/rejected 拒收并返回重调指引——漏带字段不再被当驳回落账；②通知分态：approved 迟到=「✅ 迟到复核·全过追认」notice 级，🚨「迟到驳回」只留给真 rejected；③指纹去重：同 taskId+by+verdict 只投一次，重复落账零重复通知）
- **度量** `★`：Token 消耗（总量 / 有效 / 缓存读，按模型·按任务·按日）+ 记分卡（模型表现 / 质量趋势 / 驳回聚类）
- **可运维性** `★`：运行时健康自检（派发冻结 / 结算停滞告警）、异常驱动审视（风险队列 / 质量异动告警 / 批次摘要）、起草 lint、数据安全（原子写盘 / 腐坏隔离 / 自动 salvage）、**僵尸 run 留档清扫**（host 重启后「落定卡上的 running 无 endedAt 留档」在派发周期自动关账 `stale-closed` + 清认领位，归档门禁不再被幻影 run 永久拦截）、**子会话生命周期收口**（一次性 run 落定/迟到 verdict 落账后主动 interrupt 子会话——「结算≠停止」空转根治；continuable 收紧为「续跑位真在本 child 手上」才豁免，残影 Worker 无处藏身）、**terminate 三保险**（no-rec 也按认领位盲杀补刀 + interrupt 失败 err 级可见化 + `hold:true` 原子「终止+转手动」）、**配置审计**（set-board-config 成功写入落板级 configLog {key,from,to,actor,at} 截尾 50 条；模型下拉两段式选中≠保存）
- **学习反馈**：候选教训信号 → 主窗口沉淀（零耦合，不碰任何笔记 / 记忆工具 API）

以下各节是完整规格。

### 看板 UI

- 会话标题栏「智能看板」按钮 → 顶部抽屉面板（看板 / 团队 / 仪表盘三视图）
- 面板右上角「＋ 新建任务」：表单弹层填标题/描述/优先级/管线/touches/依赖多选/验收脚本，Team 托管默认存为草稿（提交走 create-task RPC，成功即刷新、失败表单内联报错）
- 新建任务弹层为视口级 overlay（fixed 全屏遮罩 + 限高 80vh + 字段区内部滚动 + 按钮区吸底常驻，不再被看板抽屉裁切）；卡片「当前动作」行摘要化为「工具名 + 关键参数」（40 字符内有意义断点截断，悬停 title 看 host 原文），不再展示裸 JSON
- 六列状态流：草稿 → 待办 → 进行中 → 验证中 → 已完成 → 阻塞（空板也统一渲染六列骨架 + 引导 CTA：右上角「＋ 新建任务」或对话一句 task_create 建第一张卡）
- 读路径 error 防线：get-tasks 返回 {error} 或网络抖动时保留现有卡片与设置（不再静默清空全板），面板头部下方出非阻断红色错误条，下次刷新成功自动消失
- 耗时口径三分离：待办/草稿卡显「⏳ 等待 N」（创建→被领取），执行后显「⏱ 执行 N」（被领取→完成，tooltip 写清口径）——排队时间不再混进"耗时"
